Every capability

Coordinate workspace edits for workbench and extension callers

Accept resource edit batches directly or through an extension transport bridge; revive extension payloads, conditionally preview, coordinate undo grouping and cancellation, and dispatch resource-kind edit groups. The extension interface returns a boolean from the shared coordinator, while workbench callers receive its summary and application flag.

old:old:R_WorkspaceEdits · candidate · proposer assessment: supported · independent verification: not performed

Actor: Workbench features and extensions requesting workspace changes

Observable outcomes

  • Specialized edit performers are called in input-kind group order
  • An accessibility summary and isApplied flag are returned
  • Involved dirty working copies may be saved under the refactoring autosave conditions
  • Serialized edit sent to the main-thread proxy
  • Revived edit delegated to the bulk-edit coordinator
  • Boolean result returned, with application rejection logged and converted to false

Conditions

  • Empty initial edit batches return isApplied false
  • Preview requires a registered handler plus showPreview or an edit requiring confirmation
  • Cancellation is checked between edit-kind groups
  • Autosave requires respectAutoSaveConfig, the corresponding enabled setting, and more than one returned resource
  • The inspected version provider retrieves text versions but returns undefined for notebook versions
  • Data-transfer file contents require a supplied resolver when reviving such payloads

Outside this scope

  • No claim of atomic all-or-nothing mutation or rollback
  • isApplied is computed from edit-array length and is not independent proof that every edit ran
  • The extension transport does not independently perform edits.
  • No claim that every extension API registration or edit-producing feature reaches this bridge.

Uncertainty

  • File and attachment performers and preview UI were not inspected
  • Runtime behavior was not exercised
  • WorkspaceEdit.from conversion internals and extension API registration were not inspected

Source: old:old:A-005, old:old:A-006, old:old:A-001, old:old:A-002

Apply validated text-model edit batches with undo

Resolve target text models, prepare replacement and line-ending changes, validate expected model versions, and apply edits with single-model or multi-model undo entries.

old:old:A_BulkTextEdits · candidate · proposer assessment: supported · independent verification: not performed

Actor: Bulk-edit coordinator

Observable outcomes

  • Text-model edit operations and line-ending changes applied
  • Undo stack element recorded
  • Touched resource URIs returned

Conditions

  • The prepared task validates its stored expected version against the model version; addEdit assigns that stored version from each added resource edit.
  • Cancellation after preparation returns an empty resource list
  • Single-model no-op tasks do not create an edit stack element
  • Plain edit groups for the matching active editor may be minimized by the editor worker

Outside this scope

  • No claim of file saving
  • No claim that snippet interaction is identical with and without an active editor

Uncertainty

  • EditorEditTask's specialized apply path was not inspected
  • The model and undo services themselves were not inspected
  • Consistency among different expected versions supplied within a resource group is not established by the inspected preparation and model-task windows.

Source: old:old:A-008, old:old:A-022, old:old:A-024

Apply notebook-cell edit groups

Normalize cell URIs, group edits by notebook, check the first edit's optional notebook version in each group, and delegate changes with undo and current selection context.

old:old:A_BulkNotebookEdits · candidate · proposer assessment: supported · independent verification: not performed

Actor: Bulk-edit coordinator

Observable outcomes

  • Notebook model applyEdits invoked for each processed notebook
  • Processed notebook URIs returned

Conditions

  • Cancellation is checked before each notebook group
  • Invalid cell URIs throw; a group's first edit supplies the optional notebook version compared against the resolved model.
  • Undo computation is enabled when the resolved model is not readonly
  • Selection context is captured only for a matching active notebook editor

Outside this scope

  • Does not prove notebook persistence
  • The readonly check controls undo computation in this code; it is not demonstrated here as a mutation prohibition

Uncertainty

  • Notebook model edit semantics and supported cell edit kinds were not fully inspected
  • Later edits in the same notebook group are not individually version-checked by the displayed apply method.

Preserve unsaved work across workbench shutdown

Organize background working-copy backups, startup editor reassociation and native/browser shutdown decisions concerning modified work.

R_UnsavedWorkContinuity · candidate · proposer assessment: partial · independent verification: not performed

Actor: Editor user and workbench lifecycle

Observable outcomes

  • Schedule/discard backups and reopen handled retained backups
  • Choose backup, save, discard or veto behavior during shutdown

Conditions

  • Backup version and handler availability matter
  • Native asynchronous save/backup decisions differ from browser synchronous veto checks

Outside this scope

  • Crash-loss guarantees or proven persistent durability
  • Chat-history forks or request checkpoint navigation
  • Saved-file history browsing

Uncertainty

  • This is candidate organization of a shared working-copy lifecycle; concrete backup storage and restart recovery remain unverified.

Source: C-011, C-012, C-016, C-017, C-019

Inputs, implementations and individual claims

Inputs

  • Modified working copies and content versions
  • Available backups and compatible editor handlers
  • Shutdown reason, hot-exit/auto-save policy and user decisions

Implementations

  • common, electron-browser and browser workingCopyBackupTracker.ts

Background tracking stores working-copy backups and startup restoration associates backup identifiers with editors. Native shutdown can reuse/create matching backups or choose save/discard; browser shutdown synchronously checks matching backups and vetoes when needed.

Integration decisions and changes

These records account for model decisions; they do not establish correctness or independent review. Removals describe changes to candidate maps, not deletion of repository functionality.

Global scope decisions

Is inspect and decide chat-produced edits a supported higher organization?

Decision: Add R_ChatEditReviewAndHistory with distinct child responsibilities.

A shared source-backed editing-state responsibility supports one parent without merging review decisions with checkpoint access or claiming the file-creation tool's stream is wired into this session.

Is work with generated code completion candidates a supported higher organization?

B-003, B-004, B-006, B-008, B-013, B-014

Uncertainty

  • The common outcome is candidate code assistance; the sources do not establish a single generating pipeline or universal lookup-to-panel handoff.
Is control the connected workbench from a remote terminal a supported higher organization?

Decision: Add R_RemoteTerminalWorkbenchRequests with distinct child responsibilities.

The previously missing workbench handler is now inspected. The receiver's actual request switch and registered destinations justify a parent; resource opening, external URLs and remote extension management retain separate conditions and outputs.

C-006, C-007, C-010, C-013, C-014, R-001

Uncertainty

  • This grouping concerns the shared request boundary and its concrete outcomes, not all CLI functions or all remote-development behavior.
Is preserve unsaved work across workbench shutdown a supported higher organization?

Decision: Add R_UnsavedWorkContinuity with distinct child responsibilities.

Shutdown protection explicitly consults the same backup responsibility, and the browser implementation inherits the common tracker. A parent makes that lifecycle relationship visible without merging asynchronous recovery with shutdown policy.

C-011, C-012, C-016, C-017, C-019

Uncertainty

  • This is candidate organization of a shared working-copy lifecycle; concrete backup storage and restart recovery remain unverified.
Should shared low-level edit operations collapse higher-level editing responsibilities?

Decision: Keep workspace coordination, text/notebook specializations, search replacement, diff reversion, chat file production and chat review distinct.

They differ in the operation they accept or produce, applicability/version rules, review state and saving behavior. The panel and import/export gain directly evidenced service dependencies; other apparent producer/consumer links remain unasserted.

old:old:A-001, old:old:A-005, old:old:A-008, old:old:A-021, old:old:A-010, old:old:B-014, old:old:B-020, A-007, B-008

Uncertainty

  • A common edit shape is not proof of one user workflow or successful persistence.
Can chat fork, side-chat submission and protocol additional-chat creation merge?

Decision: Keep all three responsibilities and express partial overlaps with protocol chat creation.

The local fork path clones serialized histories and identities; side-chat UI captures selection and delegates through the first eligible provider; protocol creation forwards Fork/SideChat source parameters and manages chat resources in an existing session. No inspected provider ties these into an equivalent implementation.

A-009, A-011, R-002, A-012, R-003, R-005, B-012

Uncertainty

  • Concrete provider creation and history/context isolation were not inspected.
Are all conversation-related nodes one session-management responsibility?

Decision: Do not add an all-chat/session superclass or merge unrelated lifecycle nodes.

Persisted local group membership, exported conversation JSON, composer attachments, queue/steer actions, automation admission and protocol resource creation have distinct inputs and observable outcomes. Sharing session identifiers or a chat surface alone does not provide useful containment.

old:old:C-006, old:old:C-014, A-002, A-004, A-008, A-010, A-012, B-012

Uncertainty

  • This leaves room for later source-backed organization without making current gaps into absence claims.
Do the existing completion and rename groupings absorb generated code completions?

Decision: Keep configuration completions and provider rename boundaries; add a separate code-candidate group.

JSONC variable/settings suggestions, shell context suggestions and AI rename names are constrained to different domains and consumers. Inline/panel code candidates share insertion-text/range outcomes, but even those preserve different interactions and feedback.

old:old:B-001, old:B-002, old:B-003, old:old:B-016, old:B-011, old:R-001, B-003, B-004, B-008

Uncertainty

  • Similar names or generated suggestions do not establish one backend or permanent taxonomy.
Should citations, diagnostics and AI commit attribution share one evidence/quality capability?

Decision: Keep them distinct.

Marker exchange transports extension diagnostics; code citations display supplied/matched source/license information; the Git helper conditionally adds a trailer using reported AI contribution state. None independently establishes quality, authorship or legal conclusions.

old:A-007, B-008, B-013, B-014, old:old:B-005

Uncertainty

  • No contributor ranking, source-exhaustiveness or licensing conclusion is inferred.
Should servers, tunnels and remote CLI requests be merged as remote access?

Decision: Preserve protocol hosting, web-editor serving, tunnel hosting/administration/background registration, port reconciliation and terminal command requests.

The sources establish different exposed services and lifecycle responsibilities. A WebSocket server wiring session/chat requests is not an HTTP editor router or a singleton tunnel, and a terminal request client/handler is not server hosting.

B-009, B-010, B-012, old:old:C-009, old:old:C-011, old:C-001, old:C-002, old:C-003, old:C-004, C-013, R-001

Uncertainty

  • Shared transport vocabulary supplies overlap, not endpoint/security/runtime equivalence.
Are the inherited file, accessibility, test, speech and selection groupings still useful?

Decision: Retain their evidence-bounded parent/child organization and distinct specializations.

Provider/content routing, visual versus screen-reader state, test request versus result/coverage reporting, speech modalities, and explicit/history/pattern-derived selections retain different input/output contracts. No new proposal supplies a same-responsibility replacement.

old:old:C-001, old:old:C-004, old:old:C-005, old:old:C-017, old:old:C-018, old:old:A-014, old:old:A-015, old:A-005, old:A-006, old:B-004, old:B-005, old:old:B-010

Uncertainty

  • These remain candidate groupings, not a complete or mandatory repository hierarchy.
Do similarly named timeline, snapshot, virtual-document and recovery functions collapse?

Decision: Keep event timelines, virtual documents, request checkpoints and unsaved backup restoration distinct.

A provider event list, a model content supplier, an editing-request snapshot lookup and a startup backup/editor association have different state, identity and outcomes. The new unsaved-work grouping links recovery to actual shutdown backup checks instead of a generic history category.

old:A-001, old:A-003, old:A-015, A-007, C-012, C-016, C-017, C-019

Uncertainty

  • Concrete checkpoint navigation and backup storage/resolve implementations remain uninspected.
Can the two inherited embedding-provider interfaces be consolidated?

Decision: Retain their distinct interfaces and existing overlap.

The named registry selects by identifier and returns value objects; the other path races providers with different timeout/result-shape behavior. The packet does not establish replacement or interchangeable outcomes.

old:A-012, old:A-013, old:A-014

Uncertainty

  • Generation quality, universal cancellation and runtime registration remain outside the observed boundary.
What changes were required by source rather than organizational preference?

Decision: Correct the rename await claim and fork index description; narrow unsupported success claims and enrich newly traced boundaries.

The rename controller has a separate apply promise chain. Request-item forks clamp to zero. The remote pipe open handler does not await command completion; external opening's boolean is unchecked; extension calls target a remote helper and report errors. Static restart tests do not demonstrate passing recovery.

old:old:R-008, R-002, C-013, C-014, R-001, C-005, C-012, C-016

Uncertainty

  • The first saved candidate is not an independent verification result; unresolved outcomes remain explicit.
Was retention selected to reach a count or retain all inherited decisions?

Decision: No count or depth target; retain differentiated responsibilities after source-based comparison and revise identified boundary mistakes.

None of the eighteen new proposals was shown to be the same responsibility as an existing node. Shared substrate and overlapping outcomes are represented by dependencies, overlap or supported parents instead of unsupported identity merges. Every retained node and edge has explicit lineage and new-node comparison rationale.

A-007, B-008, B-012, C-013, R-001, old:old:A-005, old:old:C-006

Uncertainty

  • Bounded evidence can miss a better consolidation; no exhaustion or permanent semantic ownership is claimed.

Every new-to-existing comparison

Import and export chat sessions (A_session_import_export) — distinct

Compared with: Share and retrieve profile content through GitHub gists (old:BProfileGistTransport), Read file content through capability-aware paths (old:old:CFileRead), Create and write files with provider constraints (old:old:CFileWrite)

Conversation JSON round-tripping is not profile-text Gist transport and is not the provider-level act of reading/writing bytes. The source shows a separate selected-chat export/import, validation and presentation workflow.

Disposition: Retain the conversation responsibility and add its direct file-read/write dependencies.

A-002, old:B-001, old:old:C-004, old:old:C-005

Uncertainty

  • No generalized profile/chat transfer service is established.
Review, keep and undo chat edits (A_review_chat_edits) — overlapping

Compared with: Restore selected diff changes from the original editor model (old:old:B_diff_revert), Coordinate workspace edits for workbench and extension callers (old:old:R_WorkspaceEdits), Emit new-file edits from a language-model tool request (old:old:B_chat_file_creation)

Chat review can undo changes, overlapping diff reversion, but it operates on editing-session entry decisions and eligibility; workspace edits apply operations and the chat file tool emits stream edits. Neither prior node supplies the same review-state contract.

Disposition: Retain as a distinct child of chat-edit review/history; link overlap with diff reversal, not an untraced tool-to-session dependency.

A-003, A-005, A-007, old:old:B-020, old:old:A-005, old:old:B-014

Uncertainty

  • Concrete edited-entry rejection implementation and tool-stream handoff remain uninspected.
Retrieve and restore chat editing checkpoints (A_edit_checkpoints) — distinct

Compared with: Provider-backed resource timelines (old:A_resource_timeline), Extension-backed virtual text documents (old:A_virtual_documents), Restore selected diff changes from the original editor model (old:old:B_diff_revert)

Request/undo-stop checkpoint lookup and timeline navigation address chat editing history. Provider timeline event browsing, virtual document supply and explicit diff-range restoration have different inputs and outcomes; similarly named history/content machinery is not identity.

Disposition: Retain checkpoint detail under the chat-edit control grouping, without merging it into general timeline or diff capabilities.

A-007, old:A-003, old:A-015, old:A-001, old:old:B-020

Uncertainty

  • Checkpoint navigation's concrete restoration effects are delegated and remain partial.
Manage file, folder and image chat attachments (A_chat_attachments) — distinct

Compared with: Return semantic workspace context to a language-model tool caller (old:old:B_semantic_context), Extension access to workbench browser tabs (old:A_browser_tabs)

The attachment model maintains typed selected context entries, deduplicates them and reacts to removal/watcher events. Semantic codebase search supplies retrieved references; browser-tab management controls tabs. Neither is the same selected attachment lifecycle.

Disposition: Retain the attachment responsibility; do not infer retrieval or browser-operation dependencies from attachment kinds.

Fork a chat conversation from its history (A_fork_conversation) — distinct

Compared with: Organize sessions into persistent local groups (old:old:CSessionGroups), Persist automation runs and coordinate session execution (old:old:CAutomationRuns)

Forking copies a conversation prefix into a new identity or delegates a contributed fork. Group membership organizes existing sessions, while automation admits and launches runs; session creation alone does not make their outcomes equivalent.

Disposition: Revise the fork index boundary, retain the distinct responsibility, and record partial overlap with new protocol chat branching.

A-009, A-011, R-002, old:old:C-006, old:old:C-014

Queue/steer actions route a current chat composer or pending request relative to in-progress conversation work. Automation admission deduplicates manual claims or selects schedule occurrences and creates run state; it is not that conversational interaction.

Disposition: Retain the chat routing responsibility without subsuming it under automation scheduling.

What was and wasn’t inspected

15023 unique source lines inspected across 90 files, from 13325 eligible files and 18709 tracked entries. A file counts once even if only a small excerpt was read. This is not a percentage of capabilities discovered; completed assignments do not establish exhaustive coverage.

Assignment A — scope and omissions

Candidate responsibilities derived from bounded inspection of chat browser actions, attachment state and editing-session operations at the pinned VS Code snapshot. Both assigned regions were inspected; the local lint rule was treated as developer-tooling evidence rather than a source of an application capability.

Cross-assignment leads

19  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadBulkEdits)
20  export class MainThreadBulkEdits implements MainThreadBulkEditsShape {
21  
22  	constructor(
23  		_extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
24  		@IBulkEditService private readonly _bulkEditService: IBulkEditService,
25  		@ILogService private readonly _logService: ILogService,
26  		@IUriIdentityService private readonly _uriIdentService: IUriIdentityService
27  	) { }
28  
29  	dispose(): void { }
30  
31  	$tryApplyWorkspaceEdit(dto: SerializableObjectWithBuffers<IWorkspaceEditDto>, undoRedoGroupId?: number, isRefactoring?: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
32  		const edits = reviveWorkspaceEditDto(dto.value, this._uriIdentService);
33  		return this._bulkEditService.apply(edits, { undoRedoGroupId, respectAutoSaveConfig: isRefactoring }).then((res) => res.isApplied, err => {
34  			this._logService.warn(`IGNORING workspace edit: ${err}`);
35  			return false;
36  		});
37  	}
38  }
39  
40  export function reviveWorkspaceEditDto(data: IWorkspaceEditDto, uriIdentityService: IUriIdentityService, resolveDataTransferFile?: (id: string) => Promise<VSBuffer>): WorkspaceEdit;
41  export function reviveWorkspaceEditDto(data: IWorkspaceEditDto | undefined, uriIdentityService: IUriIdentityService, resolveDataTransferFile?: (id: string) => Promise<VSBuffer>): WorkspaceEdit | undefined;
42  export function reviveWorkspaceEditDto(data: IWorkspaceEditDto | undefined, uriIdentityService: IUriIdentityService, resolveDataTransferFile?: (id: string) => Promise<VSBuffer>): WorkspaceEdit | undefined {
43  	if (!data || !data.edits) {
44  		return <WorkspaceEdit>data;
45  	}
46  	const result = revive<WorkspaceEdit>(data);
47  	for (const edit of result.edits) {
48  		if (ResourceTextEdit.is(edit)) {
49  			edit.resource = uriIdentityService.asCanonicalUri(edit.resource);
50  		}
51  		if (ResourceFileEdit.is(edit)) {
52  			if (edit.options) {
53  				const inContents = (edit as IWorkspaceFileEditDto).options?.contents;
54  				if (inContents) {
55  					if (inContents.type === 'base64') {
56  						edit.options.contents = Promise.resolve(decodeBase64(inContents.value));
57  					} else {
58  						if (resolveDataTransferFile) {
59  							edit.options.contents = resolveDataTransferFile(inContents.id);
60  						} else {
61  							throw new Error('Could not revive data transfer file');
62  						}
63  					}
64  				}
65  			}
66  			edit.newResource = edit.newResource && uriIdentityService.asCanonicalUri(edit.newResource);
67  			edit.oldResource = edit.oldResource && uriIdentityService.asCanonicalUri(edit.oldResource);
68  		}
69  		if (ResourceNotebookCellEdit.is(edit)) {
70  			edit.resource = uriIdentityService.asCanonicalUri(edit.resource);
71  			const cellEdit = (edit as IWorkspaceCellEditDto).cellEdit;
72  			if (cellEdit.editType === CellEditType.Replace) {
73  				edit.cellEdit = {
74  					...cellEdit,
75  					cells: cellEdit.cells.map(cell => ({
76  						...cell,
77  						outputs: cell.outputs.map(output => ({
78  							...output,
79  							outputs: output.items.map(item => {
80  								return {
81  									mime: item.mime,
82  									data: item.valueBytes
83  								};
84  							})
85  						}))
86  					}))
87  				};
88  			}
89  		}
90  	}
91  	return <WorkspaceEdit>data;
92  }

99  	async perform(reason?: TextModelEditSource): Promise<readonly URI[]> {
100  
101  		if (this._edits.length === 0) {
102  			return [];
103  		}
104  
105  		const ranges: number[] = [1];
106  		for (let i = 1; i < this._edits.length; i++) {
107  			if (Object.getPrototypeOf(this._edits[i - 1]) === Object.getPrototypeOf(this._edits[i])) {
108  				ranges[ranges.length - 1]++;
109  			} else {
110  				ranges.push(1);
111  			}
112  		}
113  
114  		// Show infinte progress when there is only 1 item since we do not know how long it takes
115  		const increment = this._edits.length > 1 ? 0 : undefined;
116  		this._progress.report({ increment, total: 100 });
117  		// Increment by percentage points since progress API expects that
118  		const progress: IProgress<void> = { report: _ => this._progress.report({ increment: 100 / this._edits.length }) };
119  
120  		const resources: (readonly URI[])[] = [];
121  		let index = 0;
122  		for (const range of ranges) {
123  			if (this._token.isCancellationRequested) {
124  				break;
125  			}
126  			const group = this._edits.slice(index, index + range);
127  			if (group[0] instanceof ResourceFileEdit) {
128  				resources.push(await this._performFileEdits(<ResourceFileEdit[]>group, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource, this._confirmBeforeUndo, progress));
129  			} else if (group[0] instanceof ResourceTextEdit) {
130  				resources.push(await this._performTextEdits(<ResourceTextEdit[]>group, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource, progress, reason));
131  			} else if (group[0] instanceof ResourceNotebookCellEdit) {
132  				resources.push(await this._performCellEdits(<ResourceNotebookCellEdit[]>group, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource, progress));
133  			} else if (group[0] instanceof ResourceAttachmentEdit) {
134  				resources.push(await this._performOpaqueEdits(<ResourceAttachmentEdit[]>group, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource, progress));
135  			} else {
136  				console.log('UNKNOWN EDIT');
137  			}
138  			index = index + range;
139  		}
140  
141  		return resources.flat();
142  	}
143

145  		this._logService.debug('_performFileEdits', JSON.stringify(edits));

253  					const oldEdits = edits.slice(start, end);
254  					const newEdits = await this._editorWorker.computeMoreMinimalEdits(ref.object.textEditorModel.uri, oldEdits.map(e => e.textEdit), false);
255  					if (!newEdits) {
256  						oldEdits.forEach(task.addEdit, task);
257  					} else {
258  						// All edits in the group have the same version id since we group the edits
259  						// in the constructor by the resource URI.
260  						const versionId = oldEdits[0]?.versionId;
261  						newEdits.forEach(edit => task.addEdit(new ResourceTextEdit(ref.object.textEditorModel.uri, edit, versionId, undefined)));
262  					}
263  				};
264  
265  				let start = 0;
266  				let i = 0;
267  				for (; i < edits.length; i++) {
268  					if (edits[i].textEdit.insertAsSnippet || edits[i].metadata) {
269  						await makeGroupMoreMinimal(start, i); // grouped edits until now
270  						task.addEdit(edits[i]); // this edit
271  						start = i + 1;
272  					}
273  				}
274  				await makeGroupMoreMinimal(start, i);
275  
276  			});
277  			promises.push(promise);
278  		}
279  
280  		await Promise.all(promises);
281  		return tasks;
282  	}
283  
284  	private _validateTasks(tasks: ModelEditTask[]): ValidationResult {
285  		for (const task of tasks) {
286  			const result = task.validate();
287  			if (!result.canApply) {
288  				return result;
289  			}
290  		}
291  		return { canApply: true };
292  	}
293  
294  	async apply(reason?: TextModelEditSource): Promise<readonly URI[]> {
295  
296  		this._validateBeforePrepare();
297  		const tasks = await this._createEditsTasks();
298  
299  		try {
300  			if (this._token.isCancellationRequested) {
301  				return [];
302  			}
303  
304  			const resources: URI[] = [];
305  			const validation = this._validateTasks(tasks);
306  			if (!validation.canApply) {
307  				throw new Error(`${validation.reason.toString()} has changed in the meantime`);
308  			}
309  			if (tasks.length === 1) {
310  				// This edit touches a single model => keep things simple
311  				const task = tasks[0];
312  				if (!task.isNoOp()) {
313  					const singleModelEditStackElement = new SingleModelEditStackElement(this._label, this._code, task.model, task.getBeforeCursorState());
314  					this._undoRedoService.pushElement(singleModelEditStackElement, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource);
315  					task.apply(reason);
316  					singleModelEditStackElement.close();
317  					resources.push(task.model.uri);
318  				}
319  				this._progress.report(undefined);
320  			} else {
321  				// prepare multi model undo element
322  				const multiModelEditStackElement = new MultiModelEditStackElement(
323  					this._label,
324  					this._code,
325  					tasks.map(t => new SingleModelEditStackElement(this._label, this._code, t.model, t.getBeforeCursorState()))
326  				);
327  				this._undoRedoService.pushElement(multiModelEditStackElement, this._undoRedoGroup, this._undoRedoSource);
328  				for (const task of tasks) {
329  					task.apply();
330  					this._progress.report(undefined);
331  					resources.push(task.model.uri);
332  				}
333  				multiModelEditStackElement.close();
334  			}
335  
336  			return resources;
337  
338  		} finally {
339  			dispose(tasks);
340  		}
341  	}
342  }

290  	private onSearchCompleted(completed: ISearchComplete | undefined, duration: number, searchInstanceID: string, ai: boolean): ISearchComplete | undefined {
291  		if (!this._searchQuery) {

301  		}

303  		this.searchResult.setCachedSearchComplete(completed, ai);
304  
305  		const options: IPatternInfo = Object.assign({}, this._searchQuery.contentPattern);

311  		const fileSchemeOnly = this._searchQuery.folderQueries.every(fq => fq.folder.scheme === Schemas.file);
312  		const otherSchemeOnly = this._searchQuery.folderQueries.every(fq => fq.folder.scheme !== Schemas.file);

155  	private doSearch(query: ITextQuery, progressEmitter: Emitter<void>, searchQuery: ITextQuery, searchInstanceID: string, onProgress?: (result: ISearchProgressItem) => void, callerToken?: CancellationToken): {
156  		asyncResults: Promise<ISearchComplete>;
157  		syncResults: IFileMatch<URI>[];
158  	} {
159  		const asyncGenerateOnProgress = async (p: ISearchProgressItem) => {
160  			progressEmitter.fire();
161  			this.onSearchProgress(p, searchInstanceID, false, false);
162  			onProgress?.(p);
163  		};
164  
165  		const syncGenerateOnProgress = (p: ISearchProgressItem) => {
166  			progressEmitter.fire();
167  			this.onSearchProgress(p, searchInstanceID, true);
168  			onProgress?.(p);
169  		};
170  		const tokenSource = this.currentCancelTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource(callerToken);
171  
172  		const notebookResult = this.notebookSearchService.notebookSearch(query, tokenSource.token, searchInstanceID, asyncGenerateOnProgress);
173  		const textResult = this.searchService.textSearchSplitSyncAsync(
174  			searchQuery,
175  			tokenSource.token, asyncGenerateOnProgress,
176  			notebookResult.openFilesToScan,
177  			notebookResult.allScannedFiles,
178  		);
179  
180  		const syncResults = textResult.syncResults.results;
181  		syncResults.forEach(p => { if (p) { syncGenerateOnProgress(p); } });
182  
183  		const getAsyncResults = async (): Promise<ISearchComplete> => {
184  			const searchStart = Date.now();
185  
186  			// resolve async parts of search
187  			const allClosedEditorResults = await textResult.asyncResults;
188  			const resolvedNotebookResults = await notebookResult.completeData;
189  			const searchLength = Date.now() - searchStart;
190  			const resolvedResult: ISearchComplete = {
191  				results: [...allClosedEditorResults.results, ...resolvedNotebookResults.results],
192  				messages: [...allClosedEditorResults.messages, ...resolvedNotebookResults.messages],
193  				limitHit: allClosedEditorResults.limitHit || resolvedNotebookResults.limitHit,
194  				exit: allClosedEditorResults.exit,
195  				stats: allClosedEditorResults.stats,
196  			};
197  			this.logService.trace(`whole search time | ${searchLength}ms`);
198  			return resolvedResult;
199  		};
200  		return {
201  			asyncResults: getAsyncResults()
202  				.finally(() => tokenSource.dispose(true)),
203  			syncResults
204  		};
205  	}
206  
207  	get hasAIResults(): boolean {
208  		return !!(this.searchResult.getCachedSearchComplete(true)) || (!!this.currentAICancelTokenSource && !this.currentAICancelTokenSource.token.isCancellationRequested);
209  	}
210  
211  	get hasPlainResults(): boolean {
212  		return !!(this.searchResult.getCachedSearchComplete(false)) || (!!this.currentCancelTokenSource && !this.currentCancelTokenSource.token.isCancellationRequested);
213  	}

47  export class BulkCellEdits {
48  
49  	constructor(
50  		private readonly _undoRedoGroup: UndoRedoGroup,
51  		undoRedoSource: UndoRedoSource | undefined,
52  		private readonly _progress: IProgress<void>,
53  		private readonly _token: CancellationToken,
54  		private readonly _edits: ResourceNotebookCellEdit[],
55  		@IEditorService private readonly _editorService: IEditorService,
56  		@INotebookEditorModelResolverService private readonly _notebookModelService: INotebookEditorModelResolverService,
57  	) {
58  		this._edits = this._edits.map(e => {
59  			if (e.resource.scheme === CellUri.scheme) {
60  				const uri = CellUri.parse(e.resource)?.notebook;
61  				if (!uri) {
62  					throw new Error(`Invalid notebook URI: ${e.resource}`);
63  				}
64  
65  				return new ResourceNotebookCellEdit(uri, e.cellEdit, e.notebookVersionId, e.metadata);
66  			} else {
67  				return e;
68  			}
69  		});
70  	}
71  
72  	async apply(): Promise<readonly URI[]> {
73  		const resources: URI[] = [];
74  		const editsByNotebook = groupBy(this._edits, (a, b) => compare(a.resource.toString(), b.resource.toString()));
75  
76  		for (const group of editsByNotebook) {
77  			if (this._token.isCancellationRequested) {
78  				break;
79  			}
80  			const [first] = group;
81  			const ref = await this._notebookModelService.resolve(first.resource);
82  
83  			// check state
84  			if (typeof first.notebookVersionId === 'number' && ref.object.notebook.versionId !== first.notebookVersionId) {
85  				ref.dispose();
86  				throw new Error(`Notebook '${first.resource}' has changed in the meantime`);
87  			}
88  
89  			// apply edits
90  			const edits = group.map(entry => entry.cellEdit);
91  			const computeUndo = !ref.object.isReadonly();
92  			const editor = getNotebookEditorFromEditorPane(this._editorService.activeEditorPane);
93  			const initialSelectionState: ISelectionState | undefined = editor?.textModel?.uri.toString() === ref.object.notebook.uri.toString() ? {
94  				kind: SelectionStateType.Index,
95  				focus: editor.getFocus(),
96  				selections: editor.getSelections()
97  			} : undefined;
98  			ref.object.notebook.applyEdits(edits, true, initialSelectionState, () => undefined, this._undoRedoGroup, computeUndo);
99  			ref.dispose();
100  
101  			this._progress.report(undefined);
102  
103  			resources.push(first.resource);
104  		}
105  
106  		return resources;
107  	}
108  }

100  			this._edits = this._edits
101  				.map(this._transformSnippetStringToInsertText, this) // no editor -> no snippet mode
102  				.sort((a, b) => Range.compareRangesUsingStarts(a.range, b.range));
103  			this.model.pushEditOperations(null, this._edits, () => null, undefined, reason);
104  		}
105  		if (this._newEol !== undefined) {
106  			this.model.pushEOL(this._newEol);
107  		}
108  	}
109  
110  	protected _transformSnippetStringToInsertText(edit: ISingleSnippetEditOperation): ISingleSnippetEditOperation {
111  		// transform a snippet edit (and only those) into a normal text edit
112  		// for that we need to parse the snippet and get its actual text, e.g without placeholder
113  		// or variable syntaxes
114  		if (!edit.insertAsSnippet) {
115  			return edit;
116  		}
117  		if (!edit.text) {
118  			return edit;
119  		}
120  		const text = SnippetParser.asInsertText(edit.text);
121  		return { ...edit, insertAsSnippet: false, text };
122  	}
123  }

6  import { getLocation, JSONPath, parse, visit, Location } from 'jsonc-parser';

9  import { provideInstalledExtensionProposals } from './extensionsProposals';

11  
12  export function activate(context: vscode.ExtensionContext): void {
13  	//settings.json suggestions
14  	context.subscriptions.push(registerSettingsCompletions());
15  
16  	//extensions suggestions
17  	context.subscriptions.push(...registerExtensionsCompletions());
18  
19  	// launch.json variable suggestions
20  	context.subscriptions.push(registerVariableCompletions('**/launch.json'));
21  
22  	// task.json variable suggestions
23  	context.subscriptions.push(registerVariableCompletions('**/tasks.json'));
24  
25  	// Workspace file launch/tasks variable completions
26  	context.subscriptions.push(registerVariableCompletions('**/*.code-workspace'));
27  
28  	// keybindings.json/package.json context key suggestions
29  	context.subscriptions.push(registerContextKeyCompletions());
30  }
31  
32  function registerSettingsCompletions(): vscode.Disposable {
33  	return vscode.languages.registerCompletionItemProvider({ language: 'jsonc', pattern: '**/settings.json' }, {
34  		provideCompletionItems(document, position, token) {
35  			return new SettingsDocument(document).provideCompletionItems(position, token);
36  		}
37  	});
38  }
39  
40  function registerVariableCompletions(pattern: string): vscode.Disposable {
41  	return vscode.languages.registerCompletionItemProvider({ language: 'jsonc', pattern }, {
42  		provideCompletionItems(document, position, _token) {
43  			const location = getLocation(document.getText(), document.offsetAt(position));
44  			if (isCompletingInsidePropertyStringValue(document, location, position)) {
45  				if (document.fileName.endsWith('.code-workspace') && !isLocationInsideTopLevelProperty(location, ['launch', 'tasks'])) {
46  					return [];
47  				}
48  
49  				let range = document.getWordRangeAtPosition(position, /\$\{[^"\}]*\}?/);
50  				if (!range || range.start.isEqual(position) || range.end.isEqual(position) && document.getText(range).endsWith('}')) {
51  					range = new vscode.Range(position, position);
52  				}
53  
54  				return [
55  					{ label: 'workspaceFolder', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The path of the folder opened in VS Code") },
56  					{ label: 'workspaceFolderBasename', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The name of the folder opened in VS Code without any slashes (/)") },
57  					{ label: 'fileWorkspaceFolderBasename', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file workspace folder name without any slashes (/)") },
58  					{ label: 'relativeFile', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file relative to ${workspaceFolder}") },
59  					{ label: 'relativeFileDirname', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's dirname relative to ${workspaceFolder}") },
60  					{ label: 'file', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file") },
61  					{ label: 'cwd', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The task runner's current working directory on startup") },
62  					{ label: 'lineNumber', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current selected line number in the active file") },
63  					{ label: 'selectedText', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current selected text in the active file") },
64  					{ label: 'fileDirname', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's dirname") },
65  					{ label: 'fileDirnameBasename', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's folder name") },
66  					{ label: 'fileExtname', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's extension") },
67  					{ label: 'fileBasename', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's basename") },
68  					{ label: 'fileBasenameNoExtension', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The current opened file's basename with no file extension") },
69  					{ label: 'defaultBuildTask', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The name of the default build task. If there is not a single default build task then a quick pick is shown to choose the build task.") },
70  					{ label: 'pathSeparator', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The character used by the operating system to separate components in file paths. Is also aliased to '/'.") },
71  					{ label: 'extensionInstallFolder', detail: vscode.l10n.t("The path where an extension is installed."), param: 'publisher.extension' },
72  				].map(variable => ({
73  					label: `\${${variable.label}}`,
74  					range,
75  					insertText: variable.param ? new vscode.SnippetString(`\${${variable.label}:`).appendPlaceholder(variable.param).appendText('}') : (`\${${variable.label}}`),
76  					detail: variable.detail
77  				}));
78  			}
79  
80  			return [];
81  		}
82  	});
83  }
84  
85  function isCompletingInsidePropertyStringValue(document: vscode.TextDocument, location: Location, pos: vscode.Position) {
86  	if (location.isAtPropertyKey) {
87  		return false;
88  	}
89  	const previousNode = location.previousNode;
90  	if (previousNode && previousNode.type === 'string') {
91  		const offset = document.offsetAt(pos);
92  		return offset > previousNode.offset && offset < previousNode.offset + previousNode.length;
93  	}
94  	return false;
95  }
96  
97  function isLocationInsideTopLevelProperty(location: Location, values: string[]) {
98  	return values.includes(location.path[0] as string);
99  }
100  
101  interface IExtensionsContent {
102  	recommendations: string[];
103  }
104  
105  function registerExtensionsCompletions(): vscode.Disposable[] {
106  	return [registerExtensionsCompletionsInExtensionsDocument(), registerExtensionsCompletionsInWorkspaceConfigurationDocument()];
107  }
108  
109  function registerExtensionsCompletionsInExtensionsDocument(): vscode.Disposable {
110  	return vscode.languages.registerCompletionItemProvider({ pattern: '**/extensions.json' }, {
111  		provideCompletionItems(document, position, _token) {
112  			const location = getLocation(document.getText(), document.offsetAt(position));
113  			if (location.path[0] === 'recommendations') {
114  				const range = getReplaceRange(document, location, position);
115  				const extensionsContent = <IExtensionsContent>parse(document.getText());
116  				return provideInstalledExtensionProposals(extensionsContent && extensionsContent.recommendations || [], '', range, false);
117  			}
118  			return [];
119  		}
120  	});

6  import * as path from 'path';
7  import * as vscode from 'vscode';
8  import { DocumentSelector } from '../configuration/documentSelector';
9  import * as languageIds from '../configuration/languageIds';
10  import { API } from '../tsServer/api';
11  import type * as Proto from '../tsServer/protocol/protocol';
12  import * as typeConverters from '../typeConverters';
13  import { ClientCapability, ITypeScriptServiceClient } from '../typescriptService';
14  import { readUnifiedConfig } from '../utils/configuration';
15  import FileConfigurationManager from './fileConfigurationManager';
16  import { conditionalRegistration, requireSomeCapability } from './util/dependentRegistration';
17  import { LanguageDescription } from '../configuration/languageDescription';
18  
19  type RenameResponse = {
20  	readonly type: 'rename';
21  	readonly body: Proto.RenameResponseBody;
22  } | {
23  	readonly type: 'jsxLinkedEditing';
24  	readonly spans: readonly Proto.TextSpan[];
25  };
26  
27  class TypeScriptRenameProvider implements vscode.RenameProvider {
28  
29  	public constructor(
30  		private readonly language: LanguageDescription,
31  		private readonly client: ITypeScriptServiceClient,
32  		private readonly fileConfigurationManager: FileConfigurationManager
33  	) { }
34  
35  	public async prepareRename(
36  		document: vscode.TextDocument,
37  		position: vscode.Position,
38  		token: vscode.CancellationToken
39  	): Promise<vscode.Range | undefined> {
40  		const response = await this.execRename(document, position, token);
41  		if (!response) {
42  			return undefined;
43  		}
44  
45  		switch (response.type) {
46  			case 'rename': {
47  				const renameInfo = response.body.info;
48  				if (!renameInfo.canRename) {
49  					return Promise.reject<vscode.Range>(renameInfo.localizedErrorMessage);
50  				}
51  				return typeConverters.Range.fromTextSpan(renameInfo.triggerSpan);
52  			}
53  			case 'jsxLinkedEditing': {
54  				return response.spans
55  					.map(typeConverters.Range.fromTextSpan)
56  					.find(range => range.contains(position));
57  			}
58  		}
59  	}
60  
61  	public async provideRenameEdits(
62  		document: vscode.TextDocument,
63  		position: vscode.Position,
64  		newName: string,
65  		token: vscode.CancellationToken
66  	): Promise<vscode.WorkspaceEdit | undefined> {
67  		const file = this.client.toOpenTsFilePath(document);
68  		if (!file) {
69  			return undefined;
70  		}
71  
72  		const response = await this.execRename(document, position, token);
73  		if (!response || token.isCancellationRequested) {
74  			return undefined;
75  		}
76  
77  		switch (response.type) {
78  			case 'rename': {
79  				const renameInfo = response.body.info;
80  				if (!renameInfo.canRename) {
81  					return Promise.reject<vscode.WorkspaceEdit>(renameInfo.localizedErrorMessage);
82  				}
83  
84  				if (renameInfo.fileToRename) {
85  					const edits = await this.renameFile(renameInfo.fileToRename, renameInfo.fullDisplayName, newName, token);
86  					if (edits) {
87  						return edits;
88  					} else {
89  						return Promise.reject<vscode.WorkspaceEdit>(vscode.l10n.t("An error occurred while renaming file"));
90  					}
91  				}
92  
93  				return this.updateLocs(response.body.locs, newName);
94  			}
95  			case 'jsxLinkedEditing': {
96  				return this.updateLocs([{
97  					file,
98  					locs: response.spans.map((span): Proto.RenameTextSpan => ({ ...span })),
99  				}], newName);
100  			}
101  		}
102  	}
103  
104  	public async execRename(
105  		document: vscode.TextDocument,
106  		position: vscode.Position,
107  		token: vscode.CancellationToken
108  	): Promise<RenameResponse | undefined> {
109  		const file = this.client.toOpenTsFilePath(document);
110  		if (!file) {
111  			return undefined;
112  		}
113  
114  		// Prefer renaming matching jsx tag when available
115  		if (this.client.apiVersion.gte(API.v510) &&
116  			readUnifiedConfig<boolean>('preferences.renameMatchingJsxTags', true, { scope: document, fallbackSection: this.language.id }) &&
117  			this.looksLikePotentialJsxTagContext(document, position)
118  		) {
119  			const args = typeConverters.Position.toFileLocationRequestArgs(file, position);
120  			const response = await this.client.execute('linkedEditingRange', args, token);
121  			if (response.type !== 'response' || !response.body) {
122  				return undefined;
123  			}
124  
125  			return { type: 'jsxLinkedEditing', spans: response.body.ranges };
126  		}
127  
128  		const args: Proto.RenameRequestArgs = {
129  			...typeConverters.Position.toFileLocationRequestArgs(file, position),
130  			findInStrings: false,
131  			findInComments: false
132  		};
133  
134  		return this.client.interruptGetErr(async () => {
135  			this.fileConfigurationManager.ensureConfigurationForDocument(document, token);
136  			const response = await this.client.execute('rename', args, token);
137  			if (response.type !== 'response' || !response.body) {
138  				return undefined;
139  			}
140  			return { type: 'rename', body: response.body };

142  	}
143  
144  	private looksLikePotentialJsxTagContext(document: vscode.TextDocument, position: vscode.Position): boolean {
145  		if (![languageIds.typescriptreact, languageIds.javascript, languageIds.javascriptreact].includes(document.languageId)) {
146  			return false;
147  		}
148  
149  		const prefix = document.getText(new vscode.Range(position.line, 0, position.line, position.character));
150  		return /\<\/?\s*[\w\d_$.]*$/.test(prefix);
151  	}
152  
153  	private updateLocs(
154  		locations: ReadonlyArray<Proto.SpanGroup>,
155  		newName: string
156  	) {
157  		const edit = new vscode.WorkspaceEdit();
158  		for (const spanGroup of locations) {
159  			const resource = this.client.toResource(spanGroup.file);
160  			for (const textSpan of spanGroup.locs) {
161  				edit.replace(resource, typeConverters.Range.fromTextSpan(textSpan),
162  					(textSpan.prefixText || '') + newName + (textSpan.suffixText || ''));
163  			}
164  		}
165  		return edit;
166  	}
167  
168  	private async renameFile(
169  		fileToRename: string,
170  		fullDisplayName: string,
171  		newName: string,
172  		token: vscode.CancellationToken,
173  	): Promise<vscode.WorkspaceEdit | undefined> {
174  		// Make sure we preserve file extension if extension is unchanged or none provided
175  		if (!path.extname(newName)) {
176  			newName += path.extname(fileToRename);
177  		}
178  		else if (path.extname(newName) === path.extname(fullDisplayName)) {
179  			newName = newName.slice(0, newName.length - path.extname(newName).length) + path.extname(fileToRename);
180  		}
181  
182  		const dirname = path.dirname(fileToRename);
183  		const newFilePath = path.join(dirname, newName);
184  
185  		const args: Proto.GetEditsForFileRenameRequestArgs & { file: string } = {
186  			file: fileToRename,
187  			oldFilePath: fileToRename,
188  			newFilePath: newFilePath,
189  		};
190  		const response = await this.client.execute('getEditsForFileRename', args, token);
191  		if (response.type !== 'response' || !response.body) {
192  			return undefined;
193  		}
194  
195  		const edits = typeConverters.WorkspaceEdit.fromFileCodeEdits(this.client, response.body);
196  		edits.renameFile(vscode.Uri.file(fileToRename), vscode.Uri.file(newFilePath));
197  		return edits;
198  	}
199  }
200  
201  export function register(
202  	selector: DocumentSelector,
203  	language: LanguageDescription,
204  	client: ITypeScriptServiceClient,
205  	fileConfigurationManager: FileConfigurationManager,
206  ) {
207  	return conditionalRegistration([
208  		requireSomeCapability(client, ClientCapability.Semantic),
209  	], () => {
210  		return vscode.languages.registerRenameProvider(selector.semantic,
211  			new TypeScriptRenameProvider(language, client, fileConfigurationManager));
212  	});
213  }

157  	private openExternalWithString(session: vscode.DebugSession, captureString: string) {
158  		const args: ServerReadyAction = session.configuration.serverReadyAction;

160  		let uri;
161  		if (captureString === '') {

173  			const format = args.uriFormat || (/^[0-9]+$/.test(captureString) ? URI_PORT_FORMAT : URI_FORMAT);

175  			const s = format.split('%s');
176  			if (s.length !== 2) {

178  				vscode.window.showErrorMessage(errMsg, { modal: true }).then(_ => undefined);
179  				return;

181  			uri = util.format(format, captureString);

187  	private async openExternalWithUri(session: vscode.DebugSession, uri: string) {
188  
189  		const args: ServerReadyAction = session.configuration.serverReadyAction;
190  		switch (args.action || 'openExternally') {
191  
192  			case 'openExternally':
193  				await vscode.env.openExternal(vscode.Uri.parse(uri));
194  				break;
195  
196  			case 'openIntegratedBrowser':
197  				vscode.commands.executeCommand('workbench.action.browser.open', uri);
198  				break;
199  
200  			case 'debugWithChrome':
201  				await this.debugWithBrowser('pwa-chrome', session, uri);
202  				break;
203  
204  			case 'debugWithEdge':
205  				await this.debugWithBrowser('pwa-msedge', session, uri);
206  				break;
207  
208  			case 'startDebugging':
209  				if (args.config) {
210  					await this.startDebugSession(session, args.config.name, args.config);
211  				} else {
212  					await this.startDebugSession(session, args.name || 'unspecified');
213  				}
214  				break;
215  
216  			default:
217  				// not supported
218  				break;
219  		}
220  	}

222  	private async debugWithBrowser(type: string, session: vscode.DebugSession, uri: string) {
223  		const args = session.configuration.serverReadyAction as ServerReadyAction;
224  		if (!args.killOnServerStop) {
225  			await this.startBrowserDebugSession(type, session, uri);
226  			return;
227  		}
228  
229  		const trackerId = randomUUID();
230  		const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
231  		const newSessionPromise = this.catchStartedDebugSession(session => session.configuration._debugServerReadySessionId === trackerId, cts.token);
232  
233  		if (!await this.startBrowserDebugSession(type, session, uri, trackerId)) {
234  			cts.cancel();
235  			cts.dispose();
236  			return;
237  		}
238  
239  		const createdSession = await newSessionPromise;
240  		cts.dispose();
241  
242  		if (!createdSession) {
243  			return;
244  		}
245  
246  		const stopListener = this.onDidSessionStop(async () => {
247  			stopListener.dispose();
248  			this.disposables.delete(stopListener);
249  			await vscode.debug.stopDebugging(createdSession);
250  		});
251  		this.disposables.add(stopListener);
252  	}
253  
254  	private startBrowserDebugSession(type: string, session: vscode.DebugSession, uri: string, trackerId?: string) {
255  		return vscode.debug.startDebugging(session.workspaceFolder, {
256  			type,
257  			name: 'Browser Debug',
258  			request: 'launch',
259  			url: uri,
260  			webRoot: session.configuration.serverReadyAction.webRoot || WEB_ROOT,
261  			_debugServerReadySessionId: trackerId,
262  		});

24  export class RevertButtonsFeature extends Disposable {
25  	constructor(
26  		private readonly _editors: DiffEditorEditors,

28  		private readonly _options: DiffEditorOptions,
29  		private readonly _widget: DiffEditorWidget
30  	) {
31  		super();
32  
33  		this._register(autorunWithStore((reader, store) => {
34  			if (!this._options.shouldRenderOldRevertArrows.read(reader)) { return; }
35  			const model = this._diffModel.read(reader);
36  			const diff = model?.diff.read(reader);
37  			if (!model || !diff) { return; }
38  			if (model.movedTextToCompare.read(reader)) { return; }
39  
40  			const glyphWidgetsModified: IGlyphMarginWidget[] = [];
41  
42  			const selectedDiffs = this._selectedDiffs.read(reader);
43  			const selectedDiffsSet = new Set(selectedDiffs.map(d => d.mapping));
44  
45  			if (selectedDiffs.length > 0) {
46  				// The button to revert the selection
47  				const selections = this._editors.modifiedSelections.read(reader);
48  
49  				const btn = store.add(new RevertButton(
50  					selections[selections.length - 1].positionLineNumber,
51  					this._widget,
52  					selectedDiffs.flatMap(d => d.rangeMappings),
53  					true
54  				));
55  				this._editors.modified.addGlyphMarginWidget(btn);
56  				glyphWidgetsModified.push(btn);
57  			}
58  
59  			for (const m of diff.mappings) {
60  				if (selectedDiffsSet.has(m)) { continue; }
61  				if (!m.lineRangeMapping.modified.isEmpty && m.lineRangeMapping.innerChanges) {
62  					const btn = store.add(new RevertButton(
63  						m.lineRangeMapping.modified.startLineNumber,
64  						this._widget,
65  						m.lineRangeMapping,
66  						false
67  					));
68  					this._editors.modified.addGlyphMarginWidget(btn);
69  					glyphWidgetsModified.push(btn);
70  				}
71  			}
72  
73  			store.add(toDisposable(() => {
74  				for (const w of glyphWidgetsModified) {
75  					this._editors.modified.removeGlyphMarginWidget(w);
76  				}
77  			}));
78  		}));
79  	}
80  
81  	private readonly _selectedDiffs = derived(this, (reader) => {
82  		/** @description selectedDiffs */
83  		const model = this._diffModel.read(reader);
84  		const diff = model?.diff.read(reader);
85  		// Return `emptyArr` because it is a constant. [] is always a new array and would trigger a change.
86  		if (!diff) { return emptyArr; }
87  
88  		const selections = this._editors.modifiedSelections.read(reader);
89  		if (selections.every(s => s.isEmpty())) { return emptyArr; }
90  
91  		const selectedLineNumbers = new LineRangeSet(selections.map(s => LineRange.fromRangeInclusive(s)));
92  
93  		const selectedMappings = diff.mappings.filter(m =>
94  			m.lineRangeMapping.innerChanges && selectedLineNumbers.intersects(m.lineRangeMapping.modified)
95  		);
96  		const result = selectedMappings.map(mapping => ({
97  			mapping,
98  			rangeMappings: mapping.lineRangeMapping.innerChanges!.filter(
99  				c => selections.some(s => Range.areIntersecting(c.modifiedRange, s))
100  			)
101  		}));
102  		if (result.length === 0 || result.every(r => r.rangeMappings.length === 0)) { return emptyArr; }
103  		return result;
104  	});
105  }

50  	private readonly provider = new Map<string, IFileSystemProvider>();
51  
52  	registerProvider(scheme: string, provider: IFileSystemProvider): IDisposable {
53  		if (this.provider.has(scheme)) {
54  			throw new Error(`A filesystem provider for the scheme '${scheme}' is already registered.`);
55  		}
56  
57  		mark(`code/registerFilesystem/${scheme}`);
58  
59  		const providerDisposables = new DisposableStore();
60  
61  		// Add provider with event
62  		this.provider.set(scheme, provider);
63  		this._onDidChangeFileSystemProviderRegistrations.fire({ added: true, scheme, provider });
64  
65  		// Forward events from provider
66  		providerDisposables.add(provider.onDidChangeFile(changes => {
67  			const event = new FileChangesEvent(changes, !this.isPathCaseSensitive(provider));
68  
69  			// Always emit any event internally
70  			this.internalOnDidFilesChange.fire(event);
71  
72  			// Only emit uncorrelated events in the global `onDidFilesChange` event
73  			if (!event.hasCorrelation()) {
74  				this._onDidUncorrelatedFilesChange.fire(event);
75  			}
76  		}));
77  		if (typeof provider.onDidWatchError === 'function') {
78  			providerDisposables.add(provider.onDidWatchError(error => this._onDidWatchError.fire(new Error(error))));
79  		}
80  		providerDisposables.add(provider.onDidChangeCapabilities(() => this._onDidChangeFileSystemProviderCapabilities.fire({ provider, scheme })));
81  
82  		return toDisposable(() => {
83  			this._onDidChangeFileSystemProviderRegistrations.fire({ added: false, scheme, provider });
84  			this.provider.delete(scheme);
85  
86  			dispose(providerDisposables);
87  		});
88  	}

90  	getProvider(scheme: string): IFileSystemProvider | undefined {

92  	}

94  	async activateProvider(scheme: string): Promise<void> {
95  
96  		// Emit an event that we are about to activate a provider with the given scheme.
97  		// Listeners can participate in the activation by registering a provider for it.
98  		const joiners: Promise<void>[] = [];
99  		this._onWillActivateFileSystemProvider.fire({
100  			scheme,
101  			join(promise) {
102  				joiners.push(promise);
103  			},
104  		});
105  
106  		if (this.provider.has(scheme)) {
107  			return; // provider is already here so we can return directly
108  		}
109  
110  		// If the provider is not yet there, make sure to join on the listeners assuming
111  		// that it takes a bit longer to register the file system provider.
112  		await Promises.settled(joiners);
113  	}

116

119  
120  		return this.hasProvider(resource);
121  	}

131  	}

388  			if (enforcedAtomicWrite) {

395  			// validate write (this may already return a peeked-at buffer)
396  			let { stat, buffer: bufferOrReadableOrStreamOrBufferedStream } = await this.validateWriteFile(provider, resource, bufferOrReadableOrStream, writeFileOptions);

398  			// mkdir recursively as needed

70  /// Implements the vscode "server of servers". Clients who go to the URI get
71  /// served the latest version of the VS Code server whenever they load the
72  /// page. The VS Code server prefixes all assets and connections it loads with
73  /// its version string, so existing clients can continue to get served even
74  /// while new clients get new VS Code Server versions.
75  pub async fn serve_web(ctx: CommandContext, mut args: ServeWebArgs) -> Result<i32, AnyError> {
76  	legal::require_consent(&ctx.paths, args.accept_server_license_terms)?;

78  	let platform: crate::update_service::Platform = PreReqChecker::new().verify().await?;

81  			let token = fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(p))
82  				.map_err(CodeError::CouldNotReadConnectionTokenFile)?;
83  			args.connection_token = Some(token.trim().to_string());
84  		} else {
85  			// Ensure there's a defined connection token, since if multiple server versions
86  			// are executed, they will need to have a single shared token.
87  			let token_path = ctx.paths.root().join("serve-web-token");
88  			let token = mint_connection_token(&token_path, args.connection_token.clone())
89  				.map_err(CodeError::CouldNotCreateConnectionTokenFile)?;
90  			args.connection_token = Some(token);
91  			args.connection_token_file = Some(token_path.to_string_lossy().to_string());
92  		}
93  	}
94  
95  	let cm: Arc<ConnectionManager> = ConnectionManager::new(&ctx, platform, args.clone());
96  	let update_check_interval = 3600;
97  	if args.commit_id.is_none() {
98  		cm.clone()
99  			.start_update_checker(Duration::from_secs(update_check_interval));
100  	} else {
101  		// If a commit was provided, invoke get_latest_release() once to ensure we're using that exact version;
102  		// get_latest_release() will short-circuit to args.commit_id.
103  		if let Err(e) = cm.get_latest_release().await {
104  			warning!(cm.log, "error getting latest version: {}", e);
105  		}
106  	}
107  
108  	let key = get_server_key_half(&ctx.paths);
109  
110  	let mut shutdown = ShutdownRequest::create_rx([ShutdownRequest::CtrlC]);
111  	if let Some(s) = args.socket_path {
112  		let s = PathBuf::from(&s);
113  		let mut socket = listen_socket_rw_stream(&s).await?;
114  		ctx.log
115  			.result(format!("Web UI available on {}", s.display()));
116  		loop {
117  			tokio::select! {
118  				result = socket.accept() => {
119  					let conn = match result {
120  						Ok(c) => c,
121  						Err(_) => continue,
122  					};

130  					});
131  				}
132  				_ = shutdown.wait() => break,
133  			}
134  		}
135  		let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&s); // cleanup
136  	} else {

138  			Some(h) => {
139  				SocketAddr::new(h.parse().map_err(CodeError::InvalidHostAddress)?, args.port)
140  			}
141  			None => SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST), args.port),
142  		};
143  		let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)
144  			.await

195  async fn handle(
196  	ctx: HandleContext,
197  	req: Request<Incoming>,
198  ) -> Result<Response<HyperBody>, Infallible> {
199  	let client_key_half = get_client_key_half(&req);
200  	let path = req.uri().path();
201  
202  	let mut res = if path.starts_with(&ctx.cm.base_path)
203  		&& path.get(ctx.cm.base_path.len()..).unwrap_or_default() == SECRET_KEY_MINT_PATH
204  	{
205  		handle_secret_mint(&ctx, req)
206  	} else {
207  		handle_proxied(&ctx, req).await
208  	};
209  
210  	append_secret_headers(&ctx.cm.base_path, &mut res, &client_key_half);
211  	append_frame_ancestors(&mut res);
212  
213  	Ok(res)
214  }
215  
216  async fn handle_proxied(ctx: &HandleContext, req: Request<Incoming>) -> Response<HyperBody> {
217  	let release = if let Some((r, _)) = get_release_from_path(req.uri().path(), ctx.cm.platform) {
218  		r
219  	} else {
220  		match ctx.cm.get_release_from_cache().await {
221  			Ok(r) => r,
222  			Err(e) => {
223  				error!(ctx.log, "error getting latest version: {}", e);
224  				return response::code_err(e);
225  			}
226  		}
227  	};
228  
229  	match ctx.cm.get_connection(release).await {
230  		Ok(rw) => {
231  			if req.headers().contains_key(::http::header::UPGRADE) {
232  				forward_ws_req_to_server(ctx.log.clone(), rw, req).await
233  			} else {
234  				forward_http_req_to_server(rw, req).await
235  			}
236  		}
237  		Err(CodeError::ServerNotYetDownloaded) => response::wait_for_download(),
238  		Err(e) => response::code_err(e),
239  	}
240  }
241  
242  fn handle_secret_mint(ctx: &HandleContext, req: Request<Incoming>) -> Response<HyperBody> {
243  	use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
244  
245  	let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
246  	hasher.update(ctx.server_secret_key.0.as_ref());
247  	hasher.update(get_client_key_half(&req).0.as_ref());
248  	let hash = hasher.finalize();
249  	let hash = hash[..SECRET_KEY_BYTES].to_vec();
250  	response::secret_key(hash)
251  }
252  
253  /// Appends headers to response to maintain the secret storage of the workbench:
254  /// sets the `PATH_COOKIE_VALUE` so workbench.ts knows about the 'mint' endpoint,
255  /// and maintains the http-only cookie the client will use for cookies.
256  fn append_secret_headers(
257  	base_path: &str,
258  	res: &mut Response<HyperBody>,
259  	client_key_half: &SecretKeyPart,
260  ) {
261  	let headers = res.headers_mut();
262  	headers.append(
263  		::http::header::SET_COOKIE,
264  		format!("{PATH_COOKIE_NAME}={base_path}{SECRET_KEY_MINT_PATH}; SameSite=Strict; Path=/",)
265  			.parse()
266  			.unwrap(),
267  	);
268  	headers.append(
269  		::http::header::SET_COOKIE,
270  		format!(
271  			"{}={}; SameSite=Strict; HttpOnly; Max-Age=2592000; Path=/",
272  			SECRET_KEY_COOKIE_NAME,
273  			client_key_half.encode()
274  		)
275  		.parse()
276  		.unwrap(),
277  	);
278  }
279  
280  /// Prevents other origins from embedding serve-web pages. Same-origin iframes
281  /// used by the workbench itself are still allowed.
282  fn append_frame_ancestors(res: &mut Response<HyperBody>) {
283  	let headers = res.headers_mut();
284  	headers.append(
285  		::http::header::CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY,
286  		"frame-ancestors 'self'".parse().unwrap(),
287  	);
288  	headers.insert(
289  		::http::header::HeaderName::from_static("x-frame-options"),
290  		"SAMEORIGIN".parse().unwrap(),
291  	);
292  }

158  	async completeMigration(expectedResources?: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
159  		return this._enqueueMutation(async () => {
160  			const catalog = this._requireCatalog();
161  			if (!this._isAutomationsEnabled()) {
162  				throw new Error('Automations must be enabled before migration can complete.');
163  			}
164  			if (this._migrationCompletedAt !== undefined) {
165  				return;
166  			}
167  			const missing = (expectedResources ?? catalog.entries.map(automation => automation.resource))
168  				.filter(resource => !catalog.entries.some(automation => automation.resource === resource));
169  			if (missing.length > 0) {
170  				throw new Error(`Automation migration is incomplete; ${missing.length} expected automation resources are missing.`);
171  			}
172  			const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
173  			// Set the completion marker before synthesizing operations so
174  			// `_canGrantRun` sees migration as complete. Roll back if persist
175  			// fails to preserve the pre-migration invariants.
176  			const priorCompletedAt = this._migrationCompletedAt;
177  			this._migrationCompletedAt = completedAt;
178  			let migratedCatalog: AutomationState;
179  			try {
180  				migratedCatalog = {
181  					...catalog,
182  					_meta: { ...catalog._meta, [AGENT_HOST_AUTOMATION_CATALOG_MIGRATED_META_KEY]: true },
183  					entries: catalog.entries.map(automation => ({
184  						...automation,
185  						operations: this._migrationOperationsForItem(automation),
186  					})),
187  				};
188  				await this._persist(migratedCatalog, this._runs, this._manualRunRequests, completedAt);
189  			} catch (error) {
190  				this._migrationCompletedAt = priorCompletedAt;
191  				throw error;
192  			}
193  			this._catalog = migratedCatalog;
194  			this._stateManager.setAutomationCatalogState(migratedCatalog);
195  			for (const automation of migratedCatalog.entries) {
196  				this._stateManager.dispatchServerAction(AUTOMATION_CATALOG_URI, { type: ActionType.AutomationSet, automation });
197  			}
198  			this._logService.info(`[AgentHostAutomationService] Automation migration completed: discovered=${expectedResources?.length ?? migratedCatalog.entries.length}, automations=${migratedCatalog.entries.length}, runs=${this._runs.size}.`);
199  			this._recoverRuns();
200  			this._scheduleNext();
201  		});
202  	}

204  	private _migrationOperationsForItem(automation: AutomationEntry): AutomationOperation[] {
205  		if (!this._canGrantRun(automation.definition)) {
206  			// Pending imports or disabled automations must not receive Run or
207  			// Remove: the browser scheduler still owns the legacy row until the
208  			// pending flag clears.
209  			return automation.operations.filter(op => op !== AutomationOperation.Run && op !== AutomationOperation.Remove);
210  		}
211  		return automation.runs.some(run => !isTerminalLifecycle(run.lifecycle))
212  			? withOperation(automation.operations, AutomationOperation.Run).filter(operation => operation !== AutomationOperation.Remove)
213  			: withOperation(withOperation(automation.operations, AutomationOperation.Run), AutomationOperation.Remove);
214  	}

216  	private _canGrantRun(definition: AutomationDefinition): boolean {
217  		return this._migrationCompletedAt !== undefined
218  			&& this._isAutomationsEnabled()
219  			&& !isAgentHostLegacyAutomationImportPending(definition);
220  	}

431  	private async _cancelRun(resource: string, outcome: 'cancelled' | 'timeout'): Promise<void> {
432  		const cancellation = { outcome };
433  		try {
434  			const sessions = await this._enqueueMutation(() => this._prepareCancellation(resource, cancellation));
435  			if (sessions.length === 0) {
436  				return;
437  			}
438  			const results = await Promise.allSettled(sessions.map(session => this._execution.cancelSession(URI.parse(session))));
439  			let accepted = false;
440  			for (const result of results) {
441  				if (result.status === 'rejected') {
442  					throw result.reason;
443  				}
444  				accepted ||= result.value;
445  			}
446  			if (!accepted) {
447  				const terminal = await this._enqueueMutation(async () => {
448  					const run = this._runs.get(resource);
449  					return run === undefined || isTerminalLifecycle(run.lifecycle);
450  				});
451  				if (!terminal) {
452  					throw new Error(`Automation run cancellation was not accepted: ${resource}`);
453  				}
454  			}
455  		} catch (error) {
456  			if (this._cancellations.get(resource) === cancellation) {
457  				this._cancellations.delete(resource);
458  			}
459  			throw error;
460  		}
461  	}

463  	private _load(): IStoredAutomations | undefined {
464  		if (this._storageService.loadError) {
465  			this._logService.error('[AgentHostAutomationService] Agent Host storage failed to load; automation state and execution remain unavailable.');
466  			return undefined;
467  		}
468  		const stored = this._storageService.get<IStoredAutomations>(STORAGE_KEY);
469  		if (stored === undefined) {
470  			return { catalog: { automations: [] } };
471  		}
472  		if (!isStoredAutomations(stored)) {
473  			this._logService.error('[AgentHostAutomationService] Automation storage is invalid; automation execution remains unavailable until it is recovered.');
474  			return undefined;
475  		}
476  		return stored;
477  	}

493  			...(migrationCompletedAt ? { migration: { status: 'complete', completedAt: migrationCompletedAt } } : {}),
494  		});

565  	private async _claimDueRuns(): Promise<readonly { readonly run: AutomationRunState; readonly definition: AutomationDefinition }[]> {
566  		const catalog = this._requireAvailableCatalog();
567  		const now = new Date();
568  		const nowTimestamp = now.getTime();
569  		const createdAt = now.toISOString();
570  		let nextCatalog = catalog;
571  		const nextRuns = new Map(this._runs);
572  		const changed = new Map<string, AutomationEntry>();
573  		const claimed: { run: AutomationRunState; definition: AutomationDefinition }[] = [];
574  
575  		for (const current of catalog.entries) {
576  			if (!current.definition.enabled) {
577  				continue;
578  			}
579  			if (!current.operations.includes(AutomationOperation.Run)) {
580  				continue;
581  			}
582  			if (this._activeRunFor(current.resource)) {
583  				continue;
584  			}
585  			if (!this._execution.isSessionTemplateAvailable(current.definition.session)) {
586  				continue;
587  			}
588  			const cursors = { ...readScheduleCursors(current._meta) };
589  			let automation = current;
590  			let claimedForAutomation = false;
591  			for (const trigger of current.definition.triggers) {
592  				if (trigger.kind !== AutomationTriggerKind.Schedule) {
593  					continue;
594  				}
595  				let scheduledFor = cursors[trigger.id] ? new Date(cursors[trigger.id]) : undefined;
596  				if (!scheduledFor || !Number.isFinite(scheduledFor.getTime())) {
597  					scheduledFor = nextAutomationCronOccurrence(trigger.schedule.expression, trigger.schedule.timeZone, now);
598  				} else if (scheduledFor.getTime() <= nowTimestamp) {
599  					const catchUp = nowTimestamp - scheduledFor.getTime() >= 60_000;
600  					if (!catchUp || trigger.misfirePolicy !== AutomationMisfirePolicy.Skip) {
601  						if (!claimedForAutomation) {
602  							const run = this._createRunState(automation.resource, {
603  								kind: AutomationRunOriginKind.Trigger,
604  								triggerId: trigger.id,
605  								scheduledFor: scheduledFor.toISOString(),
606  								...(catchUp ? { catchUp: true } : {}),
607  							}, createdAt);
608  							nextRuns.set(run.resource, run);
609  							automation = withRunSummary(automation, nextRuns);
610  							claimed.push({ run, definition: automation.definition });
611  							claimedForAutomation = true;
612  						}
613  						// A sibling trigger already claimed this Automation this
614  						// tick. Coalesce this past-due firing into the earlier
615  						// one and let its cursor roll forward below, so we don't
616  						// re-fire on the next tick.
617  					}
618  					scheduledFor = nextAutomationCronOccurrence(trigger.schedule.expression, trigger.schedule.timeZone, now);
619  				}
620  				cursors[trigger.id] = scheduledFor.toISOString();
621  			}
622  			const nextAutomation: AutomationEntry = {
623  				...automation,
624  				nextRunAt: earliestCursor(cursors),
625  				_meta: withScheduleCursors(automation._meta, cursors),
626  			};
627  			if (!equals(nextAutomation, current)) {
628  				nextCatalog = automationReducer(nextCatalog, { type: ActionType.AutomationSet, automation: nextAutomation }, this._log);
629  				changed.set(nextAutomation.resource, nextAutomation);
630  			}
631  		}
632

682  	private async _createManualRun(params: RunAutomationParams): Promise<{ readonly run: AutomationRunState; readonly definition?: AutomationDefinition }> {
683  		const catalog = this._requireAvailableCatalog();
684  		if (params.requestId.trim().length === 0) {
685  			throw new Error('Automation run requestId must not be empty.');
686  		}
687  		const previousRequest = this._manualRunRequests.get(params.requestId);
688  		if (previousRequest) {
689  			if (previousRequest.automation !== params.automation) {
690  				throw new Error(`Automation run requestId is already used for another automation: ${params.requestId}`);
691  			}
692  			const previousRun = this._runs.get(previousRequest.run);
693  			if (!previousRun) {
694  				throw new Error(`Automation run requestId refers to a missing run: ${params.requestId}`);
695  			}
696  			return { run: previousRun };
697  		}
698  
699  		const automation = catalog.entries.find(candidate => candidate.resource === params.automation);
700  		if (!automation) {
701  			throw new Error(`Automation not found: ${params.automation}`);
702  		}
703  		this._requireOperation(automation, AutomationOperation.Run);
704  		const activeRun = this._activeRunFor(automation.resource);
705  		if (activeRun) {
706  			return { run: activeRun };
707  		}
708  		const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
709  		const run = this._createRunState(automation.resource, { kind: AutomationRunOriginKind.Manual }, createdAt);
710  		const nextCatalog = this._catalogWithRun(catalog, run);
711  		const nextRuns = new Map(this._runs);
712  		nextRuns.set(run.resource, run);
713  		const nextRequests = new Map(this._manualRunRequests);
714  		nextRequests.set(params.requestId, { requestId: params.requestId, automation: params.automation, run: run.resource });
715  		await this._persist(nextCatalog, nextRuns, nextRequests);
716  		this._catalog = nextCatalog;
717  		this._runs = nextRuns;
718  		this._manualRunRequests = nextRequests;
719  		this._stateManager.setAutomationRunState(run);
720  		this._publishAutomation(nextCatalog, automation.resource);
721  		logAutomationRunCreated(this._telemetryService, {
722  			...this._runTelemetry(run),
723  			...this._configurationTelemetry(automation.definition.session),
724  		});
725  		this._logService.info(`[AgentHostAutomationService] Created durable manual automation run: automation=${automation.resource}, run=${run.resource}.`);
726  		return { run, definition: automation.definition };
727  	}

732  			automation,

84  	public $shellIntegrationChange(instanceId: number, supportsExecuteCommandApi: boolean): void {
85  		const terminal = this._extHostTerminalService.getTerminalById(instanceId);
86  		if (!terminal) {
87  			return;
88  		}
89  
90  		const apiTerminal = terminal.value;
91  		let shellIntegration = this._activeShellIntegrations.get(instanceId);
92  		if (!shellIntegration) {
93  			shellIntegration = new InternalTerminalShellIntegration(terminal.value, supportsExecuteCommandApi, this._onDidStartTerminalShellExecution);
94  			this._activeShellIntegrations.set(instanceId, shellIntegration);
95  			shellIntegration.store.add(terminal.onWillDispose(() => this._activeShellIntegrations.get(instanceId)?.dispose()));
96  			shellIntegration.store.add(shellIntegration.onDidRequestShellExecution(commandLine => this._proxy.$executeCommand(instanceId, commandLine)));
97  			shellIntegration.store.add(shellIntegration.onDidRequestEndExecution(e => this._onDidEndTerminalShellExecution.fire(e)));
98  			shellIntegration.store.add(shellIntegration.onDidRequestChangeShellIntegration(e => this._onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration.fire(e)));
99  			terminal.shellIntegration = shellIntegration.value;
100  		}
101  		this._onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration.fire({
102  			terminal: apiTerminal,
103  			shellIntegration: shellIntegration.value
104  		});
105  	}

108  		// Force shellIntegration creation if it hasn't been created yet, this could when events
109  		// don't come through on startup
110  		if (!this._activeShellIntegrations.has(instanceId)) {
111  			this.$shellIntegrationChange(instanceId, supportsExecuteCommandApi);
112  		}
113  		const commandLine: vscode.TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine = {
114  			value: commandLineValue,
115  			confidence: commandLineConfidence,
116  			isTrusted
117  		};

119  	}

147  	private _convertCwdToUri(cwd: string | undefined): URI | undefined {
148  		// IMPORTANT: cwd is provided to the exthost as a string from the renderer and only
149  		// converted to a URI on the machine in which the pty is hosted on. The string version of
150  		// the cwd is used from the renderer such that it's access is synchronous and its event
151  		// comes through in order relative to other shell integration events.
152  		return cwd ? URI.file(cwd) : undefined;

351  		for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {

358  	setCwd(cwd: URI | undefined): void {
359  		let wasChanged = false;
360  		if (URI.isUri(this._cwd)) {
361  			wasChanged = !URI.isUri(cwd) || this._cwd.toString() !== cwd.toString();
362  		} else if (this._cwd !== cwd) {
363  			wasChanged = true;
364  		}
365  		if (wasChanged) {

367  			this._fireChangeEvent();
