6  import { onUnexpectedError } from '../../../base/common/errors.js';
7  import { dispose, DisposableMap } from '../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
8  import { URI, UriComponents } from '../../../base/common/uri.js';
9  import { EditOperation } from '../../../editor/common/core/editOperation.js';
10  import { Range } from '../../../editor/common/core/range.js';
11  import { ITextModel } from '../../../editor/common/model.js';
12  import { IEditorWorkerService } from '../../../editor/common/services/editorWorker.js';
13  import { IModelService } from '../../../editor/common/services/model.js';
14  import { ILanguageService } from '../../../editor/common/languages/language.js';
15  import { ITextModelService } from '../../../editor/common/services/resolverService.js';
16  import { extHostNamedCustomer, IExtHostContext } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
17  import { ExtHostContext, ExtHostDocumentContentProvidersShape, MainContext, MainThreadDocumentContentProvidersShape } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';
18  import { CancellationTokenSource } from '../../../base/common/cancellation.js';
19  
20  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadDocumentContentProviders)
21  export class MainThreadDocumentContentProviders implements MainThreadDocumentContentProvidersShape {
22  
23  	private readonly _resourceContentProvider = new DisposableMap<number>();
24  	private readonly _pendingUpdate = new Map<string, CancellationTokenSource>();
25  	private readonly _proxy: ExtHostDocumentContentProvidersShape;
26  
27  	constructor(
28  		extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
29  		@ITextModelService private readonly _textModelResolverService: ITextModelService,
30  		@ILanguageService private readonly _languageService: ILanguageService,
31  		@IModelService private readonly _modelService: IModelService,
32  		@IEditorWorkerService private readonly _editorWorkerService: IEditorWorkerService
33  	) {
34  		this._proxy = extHostContext.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostDocumentContentProviders);
35  	}
36  
37  	dispose(): void {
38  		this._resourceContentProvider.dispose();
39  		dispose(this._pendingUpdate.values());
40  	}
41  
42  	$registerTextContentProvider(handle: number, scheme: string): void {
43  		const registration = this._textModelResolverService.registerTextModelContentProvider(scheme, {
44  			provideTextContent: (uri: URI): Promise<ITextModel | null> => {
45  				return this._proxy.$provideTextDocumentContent(handle, uri).then(value => {
46  					if (typeof value === 'string') {
47  						const firstLineText = value.substr(0, 1 + value.search(/\r?\n/));
48  						const languageSelection = this._languageService.createByFilepathOrFirstLine(uri, firstLineText);
49  						return this._modelService.createModel(value, languageSelection, uri);
50  					}
51  					return null;
52  				});
53  			}
54  		});
55  		this._resourceContentProvider.set(handle, registration);
56  	}
57  
58  	$unregisterTextContentProvider(handle: number): void {
59  		this._resourceContentProvider.deleteAndDispose(handle);
60  	}
61  
62  	async $onVirtualDocumentChange(uri: UriComponents, value: string): Promise<void> {
63  		const model = this._modelService.getModel(URI.revive(uri));
64  		if (!model) {
65  			return;
66  		}
67  
68  		// cancel and dispose an existing update
69  		const pending = this._pendingUpdate.get(model.id);
70  		pending?.cancel();
71  
72  		// create and keep update token
73  		const myToken = new CancellationTokenSource();
74  		this._pendingUpdate.set(model.id, myToken);
75  
76  		try {
77  			const edits = await this._editorWorkerService.computeMoreMinimalEdits(model.uri, [{ text: value, range: model.getFullModelRange() }]);
78  
79  			// remove token
80  			this._pendingUpdate.delete(model.id);
81  
82  			if (myToken.token.isCancellationRequested) {
83  				// ignore this
84  				return;
85  			}
86  
87  			if (model.isDisposed()) {
88  				// model was disposed during the async operation
89  				return;
90  			}
91  			if (edits && edits.length > 0) {
92  				// use the evil-edit as these models show in readonly-editor only
93  				model.applyEdits(edits.map(edit => EditOperation.replace(Range.lift(edit.range), edit.text)));
94  			}
95  		} catch (error) {
96  			onUnexpectedError(error);
97  		}
98  	}
99  }

6  import { onUnexpectedError } from '../../../base/common/errors.js';
7  import { URI, UriComponents } from '../../../base/common/uri.js';
8  import { IDisposable } from '../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
9  import { Disposable } from './extHostTypes.js';
10  import type * as vscode from 'vscode';
11  import { MainContext, ExtHostDocumentContentProvidersShape, MainThreadDocumentContentProvidersShape, IMainContext } from './extHost.protocol.js';
12  import { ExtHostDocumentsAndEditors } from './extHostDocumentsAndEditors.js';
13  import { Schemas } from '../../../base/common/network.js';
14  import { ILogService } from '../../../platform/log/common/log.js';
15  import { CancellationToken } from '../../../base/common/cancellation.js';
16  import { splitLines } from '../../../base/common/strings.js';
17  
18  export class ExtHostDocumentContentProvider implements ExtHostDocumentContentProvidersShape {
19  
20  	private static _handlePool = 0;
21  
22  	private readonly _documentContentProviders = new Map<number, vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider>();
23  	private readonly _proxy: MainThreadDocumentContentProvidersShape;
24  
25  	constructor(
26  		mainContext: IMainContext,
27  		private readonly _documentsAndEditors: ExtHostDocumentsAndEditors,
28  		private readonly _logService: ILogService,
29  	) {
30  		this._proxy = mainContext.getProxy(MainContext.MainThreadDocumentContentProviders);
31  	}
32  
33  	registerTextDocumentContentProvider(scheme: string, provider: vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider): vscode.Disposable {
34  		// todo@remote
35  		// check with scheme from fs-providers!
36  		if (Object.keys(Schemas).indexOf(scheme) >= 0) {
37  			throw new Error(`scheme '${scheme}' already registered`);
38  		}
39  
40  		const handle = ExtHostDocumentContentProvider._handlePool++;
41  
42  		this._documentContentProviders.set(handle, provider);
43  		this._proxy.$registerTextContentProvider(handle, scheme);
44  
45  		let subscription: IDisposable | undefined;
46  		if (typeof provider.onDidChange === 'function') {
47  
48  			let lastEvent: Promise<void> | undefined;
49  
50  			subscription = provider.onDidChange(async uri => {
51  				if (uri.scheme !== scheme) {
52  					this._logService.warn(`Provider for scheme '${scheme}' is firing event for schema '${uri.scheme}' which will be IGNORED`);
53  					return;
54  				}
55  				if (!this._documentsAndEditors.getDocument(uri)) {
56  					// ignore event if document isn't open
57  					return;
58  				}
59  
60  				if (lastEvent) {
61  					await lastEvent;
62  				}
63  
64  				const thisEvent = this.$provideTextDocumentContent(handle, uri)
65  					.then(async value => {
66  						if (!value && typeof value !== 'string') {
67  							return;
68  						}
69  
70  						const document = this._documentsAndEditors.getDocument(uri);
71  						if (!document) {
72  							// disposed in the meantime
73  							return;
74  						}
75  
76  						// create lines and compare
77  						const lines = splitLines(value);
78  
79  						// broadcast event when content changed
80  						if (!document.equalLines(lines)) {
81  							return this._proxy.$onVirtualDocumentChange(uri, value);
82  						}
83  					})
84  					.catch(onUnexpectedError)
85  					.finally(() => {
86  						if (lastEvent === thisEvent) {
87  							lastEvent = undefined;
88  						}
89  					});
90  
91  				lastEvent = thisEvent;
92  			});
93  		}
94  		return new Disposable(() => {
95  			if (this._documentContentProviders.delete(handle)) {
96  				this._proxy.$unregisterTextContentProvider(handle);
97  			}
98  			if (subscription) {
99  				subscription.dispose();
100  				subscription = undefined;
101  			}
102  		});
103  	}
104  
105  	$provideTextDocumentContent(handle: number, uri: UriComponents): Promise<string | null | undefined> {
106  		const provider = this._documentContentProviders.get(handle);
107  		if (!provider) {
108  			return Promise.reject(new Error(`unsupported uri-scheme: ${uri.scheme}`));
109  		}
110  		return Promise.resolve(provider.provideTextDocumentContent(URI.revive(uri), CancellationToken.None));
111  	}
112  }

12  import { TimelineChangeEvent, TimelineOptions, TimelineProviderDescriptor, ITimelineService, Timeline } from '../../contrib/timeline/common/timeline.js';
13  import { revive } from '../../../base/common/marshalling.js';
14  
15  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadTimeline)
16  export class MainThreadTimeline implements MainThreadTimelineShape {
17  	private readonly _proxy: ExtHostTimelineShape;
18  	private readonly _providerEmitters = new Map<string, Emitter<TimelineChangeEvent>>();
19  
20  	constructor(
21  		context: IExtHostContext,
22  		@ILogService private readonly logService: ILogService,
23  		@ITimelineService private readonly _timelineService: ITimelineService
24  	) {
25  		this._proxy = context.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostTimeline);
26  	}
27  
28  	$registerTimelineProvider(provider: TimelineProviderDescriptor): void {
29  		this.logService.trace(`MainThreadTimeline#registerTimelineProvider: id=${provider.id}`);
30  
31  		const proxy = this._proxy;
32  
33  		const emitters = this._providerEmitters;
34  		let onDidChange = emitters.get(provider.id);
35  		if (onDidChange === undefined) {
36  			onDidChange = new Emitter<TimelineChangeEvent>();
37  			emitters.set(provider.id, onDidChange);
38  		}
39  
40  		this._timelineService.registerTimelineProvider({
41  			...provider,
42  			onDidChange: onDidChange.event,
43  			async provideTimeline(uri: URI, options: TimelineOptions, token: CancellationToken) {
44  				return revive<Timeline>(await proxy.$getTimeline(provider.id, uri, options, token));
45  			},
46  			dispose() {
47  				emitters.delete(provider.id);
48  				onDidChange?.dispose();
49  			}
50  		});
51  	}
52  
53  	$unregisterTimelineProvider(id: string): void {
54  		this.logService.trace(`MainThreadTimeline#unregisterTimelineProvider: id=${id}`);
55  
56  		this._timelineService.unregisterTimelineProvider(id);
57  	}
58  
59  	$emitTimelineChangeEvent(e: TimelineChangeEvent): void {
60  		this.logService.trace(`MainThreadTimeline#emitChangeEvent: id=${e.id}, uri=${e.uri?.toString(true)}`);
61  
62  		const emitter = this._providerEmitters.get(e.id);
63  		emitter?.fire(e);
64  	}
65  
66  	dispose(): void {
67  		// noop
68  	}
69  }

6  import { Action } from '../../../base/common/actions.js';
7  import { isCancellationError } from '../../../base/common/errors.js';
8  import { Disposable } from '../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
9  import { Schemas } from '../../../base/common/network.js';
10  import { URI } from '../../../base/common/uri.js';
11  import { localize } from '../../../nls.js';
12  import { ExtensionIdentifier } from '../../../platform/extensions/common/extensions.js';
13  import { INotificationService, Severity } from '../../../platform/notification/common/notification.js';
14  import { IOpenerService } from '../../../platform/opener/common/opener.js';
15  import { IStorageService } from '../../../platform/storage/common/storage.js';
16  import { ExtHostContext, ExtHostUriOpenersShape, MainContext, MainThreadUriOpenersShape } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';
17  import { defaultExternalUriOpenerId } from '../../contrib/externalUriOpener/common/configuration.js';
18  import { ContributedExternalUriOpenersStore } from '../../contrib/externalUriOpener/common/contributedOpeners.js';
19  import { IExternalOpenerProvider, IExternalUriOpener, IExternalUriOpenerService } from '../../contrib/externalUriOpener/common/externalUriOpenerService.js';
20  import { IExtensionService } from '../../services/extensions/common/extensions.js';
21  import { extHostNamedCustomer, IExtHostContext } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
22  
23  interface RegisteredOpenerMetadata {
24  	readonly schemes: ReadonlySet<string>;
25  	readonly extensionId: ExtensionIdentifier;
26  	readonly label: string;
27  }
28  
29  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadUriOpeners)
30  export class MainThreadUriOpeners extends Disposable implements MainThreadUriOpenersShape, IExternalOpenerProvider {
31  
32  	private readonly proxy: ExtHostUriOpenersShape;
33  	private readonly _registeredOpeners = new Map<string, RegisteredOpenerMetadata>();
34  	private readonly _contributedExternalUriOpenersStore: ContributedExternalUriOpenersStore;
35  
36  	constructor(
37  		context: IExtHostContext,
38  		@IStorageService storageService: IStorageService,
39  		@IExternalUriOpenerService externalUriOpenerService: IExternalUriOpenerService,
40  		@IExtensionService private readonly extensionService: IExtensionService,
41  		@IOpenerService private readonly openerService: IOpenerService,
42  		@INotificationService private readonly notificationService: INotificationService,
43  	) {
44  		super();
45  		this.proxy = context.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostUriOpeners);
46  
47  		this._register(externalUriOpenerService.registerExternalOpenerProvider(this));
48  
49  		this._contributedExternalUriOpenersStore = this._register(new ContributedExternalUriOpenersStore(storageService, extensionService));
50  	}
51  
52  	public async *getOpeners(targetUri: URI): AsyncIterable<IExternalUriOpener> {
53  
54  		// Currently we only allow openers for http and https urls
55  		if (targetUri.scheme !== Schemas.http && targetUri.scheme !== Schemas.https) {
56  			return;
57  		}
58  
59  		await this.extensionService.activateByEvent(`onOpenExternalUri:${targetUri.scheme}`);
60  
61  		for (const [id, openerMetadata] of this._registeredOpeners) {
62  			if (openerMetadata.schemes.has(targetUri.scheme)) {
63  				yield this.createOpener(id, openerMetadata);
64  			}
65  		}
66  	}
67  
68  	private createOpener(id: string, metadata: RegisteredOpenerMetadata): IExternalUriOpener {
69  		return {
70  			id: id,
71  			label: metadata.label,
72  			canOpen: (uri, token) => {
73  				return this.proxy.$canOpenUri(id, uri, token);
74  			},
75  			openExternalUri: async (uri, ctx, token) => {
76  				try {
77  					await this.proxy.$openUri(id, { resolvedUri: uri, sourceUri: ctx.sourceUri }, token);
78  				} catch (e) {
79  					if (!isCancellationError(e)) {
80  						const openDefaultAction = new Action('default', localize('openerFailedUseDefault', "Open using default opener"), undefined, undefined, async () => {
81  							await this.openerService.open(uri, {
82  								allowTunneling: false,
83  								allowContributedOpeners: defaultExternalUriOpenerId,
84  							});
85  						});
86  						openDefaultAction.tooltip = uri.toString();
87  
88  						this.notificationService.notify({
89  							severity: Severity.Error,
90  							message: localize({
91  								key: 'openerFailedMessage',
92  								comment: ['{0} is the id of the opener. {1} is the url being opened.'],
93  							}, 'Could not open uri with \'{0}\': {1}', id, e.toString()),
94  							actions: {
95  								primary: [
96  									openDefaultAction
97  								]
98  							}
99  						});
100  					}
101  				}
102  				return true;
103  			},
104  		};
105  	}
106  
107  	async $registerUriOpener(
108  		id: string,
109  		schemes: readonly string[],
110  		extensionId: ExtensionIdentifier,
111  		label: string,
112  	): Promise<void> {
113  		if (this._registeredOpeners.has(id)) {
114  			throw new Error(`Opener with id '${id}' already registered`);
115  		}
116  
117  		this._registeredOpeners.set(id, {
118  			schemes: new Set(schemes),
119  			label,
120  			extensionId,
121  		});
122  
123  		this._contributedExternalUriOpenersStore.didRegisterOpener(id, extensionId.value);
124  	}
125  
126  	async $unregisterUriOpener(id: string): Promise<void> {
127  		this._registeredOpeners.delete(id);
128  		this._contributedExternalUriOpenersStore.delete(id);
129  	}
130  
131  	override dispose(): void {
132  		super.dispose();
133  		this._registeredOpeners.clear();
134  	}
135  }
136

6  import { raceCancellation } from '../../../base/common/async.js';
7  import { Emitter, Event } from '../../../base/common/event.js';
8  import { DisposableStore, IDisposable } from '../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
9  import { ILogService } from '../../../platform/log/common/log.js';
10  import { ExtHostContext, ExtHostSpeechShape, MainContext, MainThreadSpeechShape } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';
11  import { IKeywordRecognitionEvent, ISpeechProviderMetadata, ISpeechService, ISpeechToTextEvent, ITextToSpeechEvent, TextToSpeechStatus } from '../../contrib/speech/common/speechService.js';
12  import { IExtHostContext, extHostNamedCustomer } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
13  
14  type SpeechToTextSession = {
15  	readonly onDidChange: Emitter<ISpeechToTextEvent>;
16  };
17  
18  type TextToSpeechSession = {
19  	readonly onDidChange: Emitter<ITextToSpeechEvent>;
20  };
21  
22  type KeywordRecognitionSession = {
23  	readonly onDidChange: Emitter<IKeywordRecognitionEvent>;
24  };
25  
26  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadSpeech)
27  export class MainThreadSpeech implements MainThreadSpeechShape {
28  
29  	private readonly proxy: ExtHostSpeechShape;
30  
31  	private readonly providerRegistrations = new Map<number, IDisposable>();
32  
33  	private readonly speechToTextSessions = new Map<number, SpeechToTextSession>();
34  	private readonly textToSpeechSessions = new Map<number, TextToSpeechSession>();
35  	private readonly keywordRecognitionSessions = new Map<number, KeywordRecognitionSession>();
36  
37  	constructor(
38  		extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
39  		@ISpeechService private readonly speechService: ISpeechService,
40  		@ILogService private readonly logService: ILogService
41  	) {
42  		this.proxy = extHostContext.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostSpeech);
43  	}
44  
45  	$registerProvider(handle: number, identifier: string, metadata: ISpeechProviderMetadata): void {
46  		this.logService.trace('[Speech] extension registered provider', metadata.extension.value);
47  
48  		const registration = this.speechService.registerSpeechProvider(identifier, {
49  			metadata,
50  			createSpeechToTextSession: (token, options) => {
51  				if (token.isCancellationRequested) {
52  					return {
53  						onDidChange: Event.None
54  					};
55  				}
56  
57  				const disposables = new DisposableStore();
58  				const session = Math.random();
59  
60  				this.proxy.$createSpeechToTextSession(handle, session, options?.language);
61  
62  				const onDidChange = disposables.add(new Emitter<ISpeechToTextEvent>());
63  				this.speechToTextSessions.set(session, { onDidChange });
64  
65  				disposables.add(token.onCancellationRequested(() => {
66  					this.proxy.$cancelSpeechToTextSession(session);
67  					this.speechToTextSessions.delete(session);
68  					disposables.dispose();
69  				}));
70  
71  				return {
72  					onDidChange: onDidChange.event
73  				};
74  			},
75  			createTextToSpeechSession: (token, options) => {
76  				if (token.isCancellationRequested) {
77  					return {
78  						onDidChange: Event.None,
79  						synthesize: async () => { }
80  					};
81  				}
82  
83  				const disposables = new DisposableStore();
84  				const session = Math.random();
85  
86  				this.proxy.$createTextToSpeechSession(handle, session, options?.language);
87  
88  				const onDidChange = disposables.add(new Emitter<ITextToSpeechEvent>());
89  				this.textToSpeechSessions.set(session, { onDidChange });
90  
91  				disposables.add(token.onCancellationRequested(() => {
92  					this.proxy.$cancelTextToSpeechSession(session);
93  					this.textToSpeechSessions.delete(session);
94  					disposables.dispose();
95  				}));
96  
97  				return {
98  					onDidChange: onDidChange.event,
99  					synthesize: async text => {
100  						await this.proxy.$synthesizeSpeech(session, text);
101  						const disposable = new DisposableStore();
102  						try {
103  							await raceCancellation(Event.toPromise(Event.filter(onDidChange.event, e => e.status === TextToSpeechStatus.Stopped, disposable), disposable), token);
104  						} finally {
105  							disposable.dispose();
106  						}
107  					}
108  				};
109  			},
110  			createKeywordRecognitionSession: token => {
111  				if (token.isCancellationRequested) {
112  					return {
113  						onDidChange: Event.None
114  					};
115  				}
116  
117  				const disposables = new DisposableStore();
118  				const session = Math.random();
119  
120  				this.proxy.$createKeywordRecognitionSession(handle, session);
121  
122  				const onDidChange = disposables.add(new Emitter<IKeywordRecognitionEvent>());
123  				this.keywordRecognitionSessions.set(session, { onDidChange });
124  
125  				disposables.add(token.onCancellationRequested(() => {
126  					this.proxy.$cancelKeywordRecognitionSession(session);
127  					this.keywordRecognitionSessions.delete(session);
128  					disposables.dispose();
129  				}));
130  
131  				return {
132  					onDidChange: onDidChange.event
133  				};
134  			}
135  		});
136  		this.providerRegistrations.set(handle, {
137  			dispose: () => {
138  				registration.dispose();
139  			}
140  		});
141  	}
142  
143  	$unregisterProvider(handle: number): void {
144  		const registration = this.providerRegistrations.get(handle);
145  		if (registration) {
146  			registration.dispose();
147  			this.providerRegistrations.delete(handle);
148  		}
149  	}
150  
151  	$emitSpeechToTextEvent(session: number, event: ISpeechToTextEvent): void {
152  		const providerSession = this.speechToTextSessions.get(session);
153  		providerSession?.onDidChange.fire(event);
154  	}

5  
6  import { IMarkerService, IMarkerData, type IMarker } from '../../../platform/markers/common/markers.js';
7  import { URI, UriComponents } from '../../../base/common/uri.js';
8  import { MainThreadDiagnosticsShape, MainContext, ExtHostDiagnosticsShape, ExtHostContext } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';
9  import { extHostNamedCustomer, IExtHostContext } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
10  import { IDisposable } from '../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
11  import { IUriIdentityService } from '../../../platform/uriIdentity/common/uriIdentity.js';
12  import { ResourceMap } from '../../../base/common/map.js';
13  
14  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadDiagnostics)
15  export class MainThreadDiagnostics implements MainThreadDiagnosticsShape {
16  
17  	private readonly _activeOwners = new Set<string>();
18  
19  	private readonly _proxy: ExtHostDiagnosticsShape;
20  	private readonly _markerListener: IDisposable;
21  
22  	private static ExtHostCounter: number = 1;
23  	private readonly extHostId: string;
24  
25  	constructor(
26  		extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
27  		@IMarkerService private readonly _markerService: IMarkerService,
28  		@IUriIdentityService private readonly _uriIdentService: IUriIdentityService,
29  	) {
30  		this._proxy = extHostContext.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostDiagnostics);
31  
32  		this._markerListener = this._markerService.onMarkerChanged(this._forwardMarkers, this);
33  		this.extHostId = `extHost${MainThreadDiagnostics.ExtHostCounter++}`;
34  	}
35  
36  	dispose(): void {
37  		this._markerListener.dispose();
38  		for (const owner of this._activeOwners) {
39  			const markersData: ResourceMap<IMarker[]> = new ResourceMap<IMarker[]>();
40  			for (const marker of this._markerService.read({ owner })) {
41  				let data = markersData.get(marker.resource);
42  				if (data === undefined) {
43  					data = [];
44  					markersData.set(marker.resource, data);
45  				}
46  				if (marker.origin !== this.extHostId) {
47  					data.push(marker);
48  				}
49  			}
50  			for (const [resource, local] of markersData.entries()) {
51  				this._markerService.changeOne(owner, resource, local);
52  			}
53  		}
54  		this._activeOwners.clear();
55  	}
56  
57  	private _forwardMarkers(resources: readonly URI[]): void {
58  		const data: [UriComponents, IMarkerData[]][] = [];
59  		for (const resource of resources) {
60  			const allMarkerData = this._markerService.read({ resource, ignoreResourceFilters: true });
61  			const markerData = allMarkerData.filter(marker => marker.origin !== this.extHostId);
62  			data.push([resource, markerData]);
63  		}
64  		if (data.length > 0) {
65  			this._proxy.$acceptMarkersChange(data);
66  		}
67  	}
68  
69  	$changeMany(owner: string, entries: [UriComponents, IMarkerData[]][]): void {
70  		for (const entry of entries) {
71  			const [uri, markers] = entry;
72  			if (markers) {
73  				for (const marker of markers) {
74  					if (marker.relatedInformation) {
75  						for (const relatedInformation of marker.relatedInformation) {
76  							relatedInformation.resource = URI.revive(relatedInformation.resource);
77  						}
78  					}
79  					if (marker.code && typeof marker.code !== 'string') {
80  						marker.code.target = URI.revive(marker.code.target);
81  					}
82  					if (marker.origin === undefined) {
83  						marker.origin = this.extHostId;
84  					}
85  				}
86  			}
87  			this._markerService.changeOne(owner, this._uriIdentService.asCanonicalUri(URI.revive(uri)), markers);
88  		}
89  		this._activeOwners.add(owner);
90  	}
91  
92  	$clear(owner: string): void {
93  		this._markerService.changeAll(owner, []);
94  		this._activeOwners.delete(owner);
95  	}
96  }

6  import { IRange } from '../../../editor/common/core/range.js';
7  import { URI, UriComponents } from '../../../base/common/uri.js';
8  import { IEditorWorkerService } from '../../../editor/common/services/editorWorker.js';
9  import { IDocumentDiffLineChangeDto, IDocumentDiffResultDto, MainContext, MainThreadDocumentDiffShape } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';
10  import { extHostNamedCustomer, IExtHostContext } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
11  
12  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadDocumentDiff)
13  export class MainThreadDocumentDiff implements MainThreadDocumentDiffShape {
14  
15  	constructor(
16  		_extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
17  		@IEditorWorkerService private readonly _editorWorkerService: IEditorWorkerService,
18  	) {
19  	}
20  
21  	async $computeDocumentDiff(originalUri: UriComponents, modifiedUri: UriComponents, ignoreTrimWhitespace: boolean, maxComputationTimeMs: number, computeMoves: boolean): Promise<IDocumentDiffResultDto | null> {
22  		const original = URI.revive(originalUri);
23  		const modified = URI.revive(modifiedUri);
24  		const result = await this._editorWorkerService.computeDiff(original, modified, {
25  			ignoreTrimWhitespace,
26  			maxComputationTimeMs,
27  			computeMoves,
28  		}, 'advanced');
29  		if (!result) {
30  			return null;
31  		}
32  		const toLineRange = (r: { startLineNumber: number; endLineNumberExclusive: number }): IRange => ({
33  			startLineNumber: r.startLineNumber,
34  			startColumn: 1,
35  			endLineNumber: r.endLineNumberExclusive,
36  			endColumn: 1,
37  		});
38  
39  		const mapChange = (c: typeof result.changes[0]): IDocumentDiffLineChangeDto => ({
40  			originalRange: toLineRange(c.original),
41  			modifiedRange: toLineRange(c.modified),
42  			innerChanges: c.innerChanges?.map(ic => ({
43  				originalRange: ic.originalRange,
44  				modifiedRange: ic.modifiedRange,
45  			})),
46  		});
47  
48  		return {
49  			identical: result.identical,
50  			quitEarly: result.quitEarly,
51  			changes: result.changes.map(mapChange),
52  			moves: result.moves.map(m => ({
53  				originalRange: toLineRange(m.lineRangeMapping.original),
54  				modifiedRange: toLineRange(m.lineRangeMapping.modified),
55  				changes: m.changes.map(mapChange),
56  			})),
57  		};
58  	}
59  
60  	dispose(): void {
61  		// nothing to dispose
62  	}
63  }

16  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadDataChannels)
17  export class MainThreadDataChannels extends Disposable implements MainThreadDataChannelsShape {
18  
19  	private readonly _proxy: ExtHostDataChannelsShape;
20  	private readonly _linkPresentationWatchers = this._register(new DisposableMap<number>());
21  	private readonly _linkPresentationProviders = this._register(new DisposableMap<number>());
22  	private readonly _providedLinkPresentationWatchers = this._register(new DisposableMap<number, MainThreadExtensionLinkPresentationWatcher>());
23  	private static _providedLinkPresentationWatcherHandlePool = 0;
24  
25  	constructor(
26  		extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
27  		@IDataChannelService private readonly _dataChannelService: IDataChannelService,
28  		@ILinkPresentationService private readonly _linkPresentationService: ILinkPresentationService,
29  		@ILogService private readonly _logService: ILogService,
30  	) {
31  		super();
32  		this._proxy = extHostContext.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostDataChannels);
33  
34  		this._register(this._dataChannelService.onDidSendData(e => {
35  			this._proxy.$onDidReceiveData(e.channelId, e.data);
36  		}));
37  		const updateLinkPresentationRules = () => this._proxy.$acceptLinkPresentationRules(
38  			this._linkPresentationService.linkPresentationRules.map(rule => ({
39  				id: rule.id,
40  				source: rule.uriPattern.source,
41  				flags: rule.uriPattern.flags,
42  				kind: rule.kind,
43  			}))
44  		);
45  		updateLinkPresentationRules();
46  		this._register(this._linkPresentationService.onDidChangeLinkPresentationRules(updateLinkPresentationRules));
47  	}
48  
49  	$createLinkPresentationWatcher(handle: number, providerId: string, kind: LinkPresentationKind, resource: UriComponents): void {
50  		const watcher = this._linkPresentationService.createLinkPresentationWatcher(providerId, URI.revive(resource));
51  		if (!watcher) {
52  			this._logService.warn(`[MainThreadDataChannels] Link presentation provider '${providerId}' does not accept '${URI.revive(resource).toString(true)}'`);
53  			this._proxy.$acceptLinkPresentation(handle, {
54  				kind,
55  				status: { kind: 'error', label: localize('linkPresentation.unavailable', "Not available") },
56  				tooltip: localize('linkPresentation.ruleMismatch', "The selected link presentation provider does not accept this resource."),
57  				ariaLabel: localize('linkPresentation.unavailableAriaLabel', "Link presentation is not available"),
58  			});
59  			return;
60  		}
61  
62  		const store = new DisposableStore();
63  		store.add(autorun(reader => {
64  			const presentation = watcher.presentation.read(reader);
65  			if (presentation) {
66  				this._proxy.$acceptLinkPresentation(handle, presentation);
67  			}
68  		}));
69  		store.add(watcher);
70  		this._linkPresentationWatchers.set(handle, store);
71  	}
72  
73  	$disposeLinkPresentationWatcher(handle: number): void {
74  		this._linkPresentationWatchers.deleteAndDispose(handle);
75  	}
76  
77  	$registerLinkPresentationProvider(handle: number, extensionId: string, providerId: string): void {
78  		const provider: ILinkPresentationProvider = {
79  			createLinkPresentationWatcher: resource => this._createExtensionLinkPresentationWatcher(handle, resource),
80  		};
81  		this._linkPresentationProviders.set(
82  			handle,
83  			this._linkPresentationService.registerExtensionLinkPresentationProvider(extensionId, providerId, provider),
84  		);
85  	}
86  
87  	$unregisterLinkPresentationProvider(handle: number): void {
88  		this._linkPresentationProviders.deleteAndDispose(handle);
89  	}
90  
91  	$acceptLinkPresentationProviderData(handle: number, data: unknown): void {
92  		this._providedLinkPresentationWatchers.get(handle)?.acceptPresentation(data);
93  	}
94  
95  	private _createExtensionLinkPresentationWatcher(providerHandle: number, resource: URI): ILinkPresentationWatcher {
96  		const handle = MainThreadDataChannels._providedLinkPresentationWatcherHandlePool++;
97  		const watcher = new MainThreadExtensionLinkPresentationWatcher(() => {
98  			this._providedLinkPresentationWatchers.deleteAndLeak(handle);
99  			this._proxy.$disposeLinkPresentationWatcher(handle);
100  		});
101  		this._providedLinkPresentationWatchers.set(handle, watcher);
102  		void this._proxy.$createLinkPresentationWatcher(handle, providerHandle, resource).then(
103  			data => watcher.initializePresentation(data),
104  			error => {
105  				onUnexpectedError(error);
106  				watcher.initializePresentation({
107  					kind: 'resource',
108  					status: { kind: 'error', label: localize('linkPresentation.unavailable', "Not available") },
109  					tooltip: localize('linkPresentation.unavailableTooltip', "The link presentation provider failed to load."),
110  					ariaLabel: localize('linkPresentation.unavailableAriaLabel', "Link presentation is not available"),
111  				});
112  			},
113  		);
114  		return watcher;
115  	}
116  }
117  
118  class MainThreadExtensionLinkPresentationWatcher extends Disposable implements ILinkPresentationWatcher {
119  	private readonly _presentation = observableValue<ILinkPresentation | undefined>(this, undefined);
120  	readonly presentation = this._presentation;
121  	private _isDisposed = false;
122  
123  	constructor(private readonly _onDispose: () => void) {
124  		super();
125  	}
126  
127  	acceptPresentation(data: unknown): void {
128  		if (!this._isDisposed) {
129  			this._presentation.set(parseLinkPresentation(data), undefined);
130  		}
131  	}
132  
133  	initializePresentation(data: unknown): void {
134  		if (!this._isDisposed && !this._presentation.get()) {
135  			this.acceptPresentation(data);
136  		}
137  	}
138  
139  	override dispose(): void {
140  		if (this._isDisposed) {
141  			return;
142  		}
143  		this._isDisposed = true;
144  		super.dispose();
145  		this._onDispose();
146  	}
147  }

7  import { IEditorService } from '../../services/editor/common/editorService.js';
8  import { IExtHostContext, extHostNamedCustomer } from '../../services/extensions/common/extHostCustomers.js';
9  import { BrowserTabDto, ExtHostBrowsersShape, ExtHostContext, MainContext, MainThreadBrowsersShape } from '../common/extHost.protocol.js';

20  @extHostNamedCustomer(MainContext.MainThreadBrowsers)
21  export class MainThreadBrowsers extends Disposable implements MainThreadBrowsersShape {
22  
23  	private readonly _proxy: ExtHostBrowsersShape;
24  
25  	private readonly _cdpSessions = this._register(new DisposableMap<string, { groupId: string } & IDisposable>());
26  	private readonly _knownBrowsers = this._register(new DisposableMap<string, { input: BrowserEditorInput } & IDisposable>());
27  
28  	constructor(
29  		extHostContext: IExtHostContext,
30  		@IEditorService private readonly editorService: IEditorService,
31  		@IBrowserViewCDPService private readonly cdpService: IBrowserViewCDPService,
32  		@IBrowserViewWorkbenchService private readonly browserViewService: IBrowserViewWorkbenchService,
33  		@IEditorGroupsService private readonly editorGroupsService: IEditorGroupsService,
34  		@IConfigurationService private readonly configurationService: IConfigurationService,
35  	) {
36  		super();
37  		this._proxy = extHostContext.getProxy(ExtHostContext.ExtHostBrowsers);
38  
39  		// Track open browser editors via the workbench service
40  		this._register(this.browserViewService.onDidChangeBrowserViews(() => {
41  			for (const editor of this.browserViewService.getKnownBrowserViews().values()) {
42  				this._track(editor);
43  			}
44  		}));
45  		this._register(this.editorService.onDidActiveEditorChange(() => this._syncActiveBrowserTab()));
46  
47  		// Initial sync
48  		for (const editor of this.browserViewService.getKnownBrowserViews().values()) {
49  			this._track(editor);
50  		}
51  		this._syncActiveBrowserTab();
52  	}
53  
54  	// #region Browser tab open
55  
56  	async $openBrowserTab(url: string, viewColumn?: EditorGroupColumn, options?: IEditorOptions): Promise<BrowserTabDto> {
57  		const id = generateUuid();
58  		const browserUri = BrowserViewUri.forId(id);
59  
60  		await this.editorService.openEditor(
61  			{
62  				resource: browserUri,
63  				options: { ...options, viewState: { url } }
64  			},
65  			columnToEditorGroup(this.editorGroupsService, this.configurationService, viewColumn),
66  		);
67  		const known = this._knownBrowsers.get(id);
68  		if (!known) {
69  			throw new Error('Failed to open browser tab');
70  		}
71  
72  		return this._toDto(known.input);
73  	}
74  
75  	// #endregion
76  
77  	// #region Browser tab tracking
78  
79  	private _lastActiveBrowserId: string | undefined = undefined;
80  	private async _syncActiveBrowserTab(): Promise<void> {
81  		const active = this.editorService.activeEditorPane?.input;
82  		let activeId: string | undefined;
83  		if (active instanceof BrowserEditorInput) {
84  			this._track(active);
85  			activeId = active.id;
86  		}
87  		if (this._lastActiveBrowserId !== activeId) {
88  			this._lastActiveBrowserId = activeId;
89  			this._proxy.$onDidChangeActiveBrowserTab(activeId);
90  		}
91  	}
92  
93  	private _track(input: BrowserEditorInput): void {
94  		if (this._knownBrowsers.has(input.id)) {
95  			return;
96  		}
97  		const disposables = new DisposableStore();
98  
99  		// Track property changes. Currently all the tracked properties are covered under the `onDidChangeLabel` event.
100  		disposables.add(input.onDidChangeLabel(() => {
101  			this._proxy.$onDidChangeBrowserTabState(this._toDto(input));
102  		}));
103  		disposables.add(input.onWillDispose(() => {
104  			this._knownBrowsers.deleteAndDispose(input.id);
105  		}));
106  		disposables.add(toDisposable(() => {
107  			this._proxy.$onDidCloseBrowserTab(input.id);
108  		}));
109  
110  		this._knownBrowsers.set(input.id, { input, dispose: () => disposables.dispose() });
111  		this._proxy.$onDidOpenBrowserTab(this._toDto(input));
112  	}
113  
114  	private _toDto(input: BrowserEditorInput): BrowserTabDto {
115  		return {
116  			id: input.id,
117  			url: input.url || 'about:blank',
118  			title: input.getTitle(),
119  			favicon: input.favicon,
120  		};
121  	}
122  
123  	// #endregion
124  
125  	// #region CDP session management
126  
127  	async $startCDPSession(sessionId: string, browserId: string): Promise<void> {
128  		const known = this._knownBrowsers.get(browserId);
129  		if (!known) {
130  			throw new Error(`Unknown browser id: ${browserId}`);
131  		}
132  
133  		// Before starting a session, resolve the input to ensure the underlying web contents exist and can be attached.
134  		await known.input.resolve();
135  
136  		const groupId = await this.cdpService.createSessionGroup(browserId);
137  		const disposables = new DisposableStore();
138  
139  		// Wire CDP messages from main process back to ext host
140  		disposables.add(this.cdpService.onCDPMessage(groupId)(message => {
141  			this._proxy.$onCDPSessionMessage(sessionId, message);
142  		}));
143  		disposables.add(this.cdpService.onDidDestroy(groupId)(() => {
144  			this._cdpSessions.deleteAndDispose(sessionId);
145  		}));
146  		disposables.add(toDisposable(() => {
147  			this.cdpService.destroySessionGroup(groupId).catch(() => { });
148  			this._proxy.$onCDPSessionClosed(sessionId);
149  		}));
150  
151  		this._cdpSessions.set(sessionId, { groupId, dispose: () => disposables.dispose() });
152  	}
153  
154  	async $closeCDPSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
155  		this._cdpSessions.deleteAndDispose(sessionId);

34  class EmbeddingsService implements IEmbeddingsService {
35  	_serviceBrand: undefined;

37  	private providers: Map<string, IEmbeddingsProvider>;

39  	private readonly _onDidChange = new Emitter<void>();

42  	constructor() {

46  	get allProviders(): Iterable<string> {

50  	registerProvider(id: string, provider: IEmbeddingsProvider): IDisposable {
51  		this.providers.set(id, provider);

54  			dispose: () => {
55  				this.providers.delete(id);
56  				this._onDidChange.fire();
57  			}

59  	}

61  	computeEmbeddings(id: string, input: string[], token: CancellationToken): Promise<{ values: number[] }[]> {

1  /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2   *  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
3   *  Licensed under the MIT License. See License.txt in the project root for license information.
4   *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
5  
6  import { createDecorator } from '../../../../platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.js';
7  import { CancellationToken } from '../../../../base/common/cancellation.js';
8  import { CancelablePromise, createCancelablePromise, raceCancellablePromises, timeout } from '../../../../base/common/async.js';
9  import { IDisposable } from '../../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
10  import { InstantiationType, registerSingleton } from '../../../../platform/instantiation/common/extensions.js';
11  import { StopWatch } from '../../../../base/common/stopwatch.js';
12  import { ILogService } from '../../../../platform/log/common/log.js';
13  
14  export const IAiEmbeddingVectorService = createDecorator<IAiEmbeddingVectorService>('IAiEmbeddingVectorService');
15  
16  export interface IAiEmbeddingVectorService {
17  	readonly _serviceBrand: undefined;
18  
19  	isEnabled(): boolean;
20  	getEmbeddingVector(str: string, token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[]>;
21  	getEmbeddingVector(strings: string[], token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[][]>;
22  	registerAiEmbeddingVectorProvider(model: string, provider: IAiEmbeddingVectorProvider): IDisposable;
23  }
24  
25  export interface IAiEmbeddingVectorProvider {
26  	provideAiEmbeddingVector(strings: string[], token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[][]>;
27  }
28  
29  export class AiEmbeddingVectorService implements IAiEmbeddingVectorService {
30  	readonly _serviceBrand: undefined;
31  
32  	static readonly DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 1000 * 10; // 10 seconds
33  
34  	private readonly _providers: IAiEmbeddingVectorProvider[] = [];
35  
36  	constructor(@ILogService private readonly logService: ILogService) { }
37  
38  	isEnabled(): boolean {
39  		return this._providers.length > 0;
40  	}
41  
42  	registerAiEmbeddingVectorProvider(model: string, provider: IAiEmbeddingVectorProvider): IDisposable {
43  		this._providers.push(provider);
44  		return {
45  			dispose: () => {
46  				const index = this._providers.indexOf(provider);
47  				if (index >= 0) {
48  					this._providers.splice(index, 1);
49  				}
50  			}
51  		};
52  	}
53  
54  	getEmbeddingVector(str: string, token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[]>;
55  	getEmbeddingVector(strings: string[], token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[][]>;
56  	async getEmbeddingVector(strings: string | string[], token: CancellationToken): Promise<number[] | number[][]> {
57  		if (this._providers.length === 0) {
58  			throw new Error('No embedding vector providers registered');
59  		}
60  
61  		const stopwatch = StopWatch.create();
62  
63  		const cancellablePromises: Array<CancelablePromise<number[][]>> = [];
64  
65  		const timer = timeout(AiEmbeddingVectorService.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT);
66  		const disposable = token.onCancellationRequested(() => {
67  			disposable.dispose();
68  			timer.cancel();
69  		});
70  
71  		for (const provider of this._providers) {
72  			cancellablePromises.push(createCancelablePromise(async t => {
73  				try {
74  					return await provider.provideAiEmbeddingVector(
75  						Array.isArray(strings) ? strings : [strings],
76  						t
77  					);
78  				} catch (e) {
79  					// logged in extension host
80  				}
81  				// Wait for the timer to finish to allow for another provider to resolve.
82  				// Alternatively, if something resolved, or we've timed out, this will throw
83  				// as expected.
84  				await timer;
85  				throw new Error('Embedding vector provider timed out');
86  			}));
87  		}
88  
89  		cancellablePromises.push(createCancelablePromise(async (t) => {
90  			const disposable = t.onCancellationRequested(() => {
91  				timer.cancel();
92  				disposable.dispose();
93  			});
94  			await timer;
95  			throw new Error('Embedding vector provider timed out');
96  		}));
97  
98  		try {
99  			const result = await raceCancellablePromises(cancellablePromises);
100  
101  			// If we have a single result, return it directly, otherwise return an array.
102  			// This aligns with the API overloads.
103  			if (result.length === 1) {
104  				return result[0];
105  			}
106  			return result;
107  		} finally {
108  			stopwatch.stop();
109  			this.logService.trace(`[AiEmbeddingVectorService]: getEmbeddingVector took ${stopwatch.elapsed()}ms`);
110  		}
111  	}
112  }
113  
114  registerSingleton(IAiEmbeddingVectorService, AiEmbeddingVectorService, InstantiationType.Delayed);

5  
6  import { CancellationTokenSource } from '../../../../base/common/cancellation.js';
7  import { Emitter } from '../../../../base/common/event.js';
8  import { Disposable, DisposableMap, IDisposable } from '../../../../base/common/lifecycle.js';
9  import { URI } from '../../../../base/common/uri.js';
10  import { ILogService } from '../../../../platform/log/common/log.js';
11  import { ITimelineService, TimelineChangeEvent, TimelineOptions, TimelineProvidersChangeEvent, TimelineProvider, TimelinePaneId } from './timeline.js';
12  import { IViewsService } from '../../../services/views/common/viewsService.js';
13  import { IConfigurationService } from '../../../../platform/configuration/common/configuration.js';
14  import { IContextKey, IContextKeyService, RawContextKey } from '../../../../platform/contextkey/common/contextkey.js';
15  
16  export const TimelineHasProviderContext = new RawContextKey<boolean>('timelineHasProvider', false);
17  
18  export class TimelineService extends Disposable implements ITimelineService {
19  
20  	declare readonly _serviceBrand: undefined;
21  
22  	private readonly _onDidChangeProviders = this._register(new Emitter<TimelineProvidersChangeEvent>());
23  	readonly onDidChangeProviders = this._onDidChangeProviders.event;
24  
25  	private readonly _onDidChangeTimeline = this._register(new Emitter<TimelineChangeEvent>());
26  	readonly onDidChangeTimeline = this._onDidChangeTimeline.event;
27  
28  	private readonly _onDidChangeUri = this._register(new Emitter<URI>());
29  	readonly onDidChangeUri = this._onDidChangeUri.event;
30  
31  	private readonly hasProviderContext: IContextKey<boolean>;
32  	private readonly providers = new Map<string, TimelineProvider>();
33  	private readonly providerSubscriptions = this._register(new DisposableMap<string>());
34  
35  	constructor(
36  		@ILogService private readonly logService: ILogService,
37  		@IViewsService protected viewsService: IViewsService,
38  		@IConfigurationService protected configurationService: IConfigurationService,
39  		@IContextKeyService protected contextKeyService: IContextKeyService,
40  	) {
41  		super();
42  
43  		this.hasProviderContext = TimelineHasProviderContext.bindTo(this.contextKeyService);
44  		this.updateHasProviderContext();
45  	}
46  
47  	getSources() {
48  		return [...this.providers.values()].map(p => ({ id: p.id, label: p.label }));
49  	}
50  
51  	getTimeline(id: string, uri: URI, options: TimelineOptions, tokenSource: CancellationTokenSource) {
52  		this.logService.trace(`TimelineService#getTimeline(${id}): uri=${uri.toString()}`);
53  
54  		const provider = this.providers.get(id);
55  		if (provider === undefined) {
56  			return undefined;
57  		}
58  
59  		if (typeof provider.scheme === 'string') {
60  			if (provider.scheme !== '*' && provider.scheme !== uri.scheme) {
61  				return undefined;
62  			}
63  		} else if (!provider.scheme.includes(uri.scheme)) {
64  			return undefined;
65  		}
66  
67  		return {
68  			result: provider.provideTimeline(uri, options, tokenSource.token)
69  				.then(result => {
70  					if (result === undefined) {
71  						return undefined;
72  					}
73  
74  					result.items = result.items.map(item => ({ ...item, source: provider.id }));
75  					result.items.sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp - a.timestamp) || b.source.localeCompare(a.source, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
76  
77  					return result;
78  				}),
79  			options,
80  			source: provider.id,
81  			tokenSource,
82  			uri
83  		};
84  	}
85  
86  	registerTimelineProvider(provider: TimelineProvider): IDisposable {
87  		this.logService.trace(`TimelineService#registerTimelineProvider: id=${provider.id}`);
88  
89  		const id = provider.id;
90  
91  		const existing = this.providers.get(id);
92  		if (existing) {
93  			// For now to deal with https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/89553 allow any overwritting here (still will be blocked in the Extension Host)
94  			// TODO@eamodio: Ultimately will need to figure out a way to unregister providers when the Extension Host restarts/crashes
95  			// throw new Error(`Timeline Provider ${id} already exists.`);
96  			try {
97  				existing?.dispose();
98  			}
99  			catch { }
100  		}
101  
102  		this.providers.set(id, provider);
103  
104  		this.updateHasProviderContext();
105  
106  		if (provider.onDidChange) {
107  			this.providerSubscriptions.set(id, provider.onDidChange(e => this._onDidChangeTimeline.fire(e)));
108  		}
109  		this._onDidChangeProviders.fire({ added: [id] });
110  
111  		return {
112  			dispose: () => {
113  				this.providers.delete(id);
114  				this._onDidChangeProviders.fire({ removed: [id] });
115  			}
116  		};
117  	}
118  
119  	unregisterTimelineProvider(id: string): void {
120  		this.logService.trace(`TimelineService#unregisterTimelineProvider: id=${id}`);
121  
122  		if (!this.providers.has(id)) {
123  			return;
124  		}
125  
126  		this.providers.delete(id);
127  		this.providerSubscriptions.deleteAndDispose(id);
128  
129  		this.updateHasProviderContext();
130  
131  		this._onDidChangeProviders.fire({ removed: [id] });
132  	}
133  
134  	setUri(uri: URI) {
135  		this.viewsService.openView(TimelinePaneId, true);
136  		this._onDidChangeUri.fire(uri);
137  	}
138  
139  	private updateHasProviderContext() {
140  		this.hasProviderContext.set(this.providers.size !== 0);
141  	}
142  }

6  import { Octokit } from '@octokit/rest';
7  import * as vscode from 'vscode';
8  import { basename } from 'path';
9  import { agent } from './node/net';
10  
11  class GitHubGistProfileContentHandler implements vscode.ProfileContentHandler {
12  
13  	readonly name = vscode.l10n.t('GitHub');
14  	readonly description = vscode.l10n.t('gist');
15  
16  	private _octokit: Promise<Octokit> | undefined;
17  	private getOctokit(): Promise<Octokit> {
18  		if (!this._octokit) {
19  			this._octokit = (async () => {
20  				const session = await vscode.authentication.getSession('github', ['gist', 'user:email'], { createIfNone: true });
21  				const token = session.accessToken;
22  
23  				const { Octokit } = await import('@octokit/rest');
24  
25  				return new Octokit({
26  					request: { agent },
27  					userAgent: 'GitHub VSCode',
28  					auth: `token ${token}`
29  				});
30  			})();
31  		}
32  		return this._octokit;
33  	}
34  
35  	async saveProfile(name: string, content: string): Promise<{ readonly id: string; readonly link: vscode.Uri } | null> {
36  		const octokit = await this.getOctokit();
37  		const result = await octokit.gists.create({
38  			public: false,
39  			files: {
40  				[name]: {
41  					content
42  				}
43  			}
44  		});
45  		if (result.data.id && result.data.html_url) {
46  			const link = vscode.Uri.parse(result.data.html_url);
47  			return { id: result.data.id, link };
48  		}
49  		return null;
50  	}
51  
52  	private _public_octokit: Promise<Octokit> | undefined;
53  	private getPublicOctokit(): Promise<Octokit> {
54  		if (!this._public_octokit) {
55  			this._public_octokit = (async () => {
56  				const { Octokit } = await import('@octokit/rest');
57  				return new Octokit({ request: { agent }, userAgent: 'GitHub VSCode' });
58  			})();
59  		}
60  		return this._public_octokit;
61  	}
62  
63  	async readProfile(id: string): Promise<string | null>;
64  	async readProfile(uri: vscode.Uri): Promise<string | null>;
65  	async readProfile(arg: string | vscode.Uri): Promise<string | null> {
66  		const gist_id = typeof arg === 'string' ? arg : basename(arg.path);
67  		const octokit = await this.getPublicOctokit();
68  		try {
69  			const gist = await octokit.gists.get({ gist_id });
70  			if (gist.data.files) {
71  				return gist.data.files[Object.keys(gist.data.files)[0]]?.content ?? null;
72  			}
73  		} catch (error) {
74  			// ignore
75  		}
76  		return null;
77  	}
78  
79  }
80  
81  vscode.window.registerProfileContentHandler('github', new GitHubGistProfileContentHandler());

6  import * as vscode from 'vscode';
7  import { getLocation, Location, parse } from 'jsonc-parser';
8  import { provideInstalledExtensionProposals } from './extensionsProposals';
9  
10  const OVERRIDE_IDENTIFIER_REGEX = /\[([^\[\]]*)\]/g;
11  
12  export class SettingsDocument {
13  
14  	constructor(private document: vscode.TextDocument) { }
15  
16  	public async provideCompletionItems(position: vscode.Position, _token: vscode.CancellationToken): Promise<vscode.CompletionItem[] | vscode.CompletionList> {
17  		const location = getLocation(this.document.getText(), this.document.offsetAt(position));
18  
19  		// window.title
20  		if (location.path[0] === 'window.title') {
21  			return this.provideWindowTitleCompletionItems(location, position);
22  		}
23  
24  		// files.association
25  		if (location.path[0] === 'files.associations') {
26  			return this.provideFilesAssociationsCompletionItems(location, position);
27  		}
28  
29  		// files.exclude, search.exclude, explorer.autoRevealExclude
30  		if (location.path[0] === 'files.exclude' || location.path[0] === 'search.exclude' || location.path[0] === 'explorer.autoRevealExclude') {
31  			return this.provideExcludeCompletionItems(location, position);
32  		}
33  
34  		// files.defaultLanguage
35  		if (location.path[0] === 'files.defaultLanguage') {
36  			return this.provideLanguageCompletionItems(location, position);
37  		}
38  
39  		// workbench.editor.label
40  		if (location.path[0] === 'workbench.editor.label.patterns') {
41  			return this.provideEditorLabelCompletionItems(location, position);
42  		}
43  
44  		// settingsSync.ignoredExtensions
45  		if (location.path[0] === 'settingsSync.ignoredExtensions') {
46  			let ignoredExtensions = [];
47  			try {
48  				ignoredExtensions = parse(this.document.getText())['settingsSync.ignoredExtensions'];
49  			} catch (e) {/* ignore error */ }
50  			const range = this.getReplaceRange(location, position);
51  			return provideInstalledExtensionProposals(ignoredExtensions, '', range, true);
52  		}
53  
54  		// remote.extensionKind
55  		if (location.path[0] === 'remote.extensionKind' && location.path.length === 2 && location.isAtPropertyKey) {
56  			let alreadyConfigured: string[] = [];
57  			try {
58  				alreadyConfigured = Object.keys(parse(this.document.getText())['remote.extensionKind']);
59  			} catch (e) {/* ignore error */ }
60  			const range = this.getReplaceRange(location, position);
61  			return provideInstalledExtensionProposals(alreadyConfigured, location.previousNode ? '' : `: [\n\t"ui"\n]`, range, true);
62  		}
63  
64  		// remote.portsAttributes
65  		if (location.path[0] === 'remote.portsAttributes' && location.path.length === 2 && location.isAtPropertyKey) {
66  			return this.providePortsAttributesCompletionItem(this.getReplaceRange(location, position));
67  		}
68  
69  		return this.provideLanguageOverridesCompletionItems(location, position);
70  	}
71  
72  	private getReplaceRange(location: Location, position: vscode.Position) {
73  		const node = location.previousNode;
74  		if (node) {
75  			const nodeStart = this.document.positionAt(node.offset), nodeEnd = this.document.positionAt(node.offset + node.length);
76  			if (nodeStart.isBeforeOrEqual(position) && nodeEnd.isAfterOrEqual(position)) {
77  				return new vscode.Range(nodeStart, nodeEnd);
78  			}
79  		}
80  		return new vscode.Range(position, position);
81  	}
82  
83  	private isCompletingPropertyValue(location: Location, pos: vscode.Position) {
84  		if (location.isAtPropertyKey) {
85  			return false;
86  		}
87  		const previousNode = location.previousNode;
88  		if (previousNode) {
89  			const offset = this.document.offsetAt(pos);
90  			return offset >= previousNode.offset && offset <= previousNode.offset + previousNode.length;
91  		}
92  		return true;
93  	}
94  
95  	private async provideWindowTitleCompletionItems(location: Location, pos: vscode.Position): Promise<vscode.CompletionItem[]> {
96  		const completions: vscode.CompletionItem[] = [];
97  
98  		if (!this.isCompletingPropertyValue(location, pos)) {
99  			return completions;
100  		}
101  
102  		let range = this.document.getWordRangeAtPosition(pos, /\$\{[^"\}]*\}?/);
103  		if (!range || range.start.isEqual(pos) || range.end.isEqual(pos) && this.document.getText(range).endsWith('}')) {
104  			range = new vscode.Range(pos, pos);
105  		}
106  
107  		const getText = (variable: string) => {
108  			const text = '${' + variable + '}';
109  			return location.previousNode ? text : JSON.stringify(text);
110  		};
111  
112  
113  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeEditorShort'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the file name (e.g. myFile.txt)")));
114  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeEditorMedium'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the path of the file relative to the workspace folder (e.g. myFolder/myFileFolder/myFile.txt)")));
115  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeEditorLong'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the full path of the file (e.g. /Users/Development/myFolder/myFileFolder/myFile.txt)")));
116  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeFolderShort'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the name of the folder the file is contained in (e.g. myFileFolder)")));
117  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeFolderMedium'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the path of the folder the file is contained in, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. myFolder/myFileFolder)")));
118  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeFolderLong'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the full path of the folder the file is contained in (e.g. /Users/Development/myFolder/myFileFolder)")));
119  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('rootName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("name of the workspace with optional remote name and workspace indicator if applicable (e.g. myFolder, myRemoteFolder [SSH] or myWorkspace (Workspace))")));
120  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('rootNameShort'), range, vscode.l10n.t("shortened name of the workspace without suffixes (e.g. myFolder or myWorkspace)")));
121  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('rootPath'), range, vscode.l10n.t("file path of the workspace (e.g. /Users/Development/myWorkspace)")));
122  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('folderName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("name of the workspace folder the file is contained in (e.g. myFolder)")));
123  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('folderPath'), range, vscode.l10n.t("file path of the workspace folder the file is contained in (e.g. /Users/Development/myFolder)")));
124  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('appName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("e.g. VS Code")));
125  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('remoteName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("e.g. SSH")));
126  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('dirty'), range, vscode.l10n.t("an indicator for when the active editor has unsaved changes")));
127  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('separator'), range, vscode.l10n.t("a conditional separator (' - ') that only shows when surrounded by variables with values")));
128  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeRepositoryName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the name of the active repository (e.g. vscode)")));
129  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeRepositoryBranchName'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the name of the active branch in the active repository (e.g. main)")));
130  		completions.push(this.newSimpleCompletionItem(getText('activeEditorState'), range, vscode.l10n.t("the state of the active editor (e.g. modified).")));

23  class SelectionAnchorController implements IEditorContribution {
24  
25  	public static readonly ID = 'editor.contrib.selectionAnchorController';
26  
27  	static get(editor: ICodeEditor): SelectionAnchorController | null {

31  	private decorationId: string | undefined;
32  	private selectionAnchorSetContextKey: IContextKey<boolean>;
33  	private modelChangeListener: IDisposable;
34  
35  	constructor(
36  		private editor: ICodeEditor,
37  		@IContextKeyService contextKeyService: IContextKeyService
38  	) {
39  		this.selectionAnchorSetContextKey = SelectionAnchorSet.bindTo(contextKeyService);
40  		this.modelChangeListener = editor.onDidChangeModel(() => this.selectionAnchorSetContextKey.reset());
41  	}
42  
43  	setSelectionAnchor(): void {
44  		if (this.editor.hasModel()) {
45  			const position = this.editor.getPosition();
46  			this.editor.changeDecorations((accessor) => {
47  				if (this.decorationId) {
48  					accessor.removeDecoration(this.decorationId);
49  				}
50  				this.decorationId = accessor.addDecoration(
51  					Selection.fromPositions(position, position),
52  					{
53  						description: 'selection-anchor',
54  						stickiness: TrackedRangeStickiness.NeverGrowsWhenTypingAtEdges,
55  						hoverMessage: new MarkdownString().appendText(localize('selectionAnchor', "Selection Anchor")),
56  						className: 'selection-anchor'
57  					}
58  				);
59  			});
60  			this.selectionAnchorSetContextKey.set(!!this.decorationId);
61  			alert(localize('anchorSet', "Anchor set at {0}:{1}", position.lineNumber, position.column));
62  		}
63  	}
64  
65  	goToSelectionAnchor(): void {
66  		if (this.editor.hasModel() && this.decorationId) {
67  			const anchorPosition = this.editor.getModel().getDecorationRange(this.decorationId);
68  			if (anchorPosition) {
69  				this.editor.setPosition(anchorPosition.getStartPosition());
70  			}
71  		}
72  	}
73  
74  	selectFromAnchorToCursor(): void {
75  		if (this.editor.hasModel() && this.decorationId) {
76  			const start = this.editor.getModel().getDecorationRange(this.decorationId);
77  			if (start) {
78  				const end = this.editor.getPosition();
79  				this.editor.setSelection(Selection.fromPositions(start.getStartPosition(), end));
80  				this.cancelSelectionAnchor();
81  			}
82  		}
83  	}
84  
85  	cancelSelectionAnchor(): void {
86  		if (this.decorationId) {
87  			const decorationId = this.decorationId;
88  			this.editor.changeDecorations((accessor) => {
89  				accessor.removeDecoration(decorationId);
90  				this.decorationId = undefined;
91  			});
92  			this.selectionAnchorSetContextKey.set(false);
93  		}
94  	}
95  
96  	dispose(): void {
97  		this.cancelSelectionAnchor();
98  		this.modelChangeListener.dispose();
99  	}

23  	public equals(other: CursorState): boolean {
24  		const thisLen = this.selections.length;
25  		const otherLen = other.selections.length;
26  		if (thisLen !== otherLen) {
27  			return false;
28  		}
29  		for (let i = 0; i < thisLen; i++) {
30  			if (!this.selections[i].equalsSelection(other.selections[i])) {
31  				return false;
32  			}
33  		}
34  		return true;
35  	}
36  }

46  export class CursorUndoRedoController extends Disposable implements IEditorContribution {
47  
48  	public static readonly ID = 'editor.contrib.cursorUndoRedoController';
49  
50  	public static get(editor: ICodeEditor): CursorUndoRedoController | null {
51  		return editor.getContribution<CursorUndoRedoController>(CursorUndoRedoController.ID);
52  	}
53  
54  	private readonly _editor: ICodeEditor;
55  	private _isCursorUndoRedo: boolean;
56  
57  	private _undoStack: StackElement[];
58  	private _redoStack: StackElement[];
59  
60  	constructor(editor: ICodeEditor) {
61  		super();
62  		this._editor = editor;
63  		this._isCursorUndoRedo = false;
64  
65  		this._undoStack = [];
66  		this._redoStack = [];
67  
68  		this._register(editor.onDidChangeModel((e) => {
69  			this._undoStack = [];
70  			this._redoStack = [];
71  		}));
72  		this._register(editor.onDidChangeModelContent((e) => {
73  			this._undoStack = [];
74  			this._redoStack = [];
75  		}));
76  		this._register(editor.onDidChangeCursorSelection((e) => {
77  			if (this._isCursorUndoRedo) {
78  				return;
79  			}
80  			if (!e.oldSelections) {
81  				return;
82  			}
83  			if (e.oldModelVersionId !== e.modelVersionId) {
84  				return;
85  			}
86  			const prevState = new CursorState(e.oldSelections);
87  			const isEqualToLastUndoStack = (this._undoStack.length > 0 && this._undoStack[this._undoStack.length - 1].cursorState.equals(prevState));
88  			if (!isEqualToLastUndoStack) {
89  				this._undoStack.push(new StackElement(prevState, editor.getScrollTop(), editor.getScrollLeft()));
90  				this._redoStack = [];
91  				if (this._undoStack.length > 50) {
92  					// keep the cursor undo stack bounded
93  					this._undoStack.shift();
94  				}
95  			}
96  		}));
97  	}
98  
99  	public cursorUndo(): void {
100  		if (!this._editor.hasModel() || this._undoStack.length === 0) {
101  			return;
102  		}
103  
104  		this._redoStack.push(new StackElement(new CursorState(this._editor.getSelections()), this._editor.getScrollTop(), this._editor.getScrollLeft()));
105  		this._applyState(this._undoStack.pop()!);
106  	}
107  
108  	public cursorRedo(): void {
109  		if (!this._editor.hasModel() || this._redoStack.length === 0) {
110  			return;
111  		}
112  
113  		this._undoStack.push(new StackElement(new CursorState(this._editor.getSelections()), this._editor.getScrollTop(), this._editor.getScrollLeft()));
114  		this._applyState(this._redoStack.pop()!);
115  	}
116  
117  	private _applyState(stackElement: StackElement): void {
118  		this._isCursorUndoRedo = true;
119  		this._editor.setSelections(stackElement.cursorState.selections);
120  		this._editor.setScrollPosition({
121  			scrollTop: stackElement.scrollTop,
122  			scrollLeft: stackElement.scrollLeft
123  		});
124  		this._isCursorUndoRedo = false;
125  	}
126  }
127  
128  export class CursorUndo extends EditorAction {
129  	constructor() {
130  		super({
131  			id: 'cursorUndo',
132  			label: nls.localize2('cursor.undo', "Cursor Undo"),
133  			precondition: undefined,
134  			kbOpts: {
135  				kbExpr: EditorContextKeys.textInputFocus,
136  				primary: KeyMod.CtrlCmd | KeyCode.KeyU,
137  				weight: KeybindingWeight.EditorContrib
138  			}
139  		});
140  	}
141  
142  	public run(accessor: ServicesAccessor, editor: ICodeEditor, args: unknown): void {
143  		CursorUndoRedoController.get(editor)?.cursorUndo();
144  	}
145  }
146  
147  export class CursorRedo extends EditorAction {
148  	constructor() {
149  		super({
150  			id: 'cursorRedo',
151  			label: nls.localize2('cursor.redo', "Cursor Redo"),
152  			precondition: undefined
153  		});
154  	}
155  
156  	public run(accessor: ServicesAccessor, editor: ICodeEditor, args: unknown): void {
157  		CursorUndoRedoController.get(editor)?.cursorRedo();
158  	}
159  }
160  
161  registerEditorContribution(CursorUndoRedoController.ID, CursorUndoRedoController, EditorContributionInstantiation.Eager); // eager because it needs to listen to record cursor state ASAP
162  registerEditorAction(CursorUndo);
163  registerEditorAction(CursorRedo);

27  export class UnusualLineTerminatorsDetector extends Disposable implements IEditorContribution {
28  
29  	public static readonly ID = 'editor.contrib.unusualLineTerminatorsDetector';

31  	private _config: 'auto' | 'off' | 'prompt';
32  	private _isPresentingDialog: boolean = false;
33  
34  	constructor(
35  		private readonly _editor: ICodeEditor,
36  		@IDialogService private readonly _dialogService: IDialogService,
37  		@ICodeEditorService private readonly _codeEditorService: ICodeEditorService
38  	) {
39  		super();
40  
41  		this._config = this._editor.getOption(EditorOption.unusualLineTerminators);
42  		this._register(this._editor.onDidChangeConfiguration((e) => {
43  			if (e.hasChanged(EditorOption.unusualLineTerminators)) {
44  				this._config = this._editor.getOption(EditorOption.unusualLineTerminators);

48

51  		}));
52

54  			if (e.isUndoing) {
55  				// skip checking in case of undoing
56  				return;
57  			}
58  			this._checkForUnusualLineTerminators();
59  		}));
60  
61  		this._checkForUnusualLineTerminators();
62  	}
63  
64  	private async _checkForUnusualLineTerminators(): Promise<void> {
65  		if (this._config === 'off') {
66  			return;
67  		}
68  		if (!this._editor.hasModel()) {
69  			return;
70  		}
71  		const model = this._editor.getModel();
72  		if (!model.mightContainUnusualLineTerminators()) {
73  			return;
74  		}
75  		const ignoreState = readIgnoreState(this._codeEditorService, model);
76  		if (ignoreState === true) {
77  			// this model should be ignored
78  			return;
79  		}
80  		if (this._editor.getOption(EditorOption.readOnly)) {
81  			// read only editor => sorry!
82  			return;
83  		}
84  
85  		if (this._config === 'auto') {
86  			// just do it!
87  			model.removeUnusualLineTerminators(this._editor.getSelections());
88  			return;
89  		}
90  
91  		if (this._isPresentingDialog) {
92  			// we're currently showing the dialog, which is async.
93  			// avoid spamming the user
94  			return;
95  		}
96  
97  		let result: IConfirmationResult;
98  		try {
99  			this._isPresentingDialog = true;
100  			result = await this._dialogService.confirm({
101  				title: nls.localize('unusualLineTerminators.title', "Unusual Line Terminators"),
102  				message: nls.localize('unusualLineTerminators.message', "Detected unusual line terminators"),
103  				detail: nls.localize('unusualLineTerminators.detail', "The file '{0}' contains one or more unusual line terminator characters, like Line Separator (LS) or Paragraph Separator (PS).\n\nIt is recommended to remove them from the file. This can be configured via `editor.unusualLineTerminators`.", basename(model.uri)),
104  				primaryButton: nls.localize({ key: 'unusualLineTerminators.fix', comment: ['&& denotes a mnemonic'] }, "&&Remove Unusual Line Terminators"),
105  				cancelButton: nls.localize('unusualLineTerminators.ignore', "Ignore")
106  			});
107  		} finally {
108  			this._isPresentingDialog = false;
109  		}
110  
111  		if (!result.confirmed) {
112  			// this model should be ignored
113  			writeIgnoreState(this._codeEditorService, model, true);
114  			return;
115  		}
116  
117  		model.removeUnusualLineTerminators(this._editor.getSelections());
118  	}
119  }
120  
121  registerEditorContribution(UnusualLineTerminatorsDetector.ID, UnusualLineTerminatorsDetector, EditorContributionInstantiation.AfterFirstRender);

113  			if (token.isCancellationRequested) {

122  
123  				if (token.isCancellationRequested) {

125  				} else {
126  
127  					timeElapsedBeforeDelay = beforeDelaySW.elapsed();
128  
129  					let actualDelayBeforeFetch: number | undefined;
130  					if (triggerKind === NewSymbolNameTriggerKind.Automatic) {
131  						actualDelayBeforeFetch = expectedDelayBeforeFetch ? Math.max(0, expectedDelayBeforeFetch - timeElapsedBeforeDelay) : undefined;
132  						if (actualDelayBeforeFetch !== undefined && actualDelayBeforeFetch > 0) {
133  							await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, actualDelayBeforeFetch));
134  						}
135  					}

137  					if (token.isCancellationRequested) {

143  						const fetchResult = await endpoint.makeChatRequest(

257  	public static preprocessSymbolNames({ currentSymbolName, newSymbolNames, languageId }: { currentSymbolName: string; newSymbolNames: string[]; languageId: string }): string[] {
258  
259  		const currentNameConvention = guessNamingConvention(currentSymbolName);
260  
261  		let targetNamingConvention: NamingConvention;
262  		switch (currentNameConvention) {
263  			case NamingConvention.LowerCase:
264  				if (languageId === 'python') {
265  					targetNamingConvention = NamingConvention.SnakeCase;
266  				} else {
267  					targetNamingConvention = NamingConvention.CamelCase;
268  				}
269  				break;
270  			case NamingConvention.Uppercase:
271  			case NamingConvention.CamelCase:
272  			case NamingConvention.PascalCase:
273  			case NamingConvention.SnakeCase:
274  			case NamingConvention.ScreamingSnakeCase:
275  			case NamingConvention.CapitalSnakeCase:
276  			case NamingConvention.KebabCase:
277  			case NamingConvention.Capitalized:
278  			case NamingConvention.Unknown:
279  				targetNamingConvention = currentNameConvention;
280  				break;
281  			default: {
282  				const _exhaustiveCheck: never = currentNameConvention;
283  				return _exhaustiveCheck;
284  			}
285  		}
286  
287  		if (targetNamingConvention === NamingConvention.Unknown) {
288  			return newSymbolNames;
289  		}
290  
291  		return newSymbolNames.map(newSymbolName => enforceNamingConvention(newSymbolName, targetNamingConvention));

153  					const inputForLog = this._redactForLogging(commandInput as Record<string, unknown>);
154  					this._log(requestId, hookType, `Input: ${JSON.stringify(inputForLog)}`);
155  
156  					const hookToolName = (commandInput as { tool_name?: unknown }).tool_name;
157  					const hookToolNamesJson = typeof hookToolName === 'string' ? JSON.stringify([hookToolName]) : undefined;

159  					const span = this._otelService.startSpan(`execute_hook ${hookType}`, {

161  						attributes: {

166  							...(chatSessionId ? { [CopilotChatAttr.SESSION_ID]: chatSessionId } : {}),

168  							...(hookToolNamesJson ? { [GitHubCopilotAttr.HOOK_TOOL_NAMES]: hookToolNamesJson } : {}),
169  						},
170  					});
171  
172  					try {
173  						// Capture hook input for debug panel resolve
174  						try {
175  							span.setAttribute(CopilotChatAttr.HOOK_INPUT, truncateForOTel(JSON.stringify(commandInput), this._otelService.config.maxAttributeSizeChars));
176  						} catch { /* swallow serialization errors */ }
177  
178  						const sw = StopWatch.create();
179  						const commandResult = await this._hookExecutor.executeCommand(hookCommand, commandInput, effectiveToken);
180  						const elapsed = sw.elapsed();
181  						span.setAttribute(GitHubCopilotAttr.HOOK_DURATION_SECONDS, elapsed / 1000);
182  
183  						this._logCommandResult(requestId, hookType, commandResult, elapsed);
184  
185  						// Record result on OTel span
186  						const resultKind = commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.Success ? 'success'
187  							: commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.NonBlockingError ? 'non_blocking_error'

189  						span.setAttribute(CopilotChatAttr.HOOK_RESULT_KIND, resultKind);
190  
191  						const hookDecision = commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.Error
192  							? 'block'
193  							: commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.NonBlockingError
194  								? 'non_blocking_error'
195  								: 'pass';
196  						span.setAttribute(GitHubCopilotAttr.HOOK_DECISION, hookDecision);
197  
198  						if (commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.Error || commandResult.kind === HookCommandResultKind.NonBlockingError) {
199  							hasError = true;
200  							// Record exit code on error
201  							if (commandResult.exitCode !== undefined) {
202  								span.setAttribute('copilot_chat.hook_exit_code', commandResult.exitCode);
203  							}
204  							// Error output goes to span status message (displayed as errorMessage in resolve)
205  							span.setStatus(SpanStatusCode.ERROR, typeof commandResult.result === 'string' ? commandResult.result : undefined);
206  						} else {
207  							span.setStatus(SpanStatusCode.OK);
208  							// Capture hook output for debug panel resolve (success only — errors go to errorMessage)
209  							try {
210  								const output = typeof commandResult.result === 'string' ? commandResult.result : JSON.stringify(commandResult.result);
211  								if (output) {
212  									span.setAttribute(CopilotChatAttr.HOOK_OUTPUT, truncateForOTel(output, this._otelService.config.maxAttributeSizeChars));
213  								}
214  							} catch { /* swallow serialization errors */ }
215  						}
216

218  						results.push(result);
219  
220  						// If stopReason is set (including empty string for "stop without message"), stop processing remaining hooks
221  						if (result.stopReason !== undefined) {
222  							// A stop signal from a successful hook still counts as a block.
223  							if (hookDecision === 'pass') {

81  pub(super) fn fulfill_existing_tunnel_args(
82  	d: ExistingTunnelArgs,
83  	name_arg: &Option<String>,
84  ) -> Option<dev_tunnels::ExistingTunnel> {
85  	let tunnel_name = d.tunnel_name.or_else(|| name_arg.clone());
86  
87  	match (d.tunnel_id, d.cluster, d.host_token) {
88  		(Some(tunnel_id), None, Some(host_token)) => {
89  			let i = tunnel_id.find('.')?;
90  			Some(dev_tunnels::ExistingTunnel {
91  				tunnel_id: tunnel_id[..i].to_string(),
92  				cluster: tunnel_id[i + 1..].to_string(),
93  				tunnel_name,
94  				host_token,
95  			})
96  		}
97  
98  		(Some(tunnel_id), Some(cluster), Some(host_token)) => Some(dev_tunnels::ExistingTunnel {
99  			tunnel_id,
100  			tunnel_name,
101  			host_token,
102  			cluster,
103  		}),
104  
105  		_ => None,
106  	}
107  }

293  pub async fn service(
294  	ctx: CommandContext,
295  	tunnel_args: TunnelArgs,
296  	service_args: TunnelServiceSubCommands,
297  ) -> Result<i32, AnyError> {
298  	let manager = create_service_manager(ctx.log.clone(), &ctx.paths);
299  	match service_args {
300  		TunnelServiceSubCommands::Install(args) => {
301  			let auth = Auth::new(&ctx.paths, ctx.log.clone());
302  
303  			if let Some(name) = &args.name {
304  				// ensure the name matches, and tunnel exists
305  				dev_tunnels::DevTunnels::new_remote_tunnel(&ctx.log, auth, &ctx.paths)
306  					.rename_tunnel(name)
307  					.await?;
308  			} else {
309  				// still ensure they're logged in, otherwise subsequent serving will fail
310  				auth.get_credential().await?;
311  			}
312  
313  			// likewise for license consent
314  			legal::require_consent(&ctx.paths, args.accept_server_license_terms)?;
315  
316  			let current_exe = canonical_exe().map_err(|e| wrap(e, "could not get current exe"))?;
317  			let root_path = ctx.paths.root().as_os_str().to_string_lossy();
318  			let args = make_service_args(&root_path, &tunnel_args);
319  
320  			manager.register(current_exe, &args).await?;
321  			ctx.log.result(format!("Service successfully installed! You can use `{APPLICATION_NAME} tunnel service log` to monitor it, and `{APPLICATION_NAME} tunnel service uninstall` to remove it."));
322  		}
323  		TunnelServiceSubCommands::Uninstall => {
324  			manager.unregister().await?;
325  		}
326  		TunnelServiceSubCommands::Log => {
327  			manager.show_logs().await?;
328  		}
329  		TunnelServiceSubCommands::InternalRun => {
330  			manager
331  				.run(
332  					ctx.paths.clone(),
333  					TunnelServiceContainer::new(ctx.args, tunnel_args),
334  				)
335  				.await?;
336  		}
337  	}
338  
339  	Ok(0)
340  }
