342  pub async fn user(ctx: CommandContext, user_args: TunnelUserSubCommands) -> Result<i32, AnyError> {
343  	let auth = Auth::new(&ctx.paths, ctx.log.clone());
344  	match user_args {
345  		TunnelUserSubCommands::Login(mut login_args) => {
346  			auth.login(
347  				login_args.provider.map(|p| p.into()),
348  				login_args.access_token.take(),
349  				login_args.refresh_token.take(),
350  			)
351  			.await?;
352  		}
353  		TunnelUserSubCommands::Logout => {
354  			auth.clear_credentials()?;
355  		}
356  		TunnelUserSubCommands::Show => {
357  			if let Ok(Some(sc)) = auth.get_current_credential() {
358  				ctx.log
359  					.result(format!("logged in with provider {}", sc.provider));
360  			} else {
361  				ctx.log.result("not logged in");
362  				return Ok(1);
363  			}
364  		}
365  	}
366  
367  	Ok(0)
368  }

474  	let no_sleep = match gateway_args.no_sleep.then(SleepInhibitor::new) {
475  		Some(i) => match i.await {
476  			Ok(i) => Some(i),
477  			Err(e) => {
478  				warning!(log, "Could not inhibit sleep: {}", e);
479  				None
480  			}
481  		},
482  		None => None,
483  	};
484  
485  	legal::require_consent(&paths, gateway_args.accept_server_license_terms)?;
486  
487  	let mut csa = (&args).into();
488  	gateway_args.server_args.apply_to(&mut csa);
489  	let result = serve_with_csa(paths, log, gateway_args, csa, TUNNEL_CLI_LOCK_NAME).await;
490  	drop(no_sleep);
491  
492  	result
493  }

495  /// Internal command used by port forwarding. It reads requests for forwarded ports
496  /// on lines from stdin, as JSON. It uses singleton logic as well (though on
497  /// a different tunnel than the main one used for the control server) so that
498  /// all forward requests on a single machine go through a single hosted tunnel
499  /// process. Without singleton logic, requests could get routed to processes
500  /// that aren't forwarding a given port and then fail.
501  pub async fn forward(
502  	ctx: CommandContext,
503  	mut forward_args: TunnelForwardArgs,
504  ) -> Result<i32, AnyError> {
505  	// Spooky: check IS_A_TTY before starting the stdin reader, since IS_A_TTY will
506  	// access stdin but a lock will later be held on stdin by the line-reader.
507  	if *IS_A_TTY {
508  		trace!(ctx.log, "port forwarding is an internal preview feature");
509  	}
510  
511  	// #region stdin reading logic:
512  	let (own_ports_tx, own_ports_rx) = watch::channel(vec![]);
513  	let ports_process_log = ctx.log.clone();
514  	tokio::spawn(async move {
515  		let mut lines = BufReader::new(tokio::io::stdin()).lines();
516  		while let Ok(Some(line)) = lines.next_line().await {
517  			match serde_json::from_str(&line) {
518  				Ok(p) => {
519  					let _ = own_ports_tx.send(p);
520  				}
521  				Err(e) => warning!(ports_process_log, "error parsing ports: {}", e),
522  			}
523  		}
524  	});
525  
526  	// #region singleton acquisition
527  	let shutdown = ShutdownRequest::create_rx([ShutdownRequest::CtrlC]);
528  	let server = loop {
529  		if shutdown.is_open() {
530  			return Ok(0);
531  		}
532  
533  		match acquire_singleton(&ctx.paths.forwarding_lockfile()).await {
534  			Ok(SingletonConnection::Client(stream)) => {
535  				debug!(ctx.log, "starting as client to singleton");
536  				let r = local_forwarding::client(local_forwarding::SingletonClientArgs {
537  					log: ctx.log.clone(),
538  					shutdown: shutdown.clone(),
539  					stream,
540  					port_requests: own_ports_rx.clone(),
541  				})
542  				.await;
543  				if let Err(e) = r {
544  					warning!(ctx.log, "error contacting forwarding singleton: {}", e);
545  				}
546  			}
547  			Ok(SingletonConnection::Singleton(server)) => break server,
548  			Err(e) => {
549  				warning!(ctx.log, "error access singleton, retrying: {}", e);
550  				tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await
551  			}
552  		}
553  	};
554  
555  	// #region singleton handler
556  	let auth = Auth::new(&ctx.paths, ctx.log.clone());
557  	if let (Some(p), Some(at)) = (
558  		forward_args.login.provider.take(),
559  		forward_args.login.access_token.take(),
560  	) {
561  		auth.login(
562  			Some(p.into()),
563  			Some(at),
564  			forward_args.login.refresh_token.take(),
565  		)
566  		.await?;
567  	}
568  
569  	let mut tunnels = DevTunnels::new_port_forwarding(&ctx.log, auth, &ctx.paths);
570  	let tunnel = tunnels
571  		.start_new_launcher_tunnel(None, true, &forward_args.ports)
572  		.await?;
573  
574  	local_forwarding::server(ctx.log, tunnel, server, own_ports_rx, shutdown).await?;
575  
576  	Ok(0)
577  }
578  
579  fn get_connection_token(tunnel: &ActiveTunnel) -> String {
580  	let mut hash = Sha256::new();
581  	hash.update(tunnel.id.as_bytes());
582  	let result = hash.finalize();
583  	let mut result = b64::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(result);
584  	if result.starts_with('-') {
585  		result.insert(0, 'a'); // avoid arg parsing issue
586  	}
587  
588  	result
589  }

709

711  			Next::Respawn => {
712  				warning!(log, "respawn requested, starting new server");
713  				// reuse current args, but specify no-forward since tunnels will

35  #[derive(Default, Clone)]
36  struct PortCount {
37  	public: u32,
38  	private: u32,
39  }
40  
41  impl Index<PortPrivacy> for PortCount {
42  	type Output = u32;
43  
44  	fn index(&self, privacy: PortPrivacy) -> &Self::Output {
45  		match privacy {
46  			PortPrivacy::Public => &self.public,
47  			PortPrivacy::Private => &self.private,
48  		}
49  	}
50  }
51  
52  impl IndexMut<PortPrivacy> for PortCount {
53  	fn index_mut(&mut self, privacy: PortPrivacy) -> &mut Self::Output {
54  		match privacy {
55  			PortPrivacy::Public => &mut self.public,
56  			PortPrivacy::Private => &mut self.private,
57  		}
58  	}
59  }
60  
61  impl PortCount {
62  	fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
63  		self.public == 0 && self.private == 0
64  	}
65  
66  	fn primary_privacy(&self) -> PortPrivacy {
67  		if self.public > 0 {
68  			PortPrivacy::Public
69  		} else {
70  			PortPrivacy::Private
71  		}
72  	}
73  }
74  #[derive(Clone)]
75  struct PortMapRec {
76  	count: PortCount,
77  	protocol: PortProtocol,
78  }
79  
80  type PortMap = HashMap<u16, PortMapRec>;
81  
82  /// The PortForwardingHandle is given out to multiple consumers to allow
83  /// them to set_ports that they want to be forwarded.
84  struct PortForwardingSender {
85  	/// Todo: when `SyncUnsafeCell` is no longer nightly, we can use it here with
86  	/// the following comment:
87  	///
88  	/// SyncUnsafeCell is used and safe here because PortForwardingSender is used
89  	/// exclusively in synchronous dispatch *and* we create a new sender in the
90  	/// context for each connection, in `serve_singleton_rpc`.
91  	///
92  	/// If PortForwardingSender is ever used in a different context, this should
93  	/// be refactored, e.g. to use locks or `&mut self` in set_ports`
94  	///
95  	/// see https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/cell/struct.SyncUnsafeCell.html
96  	current: Mutex<PortList>,
97  	sender: Arc<Mutex<watch::Sender<PortMap>>>,
98  }
99  
100  impl PortForwardingSender {
101  	pub fn set_ports(&self, ports: PortList) {
102  		let mut current = self.current.lock().unwrap();
103  		self.sender.lock().unwrap().send_modify(|v| {
104  			for p in current.iter() {
105  				if !ports.contains(p) {
106  					let n = v.get_mut(&p.number).expect("expected port in map");
107  					n.count[p.privacy] -= 1;
108  					if n.count.is_empty() {
109  						v.remove(&p.number);
110  					}
111  				}
112  			}
113  
114  			for p in ports.iter() {
115  				if !current.contains(p) {
116  					match v.get_mut(&p.number) {
117  						Some(n) => {
118  							n.count[p.privacy] += 1;
119  							n.protocol = p.protocol;
120  						}
121  						None => {
122  							let mut count = PortCount::default();
123  							count[p.privacy] += 1;
124  							v.insert(
125  								p.number,
126  								PortMapRec {
127  									count,
128  									protocol: p.protocol,
129  								},
130  							);
131  						}
132  					};
133  				}
134  			}
135  
136  			current.splice(.., ports);
137  		});
138  	}
139  }
140  
141  impl Clone for PortForwardingSender {
142  	fn clone(&self) -> Self {
143  		Self {
144  			current: Mutex::new(vec![]),
145  			sender: self.sender.clone(),
146  		}
147  	}
148  }
149  
150  impl Drop for PortForwardingSender {
151  	fn drop(&mut self) {
152  		self.set_ports(vec![]);
153  	}
154  }

160  impl PortForwardingReceiver {
161  	pub fn new() -> (PortForwardingSender, Self) {
162  		let (sender, receiver) = watch::channel(HashMap::new());
163  		let handle = PortForwardingSender {
164  			current: Mutex::new(vec![]),
165  			sender: Arc::new(Mutex::new(sender)),
166  		};
167  
168  		let tracker = Self { receiver };
169  
170  		(handle, tracker)
171  	}

173  	/// Applies all changes from PortForwardingHandles to the tunnel.
174  	pub async fn apply_to(&mut self, log: log::Logger, tunnel: Arc<ActiveTunnel>) {
175  		let mut current: PortMap = HashMap::new();
176  		while self.receiver.changed().await.is_ok() {
177  			let next = self.receiver.borrow().clone();
178  
179  			for (port, rec) in current.iter() {
180  				let privacy = rec.count.primary_privacy();
181  				if !matches!(next.get(port), Some(n) if n.count.primary_privacy() == privacy) {
182  					match tunnel.remove_port(*port).await {
183  						Ok(_) => info!(
184  							log,
185  							"stopped forwarding {} port {} at {:?}", rec.protocol, *port, privacy
186  						),
187  						Err(e) => error!(
188  							log,
189  							"failed to stop forwarding {} port {}: {}", rec.protocol, port, e
190  						),
191  					}
192  				}
193  			}
194  
195  			for (port, rec) in next.iter() {
196  				let privacy = rec.count.primary_privacy();
197  				if !matches!(current.get(port), Some(n) if n.count.primary_privacy() == privacy) {
198  					match tunnel.add_port_tcp(*port, privacy, rec.protocol).await {
199  						Ok(_) => info!(
200  							log,
201  							"forwarding {} port {} at {:?}", rec.protocol, port, privacy
202  						),
203  						Err(e) => error!(
204  							log,
205  							"failed to forward {} port {}: {}", rec.protocol, port, e
206  						),
207  					}
208  				}
209  			}
210  
211  			current = next;
212  		}
213  	}
214  }

230  /// Serves a client singleton for port forwarding.
231  pub async fn client(args: SingletonClientArgs) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
232  	let mut rpc = new_json_rpc();
233  	let (msg_tx, msg_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
234  	let SingletonClientArgs {
235  		log,
236  		shutdown,
237  		stream,
238  		mut port_requests,
239  	} = args;
240  
241  	debug!(
242  		log,
243  		"An existing port forwarding process is running on this machine, connecting to it..."
244  	);
245  
246  	let caller = rpc.get_caller(msg_tx);
247  	let rpc = rpc.methods(()).build(log.clone());
248  	let (read, write) = socket_stream_split(stream);
249  
250  	let serve = start_json_rpc(rpc, read, write, msg_rx, shutdown);
251  	let forward = async move {
252  		while port_requests.changed().await.is_ok() {
253  			let ports = port_requests.borrow().clone();
254  			let r = caller
255  				.call::<_, _, protocol::forward_singleton::SetPortsResponse>(
256  					protocol::forward_singleton::METHOD_SET_PORTS,
257  					protocol::forward_singleton::SetPortsParams { ports },
258  				)
259  				.await
260  				.unwrap();
261  
262  			match r {
263  				Err(e) => error!(log, "failed to set ports: {:?}", e),
264  				Ok(r) => print_forwarding_addr(&r),
265  			};
266  		}
267  	};
268  
269  	tokio::select! {
270  		r = serve => r.map(|_| ()),
271  		_ = forward => Ok(()),
272  	}
273  }
274  
275  /// Serves a port-forwarding singleton.
276  pub async fn server(
277  	log: log::Logger,
278  	tunnel: ActiveTunnel,
279  	server: SingletonServer,
280  	mut port_requests: watch::Receiver<PortList>,
281  	shutdown_rx: Barrier<ShutdownSignal>,
282  ) -> Result<(), CodeError> {
283  	let tunnel = Arc::new(tunnel);
284  	let (forward_tx, mut forward_rx) = PortForwardingReceiver::new();
285  
286  	let forward_own_tunnel = tunnel.clone();
287  	let forward_own_tx = forward_tx.clone();
288  	let forward_own = async move {
289  		while port_requests.changed().await.is_ok() {
290  			forward_own_tx.set_ports(port_requests.borrow().clone());
291  			print_forwarding_addr(&SetPortsResponse {
292  				port_format: forward_own_tunnel.get_port_format().ok(),
293  			});
294  		}
295  	};
296  
297  	tokio::select! {
298  		_ = forward_own => Ok(()),
299  		_ = forward_rx.apply_to(log.clone(), tunnel.clone()) => Ok(()),
300  		r = serve_singleton_rpc(server, log, tunnel, forward_tx, shutdown_rx) => r,
301  	}
302  }
303  
304  async fn serve_singleton_rpc(
305  	mut server: SingletonServer,
306  	log: log::Logger,
307  	tunnel: Arc<ActiveTunnel>,
308  	forward_tx: PortForwardingSender,
309  	shutdown_rx: Barrier<ShutdownSignal>,
310  ) -> Result<(), CodeError> {
311  	let mut own_shutdown = shutdown_rx.clone();
312  	let shutdown_fut = own_shutdown.wait();
313  	pin!(shutdown_fut);
314  
315  	loop {
316  		let cnx = tokio::select! {
317  			c = server.accept() => c?,
318  			_ = &mut shutdown_fut => return Ok(()),
319  		};

39  	async fn connect() -> Result<Connection, AnyError> {
40  		let connection = Connection::session()
41  			.await
42  			.map_err(|e| DbusConnectFailedError(e.to_string()))?;
43  		Ok(connection)
44  	}
45  
46  	async fn proxy(connection: &Connection) -> Result<SystemdManagerDbusProxy<'_>, AnyError> {
47  		let proxy = SystemdManagerDbusProxy::new(connection)
48  			.await
49  			.map_err(|e| {
50  				wrap(
51  					e,
52  					"error connecting to systemd, you may need to re-run with sudo:",
53  				)
54  			})?;
55  
56  		Ok(proxy)
57  	}
58  
59  	fn service_path_string(&self) -> String {
60  		self.service_file.as_os_str().to_string_lossy().to_string()
61  	}
62  
63  	fn service_name_string() -> String {
64  		format!("{APPLICATION_NAME}-tunnel.service")
65  	}
66  }
67  
68  impl ServiceManager for SystemdService {
69  	async fn register(
70  		&self,
71  		exe: std::path::PathBuf,
72  		args: &[&str],
73  	) -> Result<(), crate::util::errors::AnyError> {
74  		let connection = SystemdService::connect().await?;
75  		let proxy = SystemdService::proxy(&connection).await?;
76  
77  		write_systemd_service_file(&self.service_file, exe, args)
78  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error creating service file"))?;
79  
80  		proxy
81  			.link_unit_files(
82  				vec![self.service_path_string()],
83  				/* 'runtime only'= */ false,
84  				/* replace existing = */ true,
85  			)
86  			.await
87  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error registering service"))?;
88  
89  		info!(self.log, "Successfully registered service...");
90  
91  		if let Err(e) = proxy.reload().await {
92  			warning!(self.log, "Error issuing reload(): {}", e);
93  		}
94  
95  		// note: enablement is implicit in recent systemd version, but required for older systems
96  		// https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/167489#issuecomment-1331222826
97  		proxy
98  			.enable_unit_files(
99  				vec![SystemdService::service_name_string()],
100  				/* 'runtime only'= */ false,
101  				/* replace existing = */ true,
102  			)
103  			.await
104  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error enabling unit files for service"))?;
105  
106  		info!(self.log, "Successfully enabled unit files...");
107  
108  		proxy
109  			.start_unit(SystemdService::service_name_string(), "replace".to_string())
110  			.await
111  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error starting service"))?;
112  
113  		info!(self.log, "Tunnel service successfully started");
114  
115  		if std::env::var("SSH_CLIENT").is_ok() || std::env::var("SSH_TTY").is_ok() {
116  			info!(self.log, "Tip: run `sudo loginctl enable-linger $USER` to ensure the service stays running after you disconnect.");
117  		}
118  
119  		Ok(())
120  	}
121  
122  	async fn is_installed(&self) -> Result<bool, AnyError> {
123  		let connection = SystemdService::connect().await?;
124  		let proxy = SystemdService::proxy(&connection).await?;
125  		let state = proxy
126  			.get_unit_file_state(SystemdService::service_name_string())
127  			.await;
128  
129  		if let Ok(s) = state {
130  			Ok(s == "enabled")
131  		} else {
132  			Ok(false)
133  		}
134  	}
135  
136  	async fn run(
137  		self,
138  		launcher_paths: crate::state::LauncherPaths,
139  		mut handle: impl 'static + super::ServiceContainer,
140  	) -> Result<(), crate::util::errors::AnyError> {
141  		handle.run_service(self.log, launcher_paths).await
142  	}
143  
144  	async fn show_logs(&self) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
145  		// show the systemctl status header...
146  		Command::new("systemctl")
147  			.args([
148  				"--user",
149  				"status",
150  				"-n",
151  				"0",
152  				&SystemdService::service_name_string(),
153  			])
154  			.status()
155  			.map(|s| s.code().unwrap_or(1))
156  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error running systemctl"))?;
157  
158  		// then follow log files
159  		Command::new("journalctl")
160  			.args(["--user", "-f", "-u", &SystemdService::service_name_string()])

38  impl ServiceManager for LaunchdService {
39  	async fn register(
40  		&self,
41  		exe: std::path::PathBuf,
42  		args: &[&str],
43  	) -> Result<(), crate::util::errors::AnyError> {
44  		let service_file = get_service_file_path()?;
45  		write_service_file(&service_file, &self.log_file, exe, args)
46  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error creating service file"))?;
47  
48  		info!(self.log, "Successfully registered service...");
49  
50  		capture_command_and_check_status(
51  			"launchctl",
52  			&["load", service_file.as_os_str().to_string_lossy().as_ref()],
53  		)
54  		.await?;
55  
56  		capture_command_and_check_status("launchctl", &["start", &get_service_label()]).await?;
57  
58  		info!(self.log, "Tunnel service successfully started");
59  
60  		Ok(())
61  	}

65  	}

73  	}

77  		Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&cmd.stdout).contains(&get_service_label()))
78  	}
79  
80  	async fn unregister(&self) -> Result<(), crate::util::errors::AnyError> {
81  		let service_file = get_service_file_path()?;
82  
83  		match capture_command_and_check_status("launchctl", &["stop", &get_service_label()]).await {
84  			Ok(_) => {}
85  			// status 3 == "no such process"
86  			Err(CodeError::CommandFailed { code: 3, .. }) => {}
87  			Err(e) => return Err(wrap(e, "error stopping service").into()),
88  		};
89  
90  		info!(self.log, "Successfully stopped service...");
91  
92  		capture_command_and_check_status(
93  			"launchctl",
94  			&[
95  				"unload",
96  				service_file.as_os_str().to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
97  			],
98  		)
99  		.await?;
100  
101  		info!(self.log, "Tunnel service uninstalled");
102  
103  		if let Ok(f) = get_service_file_path() {
104  			remove_file(f).ok();
105  		}
106  
107  		Ok(())
108  	}

117  		Some(mut d) => {
118  			d.push(format!("{}.plist", get_service_label()));
119  			Ok(d)
120  		}
121  		None => Err(MissingHomeDirectory()),
122  	}
123  }

150  			<key>KeepAlive</key>\n\

6  use shell_escape::windows::escape as shell_escape;
7  use std::{path::PathBuf, process::Stdio};
8  use winreg::{enums::HKEY_CURRENT_USER, RegKey};
9  
10  use crate::util::command::{new_std_command, DetachFromParent};
11  use crate::{
12  	constants::TUNNEL_ACTIVITY_NAME,
13  	log,
14  	state::LauncherPaths,
15  	tunnels::{protocol, singleton_client::do_single_rpc_call},
16  	util::errors::{wrap, wrapdbg, AnyError},
17  };

19  use super::service::{tail_log_file, ServiceContainer, ServiceManager as CliServiceManager};
20  
21  const DID_LAUNCH_AS_HIDDEN_PROCESS: &str = "VSCODE_CLI_DID_LAUNCH_AS_HIDDEN_PROCESS";
22  
23  pub struct WindowsService {
24  	log: log::Logger,
25  	tunnel_lock: PathBuf,
26  	log_file: PathBuf,
27  }
28  
29  impl WindowsService {
30  	pub fn new(log: log::Logger, paths: &LauncherPaths) -> Self {
31  		Self {
32  			log,
33  			tunnel_lock: paths.tunnel_lockfile(),
34  			log_file: paths.service_log_file(),
35  		}
36  	}
37  
38  	fn open_key() -> Result<RegKey, AnyError> {
39  		RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER)
40  			.create_subkey(r"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run")
41  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error opening run registry key").into())
42  			.map(|(key, _)| key)
43  	}
44  }
45  
46  impl CliServiceManager for WindowsService {
47  	async fn register(&self, exe: std::path::PathBuf, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
48  		let key = WindowsService::open_key()?;
49  
50  		let mut reg_str = String::new();
51  		let mut cmd = new_std_command(&exe);
52  		reg_str.push_str(shell_escape(exe.to_string_lossy()).as_ref());
53  
54  		let mut add_arg = |arg: &str| {
55  			reg_str.push(' ');
56  			reg_str.push_str(shell_escape((*arg).into()).as_ref());
57  			cmd.arg(arg);
58  		};
59  
60  		for arg in args {
61  			add_arg(arg);
62  		}
63  
64  		add_arg("--log-to-file");
65  		add_arg(self.log_file.to_string_lossy().as_ref());
66  
67  		key.set_value(TUNNEL_ACTIVITY_NAME, &reg_str)
68  			.map_err(|e| AnyError::from(wrapdbg(e, "error setting registry key")))?;
69  
70  		info!(self.log, "Successfully registered service...");
71  
72  		cmd.stderr(Stdio::null());
73  		cmd.stdout(Stdio::null());
74  		cmd.stdin(Stdio::null());
75  		cmd.detach_from_parent();
76  		cmd.spawn()
77  			.map_err(|e| wrapdbg(e, "error starting service"))?;
78  
79  		info!(self.log, "Tunnel service successfully started");
80  		Ok(())
81  	}
82  
83  	async fn show_logs(&self) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
84  		tail_log_file(&self.log_file).await
85  	}
86  
87  	async fn run(
88  		self,
89  		launcher_paths: LauncherPaths,
90  		mut handle: impl 'static + ServiceContainer,
91  	) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
92  		if std::env::var(DID_LAUNCH_AS_HIDDEN_PROCESS).is_ok() {
93  			return handle.run_service(self.log, launcher_paths).await;
94  		}
95  
96  		// Start as a hidden subprocess to avoid showing cmd.exe on startup.
97  		// Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/184058
98  		// I also tried the winapi ShowWindow, but that didn't yield fruit.
99  		new_std_command(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
100  			.args(std::env::args().skip(1))
101  			.env(DID_LAUNCH_AS_HIDDEN_PROCESS, "1")
102  			.stderr(Stdio::null())
103  			.stdout(Stdio::null())
104  			.stdin(Stdio::null())
105  			.detach_from_parent()
106  			.spawn()
107  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "error starting nested process"))?;
108  
109  		Ok(())
110  	}
111  
112  	async fn is_installed(&self) -> Result<bool, AnyError> {
113  		let key = WindowsService::open_key()?;
114  		Ok(key.get_raw_value(TUNNEL_ACTIVITY_NAME).is_ok())
115  	}
116  
117  	async fn unregister(&self) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
118  		let key = WindowsService::open_key()?;
119  		match key.delete_value(TUNNEL_ACTIVITY_NAME) {
120  			Ok(_) => {}
121  			Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
122  			Err(e) => return Err(wrap(e, "error deleting registry key").into()),
123  		}
124  
125  		info!(self.log, "Tunnel service uninstalled");
126  
127  		let r = do_single_rpc_call::<_, ()>(
128  			&self.tunnel_lock,
129  			self.log.clone(),
130  			protocol::singleton::METHOD_SHUTDOWN,
131  			protocol::EmptyObject {},
132  		)
133  		.await;
134  
135  		if r.is_err() {
136  			warning!(self.log, "The tunnel service has been unregistered, but we couldn't find a running tunnel process. You may need to restart or log out and back in to fully stop the tunnel.");
137  		} else {
138  			info!(self.log, "Successfully shut down running tunnel.");
139  		}
140  
141  		Ok(())
142  	}
143  }

523  	/// Runs the login flow, optionally pre-filling a provider and/or access token.
524  	pub async fn login(
525  		&self,
526  		provider: Option<AuthProvider>,
527  		access_token: Option<String>,
528  		refresh_token: Option<String>,
529  	) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
530  		let provider = match provider {
531  			Some(p) => p,
532  			None => self.prompt_for_provider().await?,
533  		};
534  
535  		let credentials = match access_token {
536  			Some(t) => StoredCredential {
537  				provider,
538  				access_token: t,
539  				// if a refresh token is given, assume it's valid now but refresh it
540  				// soon in order to get the real expiry time.
541  				expires_at: refresh_token
542  					.as_ref()
543  					.map(|_| Timestamp::now() + SignedDuration::from_secs(5 * 60)),
544  				refresh_token,
545  			},
546  			None => self.do_device_code_flow_with_provider(provider).await?,
547  		};
548  
549  		self.store_credentials(credentials.clone());
550  		Ok(credentials)
551  	}
552  
553  	/// Runs the device-flow login for a specific provider with custom OAuth
554  	/// scopes. Unlike [`login`], this is purpose-built for agent host auth
555  	/// where the scopes are dictated by the server's protected resource
556  	/// metadata rather than hardcoded defaults.
557  	pub async fn login_with_scopes(
558  		&self,
559  		provider: AuthProvider,
560  		scopes: Option<String>,
561  	) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
562  		let credentials = self
563  			.do_device_code_flow_with_scopes(provider, scopes)
564  			.await?;
565  		self.store_credentials(credentials.clone());
566  		Ok(credentials)
567  	}
568  
569  	/// Gets the currently stored credentials, or asks the user to log in.
570  	pub async fn get_credential(&self) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
571  		let entry = match self.get_current_credential() {
572  			Ok(Some(old_creds)) => {
573  				trace!(self.log, "Found token in keyring");
574  				match self.maybe_refresh_token(&old_creds).await {
575  					Ok(Some(new_creds)) => {
576  						self.store_credentials(new_creds.clone());
577  						new_creds
578  					}
579  					Ok(None) => old_creds,
580  					Err(e) => {
581  						info!(self.log, "error refreshing token: {}", e);
582  						crate::tunnels::machine_status::emit_token_error(e.to_string());
583  						let new_creds = self
584  							.do_device_code_flow_with_provider(old_creds.provider)
585  							.await?;
586  						self.store_credentials(new_creds.clone());
587  						new_creds
588  					}
589  				}
590  			}
591  
592  			Ok(None) => {
593  				trace!(self.log, "No token in keyring, getting a new one");
594  				let creds = self.do_device_code_flow().await?;
595  				self.store_credentials(creds.clone());
596  				creds
597  			}
598  
599  			Err(e) => {
600  				warning!(
601  					self.log,
602  					"Error reading token from keyring, getting a new one: {}",
603  					e
604  				);
605  				let creds = self.do_device_code_flow().await?;
606  				self.store_credentials(creds.clone());
607  				creds
608  			}
609  		};
610  
611  		Ok(entry)
612  	}
613  
614  	/// Stores credentials, logging a warning if it fails.
615  	fn store_credentials(&self, creds: StoredCredential) {
616  		self.with_storage(|storage| {
617  			if let Err(e) = storage.storage.store(creds.clone()) {
618  				warning!(
619  					self.log,
620  					"Failed to update keyring with new credentials: {}",
621  					e
622  				);
623  
624  				if let Some(fb) = storage.fallback_storage.take() {
625  					storage.storage = Box::new(fb);
626  					match storage.storage.store(creds.clone()) {
627  						Err(e) => {
628  							warning!(self.log, "Also failed to update fallback storage: {}", e)
629  						}

652  	/// Refreshes the token in the credentials. Returns an error if the process failed.
653  	/// Returns None if the token didn't change.
654  	async fn do_refresh_token(
655  		&self,
656  		creds: &StoredCredential,
657  	) -> Result<Option<StoredCredential>, AnyError> {
658  		match &creds.refresh_token {
659  			Some(t) => self
660  				.do_grant(
661  					creds.provider,
662  					format!(
663  						"client_id={}&grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token={}",
664  						creds.provider.client_id(),
665  						t
666  					),
667  				)
668  				.await
669  				.map(Some),
670  			None => match creds.provider {
671  				AuthProvider::Github => self.touch_github_token(creds).await.map(|_| None),
672  				_ => Err(RefreshTokenNotAvailableError().into()),
673  			},
674  		}
675  	}
676  
677  	/// Does a "grant token" request.
678  	async fn do_grant(
679  		&self,
680  		provider: AuthProvider,
681  		body: String,
682  	) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
683  		let response = self
684  			.client
685  			.post(provider.grant_uri())
686  			.body(body)
687  			.header("Accept", "application/json")
688  			.send()
689  			.await?;
690  
691  		let status_code = response.status().as_u16();
692  		let body = response.bytes().await?;
693  		if let Ok(body) = serde_json::from_slice::<AuthenticationResponse>(&body) {
694  			return Ok(StoredCredential::from_response(body, provider));
695  		}
696  
697  		Err(Auth::handle_grant_error(
698  			provider.grant_uri(),
699  			status_code,
700  			body,
701  		))
702  	}
703  
704  	/// GH doesn't have a refresh token, but does limit to the 10 most recently
705  	/// used tokens per user (#9052), so for the github "refresh" just request
706  	/// the current user.
707  	async fn touch_github_token(&self, credential: &StoredCredential) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
708  		let response = get_github_user(&self.client, &credential.access_token).await?;
709  		if response.status().is_success() {
710  			return Ok(());
711  		}
712  
713  		let status_code = response.status().as_u16();
714  		let body = response.bytes().await?;
715  		Err(Auth::handle_grant_error(
716  			GH_USER_ENDPOINT,
717  			status_code,
718  			body,
719  		))
720  	}
721  
722  	fn handle_grant_error(url: &str, status_code: u16, body: bytes::Bytes) -> AnyError {
723  		if let Ok(res) = serde_json::from_slice::<AuthenticationError>(&body) {
724  			return OAuthError {
725  				error: res.error,
726  				error_description: res.error_description,
727  			}
728  			.into();
729  		}
730  
731  		StatusError {
732  			body: String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).to_string(),
733  			status_code,
734  			url: url.to_string(),
735  		}
736  		.into()
737  	}
738  	/// Implements the device code flow, returning the credentials upon success.
739  	async fn do_device_code_flow(&self) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
740  		let provider = self.prompt_for_provider().await?;
741  		self.do_device_code_flow_with_scopes(provider, None).await
742  	}
743  
744  	async fn prompt_for_provider(&self) -> Result<AuthProvider, AnyError> {
745  		if let Some(provider) = self.forced_provider {
746  			return Ok(provider);
747  		}
748  
749  		if !*IS_INTERACTIVE_CLI {
750  			info!(
751  				self.log,
752  				"Using GitHub for authentication, run `{} tunnel user login --provider <provider>` option to change this.",
753  				APPLICATION_NAME
754  			);
755  			return Ok(AuthProvider::Github);
756  		}
757  
758  		let provider = prompt_options(
759  			format!("How would you like to log in to {PRODUCT_NAME_LONG}?"),
760  			&[AuthProvider::Microsoft, AuthProvider::Github],
761  		)?;
762  
763  		Ok(provider)
764  	}
765  
766  	async fn do_device_code_flow_with_provider(
767  		&self,
768  		provider: AuthProvider,
769  	) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
770  		self.do_device_code_flow_with_scopes(provider, None).await
771  	}

775  	pub async fn do_device_code_flow_with_scopes(
776  		&self,
777  		provider: AuthProvider,
778  		scopes: Option<String>,
779  	) -> Result<StoredCredential, AnyError> {
780  		let scopes = scopes.unwrap_or_else(|| provider.get_default_scopes());
781  		loop {
782  			let init_code = self
783  				.client
784  				.post(provider.code_uri())
785  				.header("Accept", "application/json")
786  				.body(format!(
787  					"client_id={}&scope={}",
788  					provider.client_id(),
789  					scopes,
790  				))
791  				.send()
792  				.await?;
793  
794  			if !init_code.status().is_success() {
795  				return Err(StatusError::from_res(init_code).await?.into());
796  			}
797  
798  			let init_code_json = init_code.json::<DeviceCodeResponse>().await?;
799  			let expires_at =
800  				Timestamp::now() + SignedDuration::from_secs(init_code_json.expires_in);
801  
802  			match &init_code_json.message {
803  				Some(m) => self.log.result(m),
804  				None => self.log.result(format!(
805  					"To grant access to the server, please log into {} and use code {}",
806  					init_code_json.verification_uri, init_code_json.user_code
807  				)),
808  			};
809  
810  			let body = format!(
811  					"client_id={}&grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code&device_code={}",
812  					provider.client_id(),
813  					init_code_json.device_code
814  			);
815  
816  			let mut interval_s = 5;
817  			while Timestamp::now() < expires_at {
818  				sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(interval_s)).await;
819  
820  				match self.do_grant(provider, body.clone()).await {
821  					Ok(creds) => return Ok(creds),
822  					Err(AnyError::OAuthError(e)) if e.error == "slow_down" => {
823  						interval_s += 5; // https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8628#section-3.5
824  						trace!(self.log, "refresh poll failed, slowing down");
825  					}
826  					// Github returns a non-standard 429 to slow down
827  					Err(AnyError::StatusError(e)) if e.status_code == 429 => {
828  						interval_s += 5; // https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8628#section-3.5
829  						trace!(self.log, "refresh poll failed, slowing down");
830  					}
831  					Err(e) => {
832  						trace!(self.log, "refresh poll failed, retrying: {}", e);
833  					}
834  				}
835  			}
836  		}
837  	}

839  	/// Maintains the stored credential by refreshing it against the service
840  	/// to ensure its stays current. Returns a future that should be polled and
841  	/// only errors if a refresh fails in a consistent way.
842  	pub async fn keep_token_alive(self) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
843  		let this = self.clone();
844  		let default_refresh = std::time::Duration::from_secs(60 * 60);
845  		let min_refresh = std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
846  
847  		let mut credential = this.get_credential().await?;
848  		let mut last_did_error = false;
849  		loop {
850  			let sleep_time = if last_did_error {
851  				min_refresh
852  			} else {
853  				match credential.expires_at {
854  					Some(d) => {
855  						let dur = d.duration_since(Timestamp::now());
856  						let nanos = dur.as_nanos() * 2 / 3;
857  						let scaled = SignedDuration::new(
858  							(nanos / 1_000_000_000) as i64,
859  							(nanos % 1_000_000_000) as i32,
860  						);
861  						if scaled.is_negative() {
862  							min_refresh
863  						} else {
864  							scaled.unsigned_abs()
865  						}
866  					}
867  					None => default_refresh,
868  				}
869  			};
870  
871  			// to_std errors on negative duration, fall back to a 60s refresh
872  			tokio::time::sleep(sleep_time.max(min_refresh)).await;
873  
874  			match this.do_refresh_token(&credential).await {
875  				// 4xx error means this token is probably not good any mode
876  				Err(AnyError::StatusError(e)) if e.status_code >= 400 && e.status_code < 500 => {
877  					error!(this.log, "failed to keep token alive: {:?}", e);
878  					return Err(e.into());
879  				}
880  				Err(AnyError::RefreshTokenNotAvailableError(_)) => {
881  					return Ok(());
882  				}
883  				Err(e) => {
884  					warning!(this.log, "error refreshing token: {:?}", e);
885  					crate::tunnels::machine_status::emit_token_error(e.to_string());
886  					last_did_error = true;
887  					continue;
888  				}
889  				Ok(c) => {
890  					trace!(this.log, "token was successfully refreshed in keepalive");
891  					last_did_error = false;
892  					if let Some(c) = c {
893  						this.store_credentials(c.clone());
894  						credential = c;

5  
6  use std::{fs, path::Path};
7  use tempfile::tempdir;
8  
9  use crate::{
10  	constants::{VSCODE_CLI_COMMIT, VSCODE_CLI_QUALITY},
11  	options::Quality,
12  	update_service::{unzip_downloaded_release, Platform, Release, TargetKind, UpdateService},
13  	util::{
14  		command::new_std_command,
15  		errors::{wrap, AnyError, CodeError, CorruptDownload},
16  		http,
17  		io::{ReportCopyProgress, SilentCopyProgress},
18  	},
19  };
20  
21  pub struct SelfUpdate<'a> {
22  	commit: &'static str,
23  	quality: Quality,
24  	platform: Platform,
25  	update_service: &'a UpdateService,
26  }
27  
28  static OLD_UPDATE_EXTENSION: &str = "Updating CLI";
29  
30  impl<'a> SelfUpdate<'a> {
31  	pub fn new(update_service: &'a UpdateService) -> Result<Self, AnyError> {
32  		let commit =
33  			VSCODE_CLI_COMMIT.ok_or(CodeError::UpdatesNotConfigured("unknown build commit"))?;
34  
35  		let quality = VSCODE_CLI_QUALITY
36  			.ok_or(CodeError::UpdatesNotConfigured("no configured quality"))
37  			.and_then(|q| {
38  				Quality::try_from(q).map_err(|_| CodeError::UpdatesNotConfigured("unknown quality"))
39  			})?;
40  
41  		let platform = Platform::env_default().ok_or({
42  			CodeError::UpdatesNotConfigured("Unknown platform, please report this error")
43  		})?;
44  
45  		Ok(Self {
46  			commit,
47  			quality,
48  			platform,
49  			update_service,
50  		})
51  	}
52  
53  	/// Gets the current release
54  	pub async fn get_current_release(&self) -> Result<Release, AnyError> {
55  		self.update_service
56  			.get_latest_commit(self.platform, TargetKind::Cli, self.quality)
57  			.await
58  	}
59  
60  	/// Gets whether the given release is what this CLI is built against
61  	pub fn is_up_to_date_with(&self, release: &Release) -> bool {
62  		release.commit == self.commit
63  	}
64  
65  	/// Cleans up old self-updated binaries. Should be called with regularity.
66  	/// May fail if old versions are still running.
67  	pub fn cleanup_old_update(&self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
68  		let current_path = std::env::current_exe()?;
69  		let old_path = current_path.with_extension(OLD_UPDATE_EXTENSION);
70  		if old_path.exists() {
71  			fs::remove_file(old_path)?;
72  		}
73  
74  		Ok(())
75  	}
76  
77  	/// Updates the CLI to the given release.
78  	pub async fn do_update(
79  		&self,
80  		release: &Release,
81  		progress: impl ReportCopyProgress,
82  	) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
83  		// 1. Download the archive into a temporary directory
84  		let tempdir = tempdir().map_err(|e| wrap(e, "Failed to create temp dir"))?;
85  		let stream = self.update_service.get_download_stream(release).await?;
86  		let archive_path = tempdir.path().join(stream.url_path_basename().unwrap());
87  		http::download_into_file(&archive_path, progress, stream).await?;
88  
89  		// 2. Unzip the archive and get the binary
90  		let target_path =
91  			std::env::current_exe().map_err(|e| wrap(e, "could not get current exe"))?;
92  		let staging_path = target_path.with_extension(".update");
93  		let archive_contents_path = tempdir.path().join("content");
94  		// unzipping the single binary is pretty small and fast--don't bother with passing progress
95  		unzip_downloaded_release(&archive_path, &archive_contents_path, SilentCopyProgress())?;
96  		copy_updated_cli_to_path(&archive_contents_path, &staging_path)?;
97  
98  		// 3. Copy file metadata, make sure the new binary is executable\
99  		copy_file_metadata(&target_path, &staging_path)
100  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "failed to set file permissions"))?;
101  		validate_cli_is_good(&staging_path)?;
102  
103  		// Try to rename the old CLI to the tempdir, where it can get cleaned up by the
104  		// OS later. However, this can fail if the tempdir is on a different drive
105  		// than the installation dir. In this case just rename it to ".old".
106  		if fs::rename(&target_path, tempdir.path().join("old-code-cli")).is_err() {
107  			fs::rename(
108  				&target_path,
109  				target_path.with_extension(OLD_UPDATE_EXTENSION),
110  			)
111  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "failed to rename old CLI"))?;
112  		}
113  
114  		fs::rename(&staging_path, &target_path)
115  			.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "failed to rename newly installed CLI"))?;
116  
117  		Ok(())
118  	}
119  }
120  
121  fn validate_cli_is_good(exe_path: &Path) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
122  	let o = new_std_command(exe_path)
123  		.args(["--version"])
124  		.output()
125  		.map_err(|e| CorruptDownload(format!("could not execute new binary, aborting: {e}")))?;
126  
127  	if !o.status.success() {
128  		let msg = format!(
129  			"could not execute new binary, aborting. Stdout:\n\n{}\n\nStderr:\n\n{}",
130  			String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout),
131  			String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr),
132  		);
133  
134  		return Err(CorruptDownload(msg).into());
135  	}
136  
137  	Ok(())
138  }
139  
140  fn copy_updated_cli_to_path(unzipped_content: &Path, staging_path: &Path) -> Result<(), AnyError> {
141  	let unzipped_files = fs::read_dir(unzipped_content)
142  		.map_err(|e| wrap(e, "could not read update contents"))?
143  		.collect::<Vec<_>>();
144  	if unzipped_files.len() != 1 {
145  		let msg = format!(
146  			"expected exactly one file in update, got {}",
147  			unzipped_files.len()
148  		);
149  		return Err(CorruptDownload(msg).into());
150  	}

6  use std::sync::Arc;
7  
8  use indicatif::ProgressBar;
9  
10  use crate::{
11  	constants::PRODUCT_NAME_LONG,
12  	self_update::SelfUpdate,
13  	update_service::UpdateService,
14  	util::{errors::AnyError, http::ReqwestSimpleHttp, input::ProgressBarReporter},
15  };
16  
17  use super::{args::StandaloneUpdateArgs, CommandContext};
18  
19  pub async fn update(ctx: CommandContext, args: StandaloneUpdateArgs) -> Result<i32, AnyError> {
20  	let update_service = UpdateService::new(
21  		ctx.log.clone(),
22  		Arc::new(ReqwestSimpleHttp::with_client(ctx.http.clone())),
23  	);
24  	let update_service = SelfUpdate::new(&update_service)?;
25  
26  	let _ = update_service.cleanup_old_update();
27  
28  	let current_version = update_service.get_current_release().await?;
29  	if update_service.is_up_to_date_with(&current_version) {
30  		ctx.log.result(format!(
31  			"{} is already up to date ({})",
32  			PRODUCT_NAME_LONG, current_version.commit
33  		));
34  		return Ok(0);
35  	}
36  
37  	if args.check {
38  		ctx.log
39  			.result(format!("Update to {current_version} is available"));
40  		return Ok(0);
41  	}
42  
43  	let pb = ProgressBar::new(1);
44  	pb.set_message("Downloading...");
45  	update_service
46  		.do_update(&current_version, ProgressBarReporter::from(pb))
47  		.await?;
48  	ctx.log
49  		.result(format!("Successfully updated to {current_version}"));
50  
51  	Ok(0)
52  }

5  
6  use std::fs;
7  use std::path::{Component, Path, PathBuf};
8  
9  use super::errors::{wrap, WrappedError};
10  
11  /// Lexically normalizes a path, resolving `.` and `..` components without
12  /// touching the filesystem. Returns `None` if normalization would walk above
13  /// the path's root via a leading `..`.
14  fn lexically_normalize(path: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
15  	let mut out = PathBuf::new();
16  	for component in path.components() {
17  		match component {
18  			Component::Prefix(_) | Component::RootDir | Component::Normal(_) => {
19  				out.push(component);
20  			}
21  			Component::CurDir => {}
22  			Component::ParentDir => {
23  				if !out.pop() {
24  					return None;
25  				}
26  			}
27  		}
28  	}
29  	Some(out)
30  }
31  
32  /// Ensures the extraction root exists and returns its canonicalized form to
33  /// use as the reference for containment checks.
34  pub fn prepare_extraction_root(root: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, WrappedError> {
35  	fs::create_dir_all(root)
36  		.map_err(|e| wrap(e, format!("could not create extraction root {}", root.display())))?;
37  	fs::canonicalize(root).map_err(|e| {
38  		wrap(
39  			e,
40  			format!("could not canonicalize extraction root {}", root.display()),
41  		)
42  	})
43  }
44  
45  /// Joins an archive entry's relative path under `root_canonical` after
46  /// rejecting any entry that would land outside the root. Rejects empty
47  /// entries, absolute paths, drive prefixes, and `..` traversal that escapes
48  /// the root.
49  pub fn safe_extract_join(root_canonical: &Path, entry: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, WrappedError> {
50  	if entry.as_os_str().is_empty() {
51  		return Err(wrap(
52  			"empty extraction entry",
53  			"refusing to extract empty archive entry".to_string(),
54  		));
55  	}

6  import * as vscode from 'vscode';
7  import { DocumentSelector } from '../configuration/documentSelector';
8  import { API } from '../tsServer/api';
9  import * as typeConverters from '../typeConverters';
10  import { ClientCapability, ITypeScriptServiceClient } from '../typescriptService';
11  import { conditionalRegistration, requireMinVersion, requireSomeCapability } from './util/dependentRegistration';
12  
13  class LinkedEditingSupport implements vscode.LinkedEditingRangeProvider {
14  
15  	public static readonly minVersion = API.v510;
16  
17  	public constructor(
18  		private readonly client: ITypeScriptServiceClient
19  	) { }
20  
21  	async provideLinkedEditingRanges(document: vscode.TextDocument, position: vscode.Position, token: vscode.CancellationToken): Promise<vscode.LinkedEditingRanges | undefined> {
22  		const filepath = this.client.toOpenTsFilePath(document);
23  		if (!filepath) {
24  			return undefined;
25  		}
26  
27  		const args = typeConverters.Position.toFileLocationRequestArgs(filepath, position);
28  		const response = await this.client.execute('linkedEditingRange', args, token);
29  		if (response.type !== 'response' || !response.body) {
30  			return undefined;
31  		}
32  
33  		const wordPattern = response.body.wordPattern ? new RegExp(response.body.wordPattern) : undefined;
34  		return new vscode.LinkedEditingRanges(response.body.ranges.map(range => typeConverters.Range.fromTextSpan(range)), wordPattern);
35  	}
36  }
37  
38  export function register(
39  	selector: DocumentSelector,
40  	client: ITypeScriptServiceClient
41  ) {
42  	return conditionalRegistration([
43  		requireMinVersion(client, LinkedEditingSupport.minVersion),
44  		requireSomeCapability(client, ClientCapability.Syntax),
45  	], () => {
46  		return vscode.languages.registerLinkedEditingRangeProvider(selector.syntax,
47  			new LinkedEditingSupport(client));
48  	});
49  }

1  /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2   *  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
3   *  Licensed under the MIT License. See License.txt in the project root for license information.
4   *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
5  
6  import * as eslint from 'eslint';
7  import { join, dirname } from 'path';
8  import { createImportRuleListener } from './utils.ts';
9  
10  type Config = {
11  	allowed: Set<string>;
12  	disallowed: Set<string>;
13  };
14  
15  export default new class implements eslint.Rule.RuleModule {
16  
17  	readonly meta: eslint.Rule.RuleMetaData = {
18  		messages: {
19  			layerbreaker: 'Bad layering. You are not allowed to access {{from}} from here, allowed layers are: [{{allowed}}]'
20  		},
21  		docs: {
22  			url: 'https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/Source-Code-Organization'
23  		},
24  		schema: [
25  			{
26  				type: 'object',
27  				additionalProperties: {
28  					type: 'array',
29  					items: {
30  						type: 'string'
31  					}
32  				}
33  			}
34  		]
35  	};
36  
37  	create(context: eslint.Rule.RuleContext): eslint.Rule.RuleListener {
38  
39  		const fileDirname = dirname(context.filename);
40  		const parts = fileDirname.split(/\\|\//);
41  		const ruleArgs = context.options[0] as Record<string, string[]>;
42  		let config: Config | undefined;
43  		for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
44  			if (ruleArgs[parts[i]]) {
45  				config = {
46  					allowed: new Set(ruleArgs[parts[i]]).add(parts[i]),
47  					disallowed: new Set()
48  				};
49  				Object.keys(ruleArgs).forEach(key => {
50  					if (!config!.allowed.has(key)) {
51  						config!.disallowed.add(key);
52  					}
53  				});
54  				break;
55  			}
56  		}
57  
58  		if (!config) {
59  			// nothing
60  			return {};
61  		}
62  
63  		return createImportRuleListener((node, path) => {
64  			if (path[0] === '.') {
65  				path = join(dirname(context.filename), path);
66  			}
67  
68  			const parts = dirname(path).split(/\\|\//);
69  			for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70  				const part = parts[i];
71  
72  				if (config!.allowed.has(part)) {
73  					// GOOD - same layer
74  					break;
75  				}
76  
77  				if (config!.disallowed.has(part)) {
78  					// BAD - wrong layer
79  					context.report({
80  						loc: node.loc,
81  						messageId: 'layerbreaker',
82  						data: {
83  							from: part,
84  							allowed: [...config!.allowed.keys()].join(', ')
85  						}
86  					});
87  					break;
88  				}
89  			}
90  		});
91  	}
92  };

23  
24  const defaultFileName = 'chat.json';
25  const filters = [{ name: localize('chat.file.label', "Chat Session"), extensions: ['json'] }];
26  
27  /**
28   * Target location for importing a chat session.
29   * - 'chatViewPane': Opens in the chat view pane (sidebar/panel)
30   * - 'default': Opens in the active editor group
31   */
32  export type ChatImportTarget = 'chatViewPane' | 'default';
33  
34  export interface ChatImportOptions {
35  	inputPath?: URI;
36  	target?: ChatImportTarget;
37  }
38  
39  export function registerChatExportActions() {
40  	registerAction2(class ExportChatAction extends Action2 {
41  		constructor() {
42  			super({
43  				id: 'workbench.action.chat.export',
44  				category: CHAT_CATEGORY,
45  				title: localize2('chat.export.label', "Export Chat..."),
46  				precondition: ChatContextKeys.enabled,
47  				f1: true,
48  			});
49  		}
50  		async run(accessor: ServicesAccessor, outputPath?: URI) {
51  			const widgetService = accessor.get(IChatWidgetService);
52  			const fileDialogService = accessor.get(IFileDialogService);
53  			const fileService = accessor.get(IFileService);
54  			const chatService = accessor.get(IChatService);
55  
56  			const widget = widgetService.lastFocusedWidget;
57  			if (!widget || !widget.viewModel) {
58  				return;
59  			}
60  
61  			if (!outputPath) {
62  				const defaultUri = joinPath(await fileDialogService.defaultFilePath(), defaultFileName);
63  				const result = await fileDialogService.showSaveDialog({
64  					defaultUri,
65  					filters
66  				});
67  				if (!result) {
68  					return;
69  				}
70  				outputPath = result;
71  			}
72  
73  			const model = chatService.getSession(widget.viewModel.sessionResource);
74  			if (!model) {
75  				return;
76  			}
77  
78  			// Using toJSON on the model
79  			const content = VSBuffer.fromString(JSON.stringify(model.toExport(), undefined, 2));
80  			await fileService.writeFile(outputPath, content);
81  		}
82  	});
83  
84  	registerAction2(class ImportChatAction extends Action2 {
85  		constructor() {
86  			super({
87  				id: 'workbench.action.chat.import',
88  				title: localize2('chat.import.label', "Import Chat..."),
89  				category: CHAT_CATEGORY,
90  				precondition: ChatContextKeys.enabled,
91  				f1: true,
92  			});
93  		}
94  		async run(accessor: ServicesAccessor, opts?: ChatImportOptions) {
95  			const fileService = accessor.get(IFileService);
96  			const widgetService = accessor.get(IChatWidgetService);
97  			const chatService = accessor.get(IChatService);
98  			const fileDialogService = accessor.get(IFileDialogService);
99  
100  			let inputPath = opts?.inputPath;
101  			if (!inputPath) {
102  				const defaultUri = joinPath(await fileDialogService.defaultFilePath(), defaultFileName);
103  				const result = await fileDialogService.showOpenDialog({
104  					defaultUri,
105  					canSelectFiles: true,
106  					filters
107  				});
108  				if (!result) {
109  					return;
110  				}
111  				inputPath = result[0];
112  			}
113  
114  			const content = await fileService.readFile(inputPath);
115  			try {
116  				const data = revive(JSON.parse(content.value.toString()));
117  				if (!isExportableSessionData(data)) {
118  					throw new Error('Invalid chat session data');
119  				}
120  				const importedData = extractExportableSessionData(data);
121  
122  				let sessionResource: URI;
123  				let resolvedTarget: typeof ChatViewPaneTarget | PreferredGroup;
124  				let options: IChatEditorOptions;
125  
126  				if (opts?.target === 'chatViewPane') {
127  					const modelRef = chatService.loadSessionFromData(importedData, 'ChatImportExport#importToChatView');
128  					try {
129  						sessionResource = modelRef.object.sessionResource;
130  						resolvedTarget = ChatViewPaneTarget;
131  						options = { pinned: true };
132  						await widgetService.openSession(sessionResource, resolvedTarget, options);
133  					} finally {
134  						modelRef.dispose();
135  					}
136  				} else {
137  					sessionResource = ChatEditorInput.getNewEditorUri();
138  					resolvedTarget = ACTIVE_GROUP;
139  					options = { target: { data: importedData }, pinned: true };
140  					await widgetService.openSession(sessionResource, resolvedTarget, options);
141  				}
142  			} catch (err) {
143  				throw err;
144  			}
145  		}
146  	});
147  }

48  	run(accessor: ServicesAccessor, ...args: unknown[]) {

66  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
67  export function getEditingSessionContext(accessor: ServicesAccessor, args: any[]): EditingSessionActionContext | undefined {
68  	const arg0 = args.at(0);
69  	const context = isChatViewTitleActionContext(arg0) ? arg0 : undefined;
70  
71  	const chatWidgetService = accessor.get(IChatWidgetService);
72  	const chatEditingService = accessor.get(IChatEditingService);
73  	let chatWidget = context ? chatWidgetService.getWidgetBySessionResource(context.sessionResource) : undefined;
74  	if (!chatWidget) {
75  		chatWidget = chatWidgetService.lastFocusedWidget ?? chatWidgetService.getWidgetsByLocations(ChatAgentLocation.Chat).find(w => w.supportsChangingModes);
76  	}
77  
78  	if (!chatWidget?.viewModel) {
79  		return;
80  	}
81  
82  	const editingSession = chatEditingService.getEditingSession(chatWidget.viewModel.model.sessionResource);
83  	return { editingSession, chatWidget };
84  }

288  export async function discardAllEditsWithConfirmation(accessor: ServicesAccessor, currentEditingSession: IChatEditingSession): Promise<boolean> {
289  
290  	const dialogService = accessor.get(IDialogService);
291  
292  	// Ask for confirmation if there are any edits
293  	const entries = currentEditingSession.entries.get().filter(e => e.state.get() === ModifiedFileEntryState.Modified);
294  	if (entries.length > 0) {
295  		const confirmation = await dialogService.confirm({
296  			title: localize('chat.editing.discardAll.confirmation.title', "Undo all edits?"),
297  			message: entries.length === 1
298  				? localize('chat.editing.discardAll.confirmation.oneFile', "This will undo changes made in {0}. Do you want to proceed?", basename(entries[0].modifiedURI))
299  				: localize('chat.editing.discardAll.confirmation.manyFiles', "This will undo changes made in {0} files. Do you want to proceed?", entries.length),
300  			primaryButton: localize('chat.editing.discardAll.confirmation.primaryButton', "Yes"),
301  			type: 'info'
302  		});
303  		if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
304  			return false;
305  		}
306  	}
307  
308  	await currentEditingSession.reject();
309  	return true;
310  }

425  	private _assertNotDisposed(): void {

431  	async accept(...uris: URI[]): Promise<void> {
432  		if (await this._operateEntry('accept', uris)) {
433  			this._accessibilitySignalService.playSignal(AccessibilitySignal.editsKept, { allowManyInParallel: true });
434  		}
435  
436  	}
437  
438  	async reject(...uris: URI[]): Promise<void> {
439  		if (await this._operateEntry('reject', uris)) {
440  			this._accessibilitySignalService.playSignal(AccessibilitySignal.editsUndone, { allowManyInParallel: true });
441  		}
442  	}
443  
444  	private async _operateEntry(action: 'accept' | 'reject', uris: URI[]): Promise<number> {
445  		this._assertNotDisposed();
446  
447  		const applicableEntries = this._entriesObs.get()
448  			.filter(e => uris.length === 0 || uris.some(u => isEqual(u, e.modifiedURI)))
449  			.filter(e => !e.isCurrentlyBeingModifiedBy.get())
450  			.filter(e => e.state.get() === ModifiedFileEntryState.Modified);
451  
452  		if (applicableEntries.length === 0) {
453  			return 0;
454  		}
455  
456  		// Perform all I/O operations in parallel, each resolving to a state transition callback
457  		const method = action === 'accept' ? 'acceptDeferred' : 'rejectDeferred';
458  		const transitionCallbacks = await Promise.all(
459  			applicableEntries.map(entry => entry[method]().catch(err => {
460  				this._logService.error(`Error calling ${method} on entry ${entry.modifiedURI}`, err);
461  			}))
462  		);
463  
464  		// Execute all state transitions atomically in a single transaction
465  		transaction(tx => {
466  			transitionCallbacks.forEach(callback => callback?.(tx));
467  		});
468  
469  		return applicableEntries.length;
470  	}

477  			} else if (this._editorPane.input) {

156  	private _maybeResolveDirectoryImageCount(attachment: IChatRequestVariableEntry): void {
157  		// Resolve the folder's image count asynchronously so the UI can warn when
158  		// it exceeds the model's per-request image limit. Skip if already resolved.
159  		if (attachment.kind !== 'directory' || typeof attachment.imageCount === 'number' || !URI.isUri(attachment.value)) {
160  			return;
161  		}
162  		const uri = attachment.value;
163  		this.chatAttachmentResolveService.resolveDirectoryImages(uri).then(images => {
164  			const current = this._attachments.get(attachment.id);
165  			if (current && current.kind === 'directory' && current.value?.toString() === uri.toString()) {
166  				this.updateContext(Iterable.empty(), [{ ...current, imageCount: images.length }]);
167  			}
168  		}, () => { /* ignore */ });
169  	}
170  
171  	private _watchAttachment(attachment: IChatRequestVariableEntry): void {
172  		const uri = IChatRequestVariableEntry.toUri(attachment);
173  		if (!uri || uri.scheme !== Schemas.file) {
174  			return;
175  		}
176  
177  		const watcher = this.fileService.createWatcher(uri, { recursive: false, excludes: [] });
178  		const onDidChangeListener = watcher.onDidChange(e => {
179  			if (e.contains(uri, FileChangeType.DELETED)) {
180  				this.updateContext([attachment.id], Iterable.empty());
181  			}
182  		});
183  
184  		this._fileWatchers.set(attachment.id, combinedDisposable(onDidChangeListener, watcher));
185  	}

195  		};
196  	}

198  	// Gets an image variable for a given URI, which may be a file or a web URL
199  	async asImageVariableEntry(uri: URI): Promise<IChatRequestVariableEntry | undefined> {
200  		if (uri.scheme === Schemas.file && await this.fileService.canHandleResource(uri)) {
201  			return await this.chatAttachmentResolveService.resolveImageEditorAttachContext(uri);
202  		} else if (uri.scheme === Schemas.http || uri.scheme === Schemas.https) {
203  			const extractedImages = await this.webContentExtractorService.readImage(uri, CancellationToken.None);
204  			if (extractedImages) {
205  				return await this.chatAttachmentResolveService.resolveImageEditorAttachContext(uri, extractedImages);
206  			}
207  		}
208  
209  		return undefined;
210  	}

268  			return pending;
269  		}
270  
271  		const forkPromise = (async () => {
272  			const cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
273  			try {
274  				const forkedItem = await chatSessionsService.forkChatSession(sourceSessionResource, request, cts.token);
275  				const open = () => this._openForkedSession(instantiationService, sourceSessionResource, forkedItem.resource);
276  				if (openForkedSessionImmediately) {
277  					await open();
278  				} else {
279  					setTimeout(open, 0);
280  				}
281  			} finally {
282  				cts.dispose();
283  			}
284  		})();
285  
286  		this.pendingFork.set(pendingKey, forkPromise);
287  		try {
288  			await forkPromise;
289  		} finally {
290  			this.pendingFork.delete(pendingKey);
291  		}
292  	}
293  }

8  const cp = require('child_process');
9  const path = require('path');
10  const minimist = require('minimist');
11  
12  async function main() {
13  	const args = minimist(process.argv.slice(2), {
14  		boolean: ['help', 'enable-mock-agent', 'quiet', 'without-connection-token'],
15  		string: ['port', 'host', 'log', 'connection-token', 'connection-token-file'],
16  	});
17  
18  	if (args.help) {
19  		console.log(
20  			'Usage: ./scripts/code-agent-host.sh [options]\n' +
21  			'\n' +
22  			'Options:\n' +
23  			'  --port <number>                Port to listen on (default: 8081, or VSCODE_AGENT_HOST_PORT env)\n' +
24  			'  --host <host>                  Host/IP to bind to (default: 127.0.0.1, use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)\n' +
25  			'  --connection-token <token>      A secret that must be included with all requests\n' +
26  			'  --connection-token-file <path>  Path to a file containing the connection token\n' +
27  			'  --without-connection-token      Run without a connection token\n' +
28  			'  --enable-mock-agent            Enable the mock agent for testing\n' +
29  			'  --quiet                        Suppress logging output\n' +
30  			'  --log <level>                  Log level to use (trace, debug, info, warning, error, off)\n' +
31  			'  --help                         Show this help message',
32  		);
33  		return;
34  	}
35  
36  	const port = args.port || process.env['VSCODE_AGENT_HOST_PORT'] || '8081';
37  
38  	/** @type {string[]} */
39  	const serverArgs = ['--port', String(port)];
40  	if (args.host) {
41  		serverArgs.push('--host', String(args.host));
42  	}
43  	if (args['enable-mock-agent']) {
44  		serverArgs.push('--enable-mock-agent');
45  	}
46  	if (args.quiet) {
47  		serverArgs.push('--quiet');
48  	}
49  	if (args.log) {
50  		serverArgs.push('--log', String(args.log));
51  	}
52  	if (args['connection-token']) {
53  		serverArgs.push('--connection-token', String(args['connection-token']));
54  	}
55  	if (args['connection-token-file']) {
56  		serverArgs.push('--connection-token-file', String(args['connection-token-file']));
57  	}
58  	if (args['without-connection-token']) {
59  		serverArgs.push('--without-connection-token');
60  	}
61  
62  	await startServer(serverArgs);
63  }
64  
65  /**
66   * @param {string[]} programArgs
67   * @returns {Promise<void>}
68   */
69  function startServer(programArgs) {
70  	return new Promise((resolve) => {
71  		const env = { ...process.env };
72  		const entryPoint = path.join(
73  			__dirname,
74  			'..',
75  			'out',
76  			'vs',
77  			'platform',
78  			'agentHost',
79  			'node',
80  			'agentHostServerMain.js',
81  		);
82  
83  		console.log(
84  			`Starting agent host server: ${entryPoint} ${programArgs.join(' ')}`,
85  		);
86  		const proc = cp.spawn(process.execPath, [entryPoint, ...programArgs], {
87  			env,
88  			stdio: [process.stdin, null, process.stderr],
89  		});
90  		proc.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
91  			const text = data.toString();
92  			process.stdout.write(text);
93  			const m = text.match(/READY:(\d+)/);
94  			if (m) {
95  				resolve();
96  			}
97  		});
98  
99  		proc.on('exit', (code) => process.exit(code));
100  
101  		process.on('exit', () => proc.kill());
102  		process.on('SIGINT', () => {
103  			proc.kill();
104  			process.exit(128 + 2);
105  		});
106  		process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
107  			proc.kill();
108  			process.exit(128 + 15);
109  		});
110  	});
111  }
112  
113  main();

87  		@ICompletionsCopilotTokenManager private readonly copilotTokenManager: ICompletionsCopilotTokenManager,
88  		@ILogService logService: ILogService,

94  		this.inlineEditLogger = this.instantiationService.createInstance(InlineEditLogger);
95  		this.telemetrySender = this.instantiationService.createInstance(TelemetrySender, undefined);

97  	}

99  	async provideInlineCompletionItems(
100  		doc: TextDocument,
101  		position: Position,
102  		context: InlineCompletionContext,
103  		token: CancellationToken
104  	): Promise<GhostTextCompletionList | undefined> {
105  
106  		if (context.triggerKind === InlineCompletionTriggerKind.Automatic && env.isMeteredConnection) {
107  			return;
108  		}
109  
110  		// it's ok to return an undefined here because we don't want telemetry for when automatic completions are disabled
111  		if (context.triggerKind === InlineCompletionTriggerKind.Automatic) {
112  			if (!this.instantiationService.invokeFunction(isCompletionEnabledForDocument, doc)) {
113  				return;
114  			}
115  			if (this.extensionStatusService.kind === 'Error') {
116  				return;
117  			}
118  		}
119  
120  		const sw = new StopWatch();
121  
122  		const label = `Ghost | ${basename(doc.uri.toString())} (v${doc.version})`;
123  
124  		const capturingToken = new CapturingToken(label, undefined);
125  
126  		return await this.requestLogger.captureInvocation(capturingToken, async () => {
127  
128  			const logContext = new GhostTextLogContext(doc.uri.toString(), doc.version, context);
129  			this.inlineEditLogger.addLive(logContext);
130  
131  			const logger = this.logger.createSubLogger('provideInlineCompletionItems').withExtraTarget(LogTarget.fromCallback((_level, msg) => {
132  				logContext.trace(`[${Math.floor(sw.elapsed()).toString().padStart(4, ' ')}ms] ${msg}`);
133  			}));
134  
135  			const telemetryBuilder = this.createTelemetryBuilder();
136  			telemetryBuilder.setOpportunityId(context.requestUuid);
137  
138  			try {
139  				logger.trace('Started providing inline completion items');
140  				return await this._provideInlineCompletionItems(doc, position, context, telemetryBuilder, logContext, logger, token);
141  			} catch (e) {
142  				logContext.setError(e);
143  				this.telemetryService.sendGHTelemetryException(e, 'codeUnification.completions.exception');
144  				const emptyList = { items: [], telemetryBuilder }; // we need to return an empty list, such that vscode invokes endOfLife on it and we send telemetry
145  				return emptyList;
146  			} finally {
147  				logContext.markCompleted();
148  				telemetryBuilder.nesBuilder.markEndTime();
149  			}
150  		});
151  	}

153  	private async _provideInlineCompletionItems(
154  		doc: TextDocument,
155  		position: Position,

253  		logContext: GhostTextLogContext,
254  		doc: TextDocument,
255  		items: InlineCompletionList
256  	) {
257  		if (items.items.length === 0) {
258  			logContext.markAsNoSuggestions();

264  			logContext.addLog('Inline completion item has no range');
265  			return;
266  		}
267  		if (typeof firstItem.insertText !== 'string') {
268  			logContext.addLog('Inline completion item has non-string insertText');
269  			return;
270  		}
271  
272  		const text = new LineBasedText(lineNumber => doc.lineAt(lineNumber - 1).text, doc.lineCount);
273  
274  		const lineEdit = LineEdit.fromTextEdit(
275  			new TextEdit(
276  				[new TextReplacement(
277  					new Range(firstItem.range.start.line + 1, firstItem.range.start.character + 1, firstItem.range.end.line + 1, firstItem.range.end.character + 1),
278  					firstItem.insertText,
279  				)],
280  			),
281  			text
282  		);
283  
284  		const patch = lineEdit.humanReadablePatch(text.getLines());
285  
286  		logContext.setResult(patch);
287  	}

290  		return new NextEditProviderTelemetryBuilder(
291  			undefined,
292  			undefined,
293  			undefined,
294  			'ghostText',
295  			undefined
296  		);
297  	}

259  	protected async acceptSolution(solution: TPanelCompletion, closePanel: boolean = true) {
260  		if (this._isDisposed === false && solution?.range) {
261  			const edit = new WorkspaceEdit();
262  			edit.replace(this.#documentUri, solution.range, solution.insertText);
263  			await workspace.applyEdit(edit);
264  			this.#cts.cancel();
265  			if (closePanel) {

283  	protected async renderSolutions() {
284  		const highlighter = await this.#highlighter;
285  		const content = this.#items.map(item => {
286  			const firstCitation = item.copilotAnnotations?.ip_code_citations?.[0];
287  			const details = firstCitation?.details.citations as IPCitationDetail[] | undefined;
288  			let renderedCitatation: { message: string; url: string } | undefined;
289  			if (details && details.length > 0) {
290  				const licensesSet = new Set(details.map(d => d.license));
291  				if (licensesSet.has('NOASSERTION')) {
292  					licensesSet.delete('NOASSERTION');
293  					licensesSet.add('unknown');
294  				}
295  				const allLicenses = Array.from(licensesSet).sort();
296  				const licenseString = allLicenses.length === 1 ? allLicenses[0] : `[${allLicenses.join(', ')}]`;
297  				renderedCitatation = {
298  					message: `Similar code with ${pluralize(allLicenses.length, 'license type')} ${licenseString} detected.`,
299  					url: details[0].url,
300  				};
301  			}
302  
303  			const baseContent = {
304  				htmlSnippet: highlighter.createSnippet(item.insertText.trim()),
305  				citation: renderedCitatation,
306  			};
307  
308  			return this.renderSolutionContent(item, baseContent);
309  		});
310  
311  		const message = this.createSolutionsMessage(content, this.#percentage);
312  		await this.postMessage(message);
313  	}

315  	// Subclasses must implement this to create their specific message format

317  
318  	render = debounce(10, () => this.renderSolutions());
319  
320  	postMessage(message: unknown) {
321  		if (this._isDisposed === false) {
322  			return this.webviewPanel.webview.postMessage(message);
323  		}
324  	}
325  
326  	private _dispose() {
327  		this._isDisposed = true;
328  		this._onDidDispose.fire();
329  		this.suggestionsPanelManager.decrementPanelCount();
330  		while (this._disposables.length) {
331  			const disposable = this._disposables.pop();
332  			if (disposable) {
333  				disposable.dispose();
334  			}
335  		}
336  		this._onDidDispose.dispose();
337  	}

79  	 * Absolute path to the **SDK root directory** that contains
80  	 * `node_modules/@openai/codex`. Acts as the dev override for the Codex
81  	 * agent; empty falls through to `product.agentSdks.codex`.
82  	 */
83  	readonly codexSdkRoot: string;
84  	readonly quiet: boolean;
85  	/** Connection token string, or `undefined` when `--without-connection-token`. */
86  	readonly connectionToken: string | undefined;
87  }
88  
89  function parseServerOptions(): IServerOptions {
90  	const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
91  	const envPort = parseInt(process.env['VSCODE_AGENT_HOST_PORT'] ?? '8081', 10);
92  	const portIdx = argv.indexOf('--port');
93  	const port = portIdx >= 0 ? parseInt(argv[portIdx + 1], 10) : envPort;
94  	const hostIdx = argv.indexOf('--host');
95  	const host = hostIdx >= 0 ? argv[hostIdx + 1] : undefined;
96  	const enableMockAgent = argv.includes('--enable-mock-agent');
97  	// `--claude-sdk-root` and `--codex-sdk-root` are dev overrides — they
98  	// short-circuit the on-demand download from `product.agentSdks`. They must
99  	// point at an SDK ROOT DIRECTORY (the parent of `node_modules/`), not the
100  	// package directory or the binary file itself. Required in air-gapped
101  	// deployments where the CDN is unreachable AND no product config is
102  	// present; in those environments, set one of these flags or the matching
103  	// env var, otherwise the corresponding provider will not register.
104  	const claudeSdkRootIdx = argv.indexOf('--claude-sdk-root');
105  	const claudeSdkRoot = (claudeSdkRootIdx >= 0 ? argv[claudeSdkRootIdx + 1] : process.env[AgentHostClaudeSdkRootEnvVar]) ?? '';
106  	const codexSdkRootIdx = argv.indexOf('--codex-sdk-root');
107  	const codexSdkRoot = (codexSdkRootIdx >= 0 ? argv[codexSdkRootIdx + 1] : process.env[AgentHostCodexAgentSdkRootEnvVar]) ?? '';
108  	const quiet = argv.includes('--quiet');
109  
110  	// Connection token
111  	const withoutConnectionToken = argv.includes('--without-connection-token');
112  	const connectionTokenIdx = argv.indexOf('--connection-token');
113  	const connectionTokenFileIdx = argv.indexOf('--connection-token-file');
114  	const rawToken = connectionTokenIdx >= 0 ? argv[connectionTokenIdx + 1] : undefined;
115  	const tokenFilePath = connectionTokenFileIdx >= 0 ? argv[connectionTokenFileIdx + 1] : undefined;
116  
117  	let connectionToken: string | undefined;
118  	if (withoutConnectionToken) {
119  		if (rawToken !== undefined || tokenFilePath !== undefined) {
120  			log('Error: --without-connection-token cannot be used with --connection-token or --connection-token-file');
121  			process.exit(1);
122  		}
123  		connectionToken = undefined;
124  	} else if (tokenFilePath !== undefined) {
125  		if (rawToken !== undefined) {
126  			log('Error: --connection-token cannot be used with --connection-token-file');
127  			process.exit(1);
128  		}
129  		try {
130  			connectionToken = fs.readFileSync(tokenFilePath).toString().replace(/\r?\n$/, '');
131  		} catch {
132  			log(`Error: Unable to read connection token file at '${tokenFilePath}'`);
133  			process.exit(1);
134  		}
135  		if (!connectionTokenRegex.test(connectionToken!)) {
136  			log(`Error: The connection token in '${tokenFilePath}' does not adhere to the characters 0-9, a-z, A-Z, _, or -.`);
137  			process.exit(1);
138  		}
139  	} else if (rawToken !== undefined) {
140  		if (!connectionTokenRegex.test(rawToken)) {
141  			log(`Error: The connection token '${rawToken}' does not adhere to the characters 0-9, a-z, A-Z, _, or -.`);
142  			process.exit(1);
143  		}
144  		connectionToken = rawToken;
145  	} else {
146  		// Default: generate a random token (secure by default)
147  		connectionToken = generateUuid();
148  	}
149  
150  	return { port, host, enableMockAgent, claudeSdkRoot, codexSdkRoot, quiet, connectionToken };

335  	// Report ready
336  	function reportReady(addr: string): void {
337  		const listeningPort = Number(addr.split(':').pop());
338  		process.stdout.write(`READY:${listeningPort}\n`);
339  		agentService.markStartupComplete();
340  
341  		const urls = resolveServerUrls(options.host, listeningPort);
342  		for (const url of urls.local) {
343  			log(`  Local:   ${url}`);
344  			logService.info(`[AgentHostServer] Local:   ${url}`);
345  		}
346  		for (const url of urls.network) {
347  			log(`  Network: ${url}`);
348  			logService.info(`[AgentHostServer] Network: ${url}`);
349  		}
350  		if (urls.network.length === 0 && options.host === undefined) {

352  			logService.info('[AgentHostServer] Network: use --host to expose');
353  		}
354  	}

356  	const address = wsServer.address;
357  	if (address) {
358  		reportReady(address);
359  	} else {
360  		const interval = setInterval(() => {
361  			const addr = wsServer.address;
362  			if (addr) {
363  				clearInterval(interval);
364  				reportReady(addr);
365  			}
366  		}, 10);
367  	}
368  
369  	// Keep alive until stdin closes or signal
370  	process.stdin.resume();
371  	process.stdin.on('end', () => { void shutdown(); });
372  	process.on('SIGTERM', () => { void shutdown(); });
373  	process.on('SIGINT', () => { void shutdown(); });
374  
375  	let shuttingDown = false;
376  	async function shutdown(): Promise<void> {
377  		if (shuttingDown) {
378  			return;
379  		}
380  		shuttingDown = true;
381  		logService.info('[AgentHostServer] Shutting down...');
382  		// Stop protocol ingress before draining requests so no late action can
383  		// race provider shutdown or queue persistence after the idle check.
384  		protocolHandler.dispose();
385  		wsServer.dispose();
386  		// Providers such as Claude finish writing their transcripts during
387  		// shutdown, so drain them before waiting for persistence to go idle.
388  		await shutdownAgentHostBeforeDispose(
389  			() => protocolHandler.whenIdle(),
390  			() => agentService.shutdown(),
391  			() => [sessionDataService.whenIdle(), customizationEnablementService.whenIdle()],
392  			4500,
393  			logService,
394  		);
395  		disposables.dispose();
396  		loggerService?.dispose();
397  		process.exit(0);
398  	}
399  }

18  /**
19   * Citation manager that logs citations to the VS Code log. On the first citation encountered,
20   * the user gets a notification.
21   */
22  export class LoggingCitationManager extends Disposable implements ICompletionsCitationManager {
23  	declare _serviceBrand: undefined;
24  
25  	private logger?: GitHubCopilotLogger;
26  	private readonly codeReference: CodeReference;
27  
28  	constructor(
29  		@IInstantiationService private readonly instantiationService: IInstantiationService,
30  		@IAuthenticationService authenticationService: IAuthenticationService,
31  	) {
32  		super();
33  		this.codeReference = this._register(this.instantiationService.createInstance(CodeReference));
34  		const disposable = onCopilotToken(authenticationService, _ => {
35  			if (this.logger) {
36  				return;
37  			}
38  			this.logger = instantiationService.createInstance(GitHubCopilotLogger);
39  			const initialNotificationCommand = commands.registerCommand(OutputPaneShowCommand, () =>
40  				this.logger?.forceShow()
41  			);
42  			this.codeReference.addDisposable(initialNotificationCommand);
43  		});
44  		this.codeReference.addDisposable(disposable);
45  	}
46  
47  	register() {
48  		return this.codeReference.register();
49  	}
50  
51  	async handleIPCodeCitation(citation: IPDocumentCitation): Promise<void> {
52  		if (!this.codeReference.enabled || !this.logger || citation.details.length === 0) {
53  			return;
54  		}
55  
56  		const start = citation.location?.start;
57  		const matchLocation = start ? `[Ln ${start.line + 1}, Col ${start.character + 1}]` : 'Location not available';
58  		const shortenedMatchText = `${citation.matchingText
59  			?.slice(0, 100)
60  			.replace(/[\r\n\t]+|^[ \t]+/gm, ' ')
61  			.trim()}...`;
62  
63  		this.logger.info(citation.inDocumentUri, `Similar code at `, matchLocation, shortenedMatchText);
64  		for (const detail of citation.details) {
65  			const { license, url } = detail;
66  			this.logger.info(`License: ${license.replace('NOASSERTION', 'unknown')}, URL: ${url}`);
67  		}
68  		copilotOutputLogTelemetry.handleWrite({ instantiationService: this.instantiationService });
69  		await this.instantiationService.invokeFunction(notify);
70  	}
71  }
