16  function isError(payload: unknown): payload is MatchError {
17  	return Value.Check(MatchError, payload);
18  }
19  
20  async function snippyRequest<T>(accessor: ServicesAccessor, requestFn: () => T): Promise<ReturnType<typeof requestFn> | undefined> {
21  	const instantiationService = accessor.get(IInstantiationService);
22  	const res = await requestFn();
23  
24  	if (isError(res)) {
25  		snippyTelemetry.handleSnippyNetworkError({
26  			instantiationService,
27  			origin: String(res.code),
28  			reason: res.reason,
29  			message: res.msg,
30  		});
31  
32  		return;
33  	}
34  
35  	return res;
36  }
37  
38  function isMatchError<T extends object>(response: T | MatchError): response is MatchError {
39  	return 'kind' in response && response.kind === 'failure';
40  }
41  
42  export async function fetchCitations(accessor: ServicesAccessor, uri: string, completionText: string, insertionOffset: number) {
43  	const instantiationService = accessor.get(IInstantiationService);
44  	const logTarget = accessor.get(ICompletionsLogTargetService);
45  	const documentManager = accessor.get(ICompletionsTextDocumentManagerService);
46  	const citationManager = accessor.get(ICompletionsCitationManager);
47  	const insertionDoc = await documentManager.getTextDocument({ uri });
48  
49  	// If the match occurred in a file that no longer exists, bail.
50  	if (!insertionDoc) {
51  		codeReferenceLogger.debug(logTarget, `Expected document matching ${uri}, got nothing.`);
52  		return;
53  	}
54  
55  	// The document text will include the completion at this point
56  	const docText = insertionDoc.getText();
57  
58  	// If the document + the completion isn't long enough, we know we shouldn't call snippy
59  	if (!SnippyCompute.hasMinLexemeLength(docText)) {
60  		return;
61  	}
62  
63  	// If the document + the completion isn't long enough, we know we shouldn't call snippy
64  	if (!SnippyCompute.hasMinLexemeLength(docText)) {
65  		return;
66  	}
67  
68  	let potentialMatchContext = completionText;
69  
70  	// In many cases, we will get completion that is shorter than 65 tokens,
71  	// e.g. a single line or word completion.
72  	// When a completion is too short, we should try and get the preceding tokens and
73  	// pass that to snippy as part of the context.
74  	if (!SnippyCompute.hasMinLexemeLength(completionText)) {
75  		const textWithoutCompletion = docText.slice(0, insertionOffset);
76  		const minLexemeStartOffset = SnippyCompute.offsetLastLexemes(
77  			textWithoutCompletion,
78  			SnippyCompute.MinTokenLength
79  		);
80  		potentialMatchContext = docText.slice(minLexemeStartOffset, insertionOffset + completionText.length);
81  	}
82  
83  	// Depending on where in the document the suggestion was inserted, we may still not have enough context
84  	// to detect a match.
85  	if (!SnippyCompute.hasMinLexemeLength(potentialMatchContext)) {
86  		return;
87  	}
88  
89  	const matchResponse = await instantiationService.invokeFunction(acc => snippyRequest(acc, () => Snippy.Match(acc, potentialMatchContext)));
90  
91  	if (!matchResponse || isMatchError(matchResponse) || !matchResponse.snippets.length) {
92  		// No match response from Snippy
93  		codeReferenceLogger.info(logTarget, 'No match found');
94  		return;
95  	}
96  
97  	codeReferenceLogger.info(logTarget, 'Match found');
98  
99  	const { snippets } = matchResponse;
100  
101  	const citationPromises = snippets.map(async snippet => {
102  		const response = await instantiationService.invokeFunction(acc => snippyRequest(acc, () => Snippy.FilesForMatch(acc, { cursor: snippet.cursor })));
103  
104  		if (!response || isMatchError(response)) {
105  			return;
106  		}
107  
108  		const files = response.file_matches;
109  		const licenseStats = response.license_stats;
110  
111  		return {
112  			match: snippet,
113  			files,
114  			licenseStats,
115  		};
116  	});
117  
118  	const citations = await Promise.all(citationPromises);
119  	const filtered = citations.filter(c => c !== undefined);
120  	// This shouldn't ever happen, but we should handle it nonetheless.
121  	if (!filtered.length) {
122  		return;
123  	}
124  
125  	for (const citation of filtered) {
126  		const licensesSet = new Set(Object.keys(citation.licenseStats?.count ?? {}));
127  
128  		if (licensesSet.has('NOASSERTION')) {
129  			licensesSet.delete('NOASSERTION');
130  			licensesSet.add('unknown');
131  		}
132  
133  		const allLicenses = Array.from(licensesSet).sort();
134  
135  		const offsetStart = insertionOffset;
136  		const offsetEnd = insertionOffset + citation.match.matched_source.length;
137  
138  		const start = insertionDoc.positionAt(offsetStart);
139  		const end = insertionDoc.positionAt(offsetEnd);
140  		await citationManager.handleIPCodeCitation({
141  			inDocumentUri: uri,
142  			offsetStart,
143  			offsetEnd,
144  			version: insertionDoc.version,
145  			location: { start, end },
146  			matchingText: potentialMatchContext,
147  			details: allLicenses.map(license => ({
148  				license,
149  				url: citation.match.github_url,
150  			})),
151  		});
152  	}
153  }

1  #!/usr/bin/env sh
2  #
3  # Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
4  # Licensed under the MIT License. See License.txt in the project root for license information.
5  
6  # when run in remote terminal, use the remote cli
7  if [ -n "$VSCODE_IPC_HOOK_CLI" ]; then
8  	REMOTE_CLI="$(which -a '@@APPNAME@@' | grep /remote-cli/)"
9  	if [ -n "$REMOTE_CLI" ]; then
10  		"$REMOTE_CLI" "$@"
11  		exit $?
12  	fi
13  fi
14  
15  # test that VSCode wasn't installed inside WSL
16  if grep -qi Microsoft /proc/version && [ -z "$DONT_PROMPT_WSL_INSTALL" ]; then
17  	echo "To use @@PRODNAME@@ with the Windows Subsystem for Linux, please install @@PRODNAME@@ in Windows and uninstall the Linux version in WSL. You can then use the \`@@APPNAME@@\` command in a WSL terminal just as you would in a normal command prompt." 1>&2
18  	printf "Do you want to continue anyway? [y/N] " 1>&2
19  	read -r YN
20  	YN=$(printf '%s' "$YN" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
21  	case "$YN" in
22  		y | yes )
23  		;;
24  		* )
25  			exit 1
26  		;;
27  	esac
28  	echo "To no longer see this prompt, start @@PRODNAME@@ with the environment variable DONT_PROMPT_WSL_INSTALL defined." 1>&2
29  fi
30  
31  # If root, ensure that --user-data-dir or --file-write is specified
32  if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
33  	for i in "$@"
34  	do
35  		case "$i" in
36  			--user-data-dir | --user-data-dir=* | --file-write | tunnel | serve-web )
37  				CAN_LAUNCH_AS_ROOT=1
38  			;;
39  		esac
40  	done
41  	if [ -z $CAN_LAUNCH_AS_ROOT ]; then
42  		echo "You are trying to start @@PRODNAME@@ as a super user which isn't recommended. If this was intended, please add the argument \`--no-sandbox\` and specify an alternate user data directory using the \`--user-data-dir\` argument." 1>&2
43  		exit 1
44  	fi
45  fi
46  
47  if [ ! -L "$0" ]; then
48  	# if path is not a symlink, find relatively
49  	VSCODE_PATH="$(dirname "$0")/.."
50  else
51  	if command -v readlink >/dev/null; then
52  		# if readlink exists, follow the symlink and find relatively
53  		VSCODE_PATH="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/.."
54  	else
55  		# else use the standard install location
56  		VSCODE_PATH="/usr/share/@@APPNAME@@"
57  	fi
58  fi
59  
60  ELECTRON="$VSCODE_PATH/@@APPNAME@@"
61  CLI="$VSCODE_PATH/resources/app/out/cli.js"
62  ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "$ELECTRON" "$CLI" "$@"
63  exit $?

399  async function openInBrowser(args: string[], verbose: boolean) {
400  	const uris: string[] = [];
401  	for (const location of args) {
402  		try {
403  			if (/^[a-z-]+:\/\/.+/.test(location)) {
404  				uris.push(new URL(location).href);
405  			} else {
406  				uris.push(pathToURI(location).href);
407  			}
408  		} catch (e) {
409  			console.log(`Invalid url: ${location}`);
410  		}
411  	}
412  	if (uris.length) {
413  		await sendToPipe({
414  			type: 'openExternal',
415  			uris
416  		}, verbose).catch(e => {
417  			console.error('Error when invoking the open external command:', e);
418  		});
419  	}
420  }
421  
422  async function sendToPipe(args: PipeCommand, verbose: boolean): Promise<string> {
423  	const http = await import('http');
424  	if (verbose) {
425  		console.log(JSON.stringify(args, null, '  '));
426  	}
427  	return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
428  		const message = JSON.stringify(args);
429  		if (!cliPipe) {
430  			console.log('Message ' + message);
431  			resolve('');
432  			return;
433  		}
434  
435  		const opts: http.RequestOptions = {
436  			socketPath: cliPipe,
437  			path: '/',
438  			method: 'POST',
439  			headers: {
440  				'content-type': 'application/json',
441  				'accept': 'application/json'
442  			}
443  		};
444  
445  		const req = http.request(opts, res => {
446  			if (res.headers['content-type'] !== 'application/json') {
447  				reject('Error in response: Invalid content type: Expected \'application/json\', is: ' + res.headers['content-type']);
448  				return;
449  			}
450  
451  			const chunks: string[] = [];
452  			res.setEncoding('utf8');
453  			res.on('data', chunk => {
454  				chunks.push(chunk);
455  			});
456  			res.on('error', (err) => fatal('Error in response.', err));
457  			res.on('end', () => {
458  				const content = chunks.join('');
459  				try {
460  					const obj = JSON.parse(content);
461  					if (res.statusCode === 200) {
462  						resolve(obj);
463  					} else {
464  						reject(obj);
465  					}
466  				} catch (e) {
467  					reject('Error in response: Unable to parse response as JSON: ' + content);
468  				}
469  			});
470  		});
471  
472  		req.on('error', (err) => fatal('Error in request.', err));
473  		req.write(message);
474  		req.end();
475  	});
476  }

356  	protected async restoreBackups(handler: IWorkingCopyEditorHandler): Promise<void> {
357  
358  		// Wait for backups to be resolved
359  		await this.whenReady;
360  
361  		// Figure out already opened editors for backups vs
362  		// non-opened.
363  		const openedEditorsForBackups = new Set<EditorInput>();
364  		const nonOpenedEditorsForBackups = new Set<EditorInput>();
365  
366  		// Ensure each backup that can be handled has an
367  		// associated editor.
368  		const restoredBackups = new Set<IWorkingCopyIdentifier>();
369  		for (const unrestoredBackup of this.unrestoredBackups) {
370  			const canHandleUnrestoredBackup = await handler.handles(unrestoredBackup);
371  			if (!canHandleUnrestoredBackup) {
372  				continue;
373  			}
374  
375  			// Collect already opened editors for backup
376  			let hasOpenedEditorForBackup = false;
377  			for (const { editor } of this.editorService.getEditors(EditorsOrder.MOST_RECENTLY_ACTIVE)) {
378  				const isUnrestoredBackupOpened = handler.isOpen(unrestoredBackup, editor);
379  				if (isUnrestoredBackupOpened) {
380  					openedEditorsForBackups.add(editor);
381  					hasOpenedEditorForBackup = true;
382  				}
383  			}
384  
385  			// Otherwise, make sure to create at least one editor
386  			// for the backup to show
387  			if (!hasOpenedEditorForBackup) {
388  				nonOpenedEditorsForBackups.add(await handler.createEditor(unrestoredBackup));
389  			}
390  
391  			// Remember as (potentially) restored
392  			restoredBackups.add(unrestoredBackup);
393  		}
394  
395  		// Ensure editors are opened for each backup without editor
396  		// in the background without stealing focus
397  		if (nonOpenedEditorsForBackups.size > 0) {
398  			await this.editorService.openEditors([...nonOpenedEditorsForBackups].map(nonOpenedEditorForBackup => ({
399  				editor: nonOpenedEditorForBackup,
400  				options: {
401  					pinned: true,
402  					preserveFocus: true,
403  					inactive: true
404  				}
405  			})));
406  
407  			for (const nonOpenedEditorForBackup of nonOpenedEditorsForBackups) {
408  				openedEditorsForBackups.add(nonOpenedEditorForBackup);
409  			}
410  		}
411  
412  		// Then, resolve each opened editor to make sure the working copy
413  		// is loaded and the modified editor appears properly.
414  		// We only do that for editors that are not active in a group
415  		// already to prevent calling `resolve` twice!
416  		await Promises.settled([...openedEditorsForBackups].map(async openedEditorForBackup => {
417  			if (this.editorService.isVisible(openedEditorForBackup)) {
418  				return;
419  			}
420  
421  			return openedEditorForBackup.resolve();
422  		}));
423  
424  		// Finally, remove all handled backups from the list
425  		for (const restoredBackup of restoredBackups) {
426  			this.unrestoredBackups.delete(restoredBackup);
427  		}

430  	//#endregion

74  			}
75  			this._server = http.createServer((req, res) => this.onRequest(req, res));
76  			try {

78  				this._server.on('error', err => this.logService.error(err));
79  			} catch (err) {
80  				this.logService.error('Could not start open from terminal server.');
81  			}
82  		} catch (error) {

87  	private onRequest(req: http.IncomingMessage, res: http.ServerResponse): void {
88  		const sendResponse = (statusCode: number, returnObj: string | undefined) => {
89  			res.writeHead(statusCode, { 'content-type': 'application/json' });
90  			res.end(JSON.stringify(returnObj || null), (err?: any) => err && this.logService.error(err)); // CodeQL [SM01524] Only the message portion of errors are passed in.
91  		};
92  
93  		const chunks: string[] = [];
94  		req.setEncoding('utf8');
95  		req.on('data', (d: string) => chunks.push(d));
96  		req.on('end', async () => {
97  			try {
98  				const data: PipeCommand | any = JSON.parse(chunks.join(''));
99  				let returnObj: string | undefined;
100  				switch (data.type) {
101  					case 'open':
102  						returnObj = await this.open(data);
103  						break;
104  					case 'openExternal':
105  						returnObj = await this.openExternal(data);
106  						break;
107  					case 'status':
108  						returnObj = await this.getStatus(data);
109  						break;
110  					case 'extensionManagement':
111  						returnObj = await this.manageExtensions(data);
112  						break;
113  					default:
114  						sendResponse(404, `Unknown message type: ${data.type}`);
115  						break;
116  				}
117  				sendResponse(200, returnObj);
118  			} catch (e) {
119  				const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : JSON.stringify(e);
120  				sendResponse(500, message);
121  				this.logService.error('Error while processing pipe request', e);
122  			}
123  		});
124  	}

287  			localize('backupBeforeShutdownMessage', "Backing up editors with unsaved changes is taking a bit longer..."),
288  			localize('backupBeforeShutdownDetail', "Click 'Cancel' to stop waiting and to save or revert editors with unsaved changes.")
289  		);
290  
291  		return { backups, error };
292  	}

294  	private async confirmBeforeShutdown(modifiedWorkingCopies: IWorkingCopy[]): Promise<boolean> {
295  
296  		// Save
297  		const confirm = await this.fileDialogService.showSaveConfirm(modifiedWorkingCopies.map(workingCopy => workingCopy.name));
298  		if (confirm === ConfirmResult.SAVE) {
299  			const modifiedCountBeforeSave = this.workingCopyService.modifiedCount;
300  
301  			try {
302  				await this.doSaveAllBeforeShutdown(modifiedWorkingCopies, SaveReason.EXPLICIT);
303  			} catch (error) {
304  				this.logService.error(`[backup tracker] error saving modified working copies: ${error}`); // guard against misbehaving saves, we handle remaining modified below
305  			}
306  
307  			const savedWorkingCopies = modifiedCountBeforeSave - this.workingCopyService.modifiedCount;
308  			if (savedWorkingCopies < modifiedWorkingCopies.length) {
309  				return true; // veto (save failed or was canceled)
310  			}
311  
312  			return this.noVeto(modifiedWorkingCopies); // no veto (modified saved)
313  		}
314  
315  		// Don't Save
316  		else if (confirm === ConfirmResult.DONT_SAVE) {
317  			try {
318  				await this.doRevertAllBeforeShutdown(modifiedWorkingCopies);
319  			} catch (error) {
320  				this.logService.error(`[backup tracker] error reverting modified working copies: ${error}`); // do not block the shutdown on errors from revert
321  			}
322  
323  			return this.noVeto(modifiedWorkingCopies); // no veto (modified reverted)
324  		}
325  
326  		// Cancel
327  		return true; // veto (user canceled)
328  	}

330  	private doSaveAllBeforeShutdown(workingCopies: IWorkingCopy[], reason: SaveReason): Promise<void> {
331  		return this.withProgressAndCancellation(async () => {
332  
333  			// Skip save participants on shutdown for performance reasons
334  			const saveOptions = { skipSaveParticipants: true, reason };
335  
336  			// First save through the editor service if we save all to benefit
337  			// from some extras like switching to untitled modified editors before saving.
338  			let result: boolean | undefined = undefined;
339  			if (workingCopies.length === this.workingCopyService.modifiedCount) {
340  				result = (await this.editorService.saveAll({
341  					includeUntitled: { includeScratchpad: true },
342  					...saveOptions
343  				})).success;
344  			}
345  
346  			// If we still have modified working copies, save those directly
347  			// unless the save was not successful (e.g. cancelled)
348  			if (result !== false) {
349  				await Promises.settled(workingCopies.map(workingCopy => workingCopy.isModified() ? workingCopy.save(saveOptions) : Promise.resolve(true)));
350  			}
351  		},
352  			localize('saveBeforeShutdown', "Saving editors with unsaved changes is taking a bit longer..."),
353  			undefined,
354  			// Do not pick `Dialog` as location for reporting progress if it is likely
355  			// that the save operation will itself open a dialog for asking for the
356  			// location to save to for untitled or scratchpad working copies.
357  			// https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog/issues/4943
358  			workingCopies.some(workingCopy => workingCopy.capabilities & WorkingCopyCapabilities.Untitled || workingCopy.capabilities & WorkingCopyCapabilities.Scratchpad) ? ProgressLocation.Window : ProgressLocation.Dialog);
359  	}

361  	private doRevertAllBeforeShutdown(modifiedWorkingCopies: IWorkingCopy[]): Promise<void> {
362  		return this.withProgressAndCancellation(async () => {
363  
364  			// Soft revert is good enough on shutdown
365  			const revertOptions = { soft: true };
366  
367  			// First revert through the editor service if we revert all
368  			if (modifiedWorkingCopies.length === this.workingCopyService.modifiedCount) {
369  				await this.editorService.revertAll(revertOptions);
370  			}
371  
372  			// If we still have modified working copies, revert those directly
373  			await Promises.settled(modifiedWorkingCopies.map(workingCopy => workingCopy.isModified() ? workingCopy.revert(revertOptions) : Promise.resolve()));
374  		}, localize('revertBeforeShutdown', "Reverting editors with unsaved changes is taking a bit longer..."));
375  	}

6  import { IWorkingCopyBackupService } from '../common/workingCopyBackup.js';
7  import { IWorkbenchContribution } from '../../../common/contributions.js';
8  import { IFilesConfigurationService } from '../../filesConfiguration/common/filesConfigurationService.js';
9  import { IWorkingCopyService } from '../common/workingCopyService.js';
10  import { ILifecycleService, ShutdownReason } from '../../lifecycle/common/lifecycle.js';
11  import { ILogService } from '../../../../platform/log/common/log.js';
12  import { WorkingCopyBackupTracker } from '../common/workingCopyBackupTracker.js';
13  import { IWorkingCopyEditorService } from '../common/workingCopyEditorService.js';
14  import { IEditorService } from '../../editor/common/editorService.js';
15  
16  export class BrowserWorkingCopyBackupTracker extends WorkingCopyBackupTracker implements IWorkbenchContribution {
17  
18  	static readonly ID = 'workbench.contrib.browserWorkingCopyBackupTracker';
19  
20  	constructor(
21  		@IWorkingCopyBackupService workingCopyBackupService: IWorkingCopyBackupService,
22  		@IFilesConfigurationService filesConfigurationService: IFilesConfigurationService,
23  		@IWorkingCopyService workingCopyService: IWorkingCopyService,
24  		@ILifecycleService lifecycleService: ILifecycleService,
25  		@ILogService logService: ILogService,
26  		@IWorkingCopyEditorService workingCopyEditorService: IWorkingCopyEditorService,
27  		@IEditorService editorService: IEditorService,
28  	) {
29  		super(workingCopyBackupService, workingCopyService, logService, lifecycleService, filesConfigurationService, workingCopyEditorService, editorService);
30  	}
31  
32  	protected onFinalBeforeShutdown(reason: ShutdownReason): boolean {
33  
34  		// Web: we cannot perform long running in the shutdown phase
35  		// As such we need to check sync if there are any modified working
36  		// copies that have not been backed up yet and then prevent the
37  		// shutdown if that is the case.
38  
39  		const modifiedWorkingCopies = this.workingCopyService.modifiedWorkingCopies;
40  		if (!modifiedWorkingCopies.length) {
41  			return false; // nothing modified: no veto
42  		}
43  
44  		if (!this.filesConfigurationService.isHotExitEnabled) {
45  			return true; // modified without backup: veto
46  		}
47  
48  		for (const modifiedWorkingCopy of modifiedWorkingCopies) {
49  			if (!this.workingCopyBackupService.hasBackupSync(modifiedWorkingCopy, this.getContentVersion(modifiedWorkingCopy))) {
50  				this.logService.warn('Unload veto: pending backups');
51  
52  				return true; // modified without backup: veto
53  			}
54  		}
55  
56  		return false; // modified and backed up: no veto
57  	}
58  }

48  interface ManageExtensionsArgs {
49  	list?: { showVersions?: boolean; category?: string };
50  	install?: (string | URI)[];
51  	uninstall?: string[];
52  	force?: boolean;
53  }
54  
55  CommandsRegistry.registerCommand('_remoteCLI.manageExtensions', async function (accessor: ServicesAccessor, args: ManageExtensionsArgs): Promise<string | undefined> {
56  	const instantiationService = accessor.get(IInstantiationService);
57  	const extensionManagementServerService = accessor.get(IExtensionManagementServerService);
58  	const remoteExtensionManagementService = extensionManagementServerService.remoteExtensionManagementServer?.extensionManagementService;
59  	if (!remoteExtensionManagementService) {
60  		return;
61  	}
62  
63  	const lines: string[] = [];
64  	const logger = new class extends AbstractMessageLogger {
65  		protected override log(level: LogLevel, message: string): void {
66  			lines.push(message);
67  		}
68  	}();
69  	const childInstantiationService = instantiationService.createChild(new ServiceCollection([IExtensionManagementService, remoteExtensionManagementService]));
70  	try {
71  		const cliService = childInstantiationService.createInstance(RemoteExtensionManagementCLI, logger);
72  
73  		if (args.list) {
74  			await cliService.listExtensions(!!args.list.showVersions, args.list.category, undefined);
75  		} else {
76  			const revive = (inputs: (string | UriComponents)[]) => inputs.map(input => isString(input) ? input : URI.revive(input));
77  			if (Array.isArray(args.install) && args.install.length) {
78  				try {
79  					await cliService.installExtensions(revive(args.install), [], { isMachineScoped: true }, !!args.force);
80  				} catch (e) {
81  					lines.push(e.message);
82  				}
83  			}
84  			if (Array.isArray(args.uninstall) && args.uninstall.length) {
85  				try {
86  					await cliService.uninstallExtensions(revive(args.uninstall), !!args.force, undefined);
87  				} catch (e) {
88  					lines.push(e.message);
89  				}
90  			}
91  		}
92  		return lines.join('\n');
93  	} finally {
94  		childInstantiationService.dispose();
95  	}
96  
97  });

99  class RemoteExtensionManagementCLI extends ExtensionManagementCLI {
100  
101  	private _location: string | undefined;
102  
103  	constructor(
104  		logger: ILogger,
105  		@IExtensionManagementService extensionManagementService: IExtensionManagementService,
106  		@IExtensionGalleryService extensionGalleryService: IExtensionGalleryService,
107  		@ILabelService labelService: ILabelService,
108  		@IWorkbenchEnvironmentService envService: IWorkbenchEnvironmentService,
109  		@IExtensionManifestPropertiesService private readonly _extensionManifestPropertiesService: IExtensionManifestPropertiesService,
110  		@IProductService productService: IProductService,
111  	) {
112  		super([], logger, extensionManagementService, extensionGalleryService, productService);
113  
114  		const remoteAuthority = envService.remoteAuthority;
115  		this._location = remoteAuthority ? labelService.getHostLabel(Schemas.vscodeRemote, remoteAuthority) : undefined;
116  	}
117  
118  	protected override get location(): string | undefined {
119  		return this._location;
120  	}
121  
122  	protected override validateExtensionKind(manifest: IExtensionManifest): boolean {
123  		if (!this._extensionManifestPropertiesService.canExecuteOnWorkspace(manifest)
124  			// Web extensions installed on remote can be run in web worker extension host
125  			&& !(isWeb && this._extensionManifestPropertiesService.canExecuteOnWeb(manifest))) {
126  			this.logger.info(localize('cannot be installed', "Cannot install the '{0}' extension because it is declared to not run in this setup.", getExtensionId(manifest.publisher, manifest.name)));
127  			return false;
128  		}
129  		return true;
130  	}
131  }

6  import * as dom from '../../../../base/browser/dom.js';
7  import { IChatSideChatSelection } from '../common/chatSideChatService.js';
8  import { IChatWidget } from './chat.js';
9  
10  /**
11   * Captures the user's current text selection within `widget`'s transcript so a
12   * side chat can be anchored to it. Returns `undefined` when there is no
13   * meaningful selection, when it falls outside the widget, or when it lives in
14   * the input editor (which holds the question being asked, not the source text).
15   */
16  export function captureSideChatSelection(widget: IChatWidget | undefined): IChatSideChatSelection | undefined {
17  	if (!widget) {
18  		return undefined;
19  	}
20  	const nativeSelection = dom.getActiveWindow().getSelection();
21  	const selectedText = nativeSelection?.toString();
22  	if (!nativeSelection || !selectedText || !selectedText.trim()) {
23  		return undefined;
24  	}
25  	const { anchorNode, focusNode } = nativeSelection;
26  	if (!anchorNode || !focusNode || !dom.isAncestor(anchorNode, widget.domNode) || !dom.isAncestor(focusNode, widget.domNode)) {
27  		return undefined;
28  	}
29  	const inputEditorDomNode = widget.inputEditor.getDomNode();
30  	if (inputEditorDomNode && (dom.isAncestor(anchorNode, inputEditorDomNode) || dom.isAncestor(focusNode, inputEditorDomNode))) {
31  		return undefined;
32  	}
33  	return { text: selectedText };
34  }

94  
95  	private readonly _providers = observableValue<readonly IChatSideChatProvider[]>(this, []);
96  	// Cheap deriveds keyed by session resource keep observable identities stable across renders.
97  	private readonly _sideChatOrigins = new ResourceMap<IObservable<IChatSideChatOrigin | undefined>>();
98  
99  	registerProvider(provider: IChatSideChatProvider): IDisposable {
100  		if (!this._providers.get().includes(provider)) {
101  			this._providers.set([...this._providers.get(), provider], undefined);
102  		}
103  
104  		return toDisposable(() => {
105  			const providers = this._providers.get();
106  			const index = providers.indexOf(provider);
107  			if (index !== -1) {
108  				this._providers.set([...providers.slice(0, index), ...providers.slice(index + 1)], undefined);
109  			}
110  		});
111  	}
112  
113  	canAskInSideChat(sessionResource: URI): boolean {
114  		return !!this._findProvider(sessionResource);
115  	}
116  
117  	async askInSideChat(sessionResource: URI, query: string, selection?: IChatSideChatSelection): Promise<void> {
118  		const provider = this._findProvider(sessionResource);
119  		if (!provider) {
120  			throw new Error(`No side chat provider for ${sessionResource.toString()}`);
121  		}
122  		await provider.askInSideChat(sessionResource, query, selection);
123  	}
124  
125  	observeSideChatOrigin(sessionResource: URI): IObservable<IChatSideChatOrigin | undefined> {
126  		let origin = this._sideChatOrigins.get(sessionResource);
127  		if (!origin) {
128  			origin = derived(this, reader => {
129  				for (const provider of this._providers.read(reader)) {
130  					const providerOrigin = provider.observeSideChatOrigin(sessionResource).read(reader);
131  					if (providerOrigin !== undefined) {
132  						return providerOrigin;
133  					}
134  				}
135  				return undefined;
136  			});
137  			this._sideChatOrigins.set(sessionResource, origin);
138  		}
139  		return origin;
140  	}
141  
142  	async revealSideChatSource(sessionResource: URI): Promise<void> {
143  		for (const provider of this._providers.get()) {
144  			if (provider.observeSideChatOrigin(sessionResource).get() !== undefined) {
145  				await provider.revealSideChatSource(sessionResource);
146  				return;
147  			}
148  		}
149  	}
150  
151  	private _findProvider(sessionResource: URI): IChatSideChatProvider | undefined {
152  		for (const provider of this._providers.get()) {
153  			if (provider.canAskInSideChat(sessionResource)) {
154  				return provider;
155  			}
156  		}
157  		return undefined;
158  	}
159  }

{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "old:old:R_WorkspaceEdits",
      "name": "Coordinate workspace edits for workbench and extension callers",
      "summary": "Accept resource edit batches directly or through an extension transport bridge; revive extension payloads, conditionally preview, coordinate undo grouping and cancellation, and dispatch resource-kind edit groups. The extension interface returns a boolean from the shared coordinator, while workbench callers receive its summary and application flag.",
      "actor": "Workbench features and extensions requesting workspace changes",
      "inputs": [
        "ResourceEdit array or WorkspaceEdit",
        "Optional preview, editor, progress, cancellation and undo/redo settings",
        "Extension WorkspaceEdit",
        "Optional WorkspaceEditMetadata.isRefactoring",
        "Text-document version lookup"
      ],
      "outcomes": [
        "Specialized edit performers are called in input-kind group order",
        "An accessibility summary and isApplied flag are returned",
        "Involved dirty working copies may be saved under the refactoring autosave conditions",
        "Serialized edit sent to the main-thread proxy",
        "Revived edit delegated to the bulk-edit coordinator",
        "Boolean result returned, with application rejection logged and converted to false"
      ],
      "conditions": [
        "Empty initial edit batches return isApplied false",
        "Preview requires a registered handler plus showPreview or an edit requiring confirmation",
        "Cancellation is checked between edit-kind groups",
        "Autosave requires respectAutoSaveConfig, the corresponding enabled setting, and more than one returned resource",
        "The inspected version provider retrieves text versions but returns undefined for notebook versions",
        "Data-transfer file contents require a supplied resolver when reviving such payloads"
      ],
      "exclusions": [
        "No claim of atomic all-or-nothing mutation or rollback",
        "isApplied is computed from edit-array length and is not independent proof that every edit ran",
        "The extension transport does not independently perform edits.",
        "No claim that every extension API registration or edit-producing feature reaches this bridge."
      ],
